15.16.s:
prahlāda uvāca..
tato gaccheddvijaśreṣṭhā gadātīrthamanuttamam..
yatra snātvā naro bhaktyā labhedbhūdānajaṃ phalam.. 1 ..
15.16.d:
प्रह्लाद उवाच..
ततो गच्छेद्द्विजश्रेष्ठा गदातीर्थमनुत्तमम्..
यत्र स्नात्वा नरो भक्त्या लभेद्भूदानजं फलम्.. 1 ..
15.16.m: Prahlāda said: / Then, O best of the twice-born, one should go to the unsurpassable Gadātīrtha, / bathing where with devotion a man obtains the fruit produced by the gift of land.

15.16.s:
tarpayetpitṛdevāṃśca ṛṣīṃścaiva yathākramam ..
śrāddhaṃ ca kārayettatra pitṝṇāṃ tṛptihetave .. 2 ..
15.16.d:
तर्पयेत्पितृदेवांश्च ऋषींश्चैव यथाक्रमम् ..
श्राद्धं च कारयेत्तत्र पितॄणां तृप्तिहेतवे .. 2 ..
15.16.m: One should offer water libations to the ancestors, the gods, and the seers in due order, / and there one should have a śrāddha performed for the satisfaction of the ancestors.

15.16.s:
gadātīrthe tu deveśaṃ viṣṇuṃ vārāharūpiṇam ..
samabhyarcya naro bhaktyā viṣṇuloke mahīyate .. 3 ..
15.16.d:
गदातीर्थे तु देवेशं विष्णुं वाराहरूपिणम् ..
समभ्यर्च्य नरो भक्त्या विष्णुलोके महीयते .. 3 ..
15.16.m: Having worshiped with devotion the Lord of gods, Viṣṇu in the form of a boar, at Gadātīrtha, / a man is glorified in the world of Viṣṇu.

15.16.s:
nāgatīrthaṃ tato gacchetsaraḥ paramaśo bhanam..
yatra snātvā naraḥ samyaṅnāgalokamavāpnuyāt .. 4 ..
15.16.d:
नागतीर्थं ततो गच्छेत्सरः परमशो भनम्..
यत्र स्नात्वा नरः सम्यङ्नागलोकमवाप्नुयात् .. 4 ..
15.16.m: Then one should go to Nāgatīrtha, an exceedingly beautiful lake, / bathing where properly a man reaches the world of the Nāgas.

15.16.s:
bhadratīrthaṃ tato gacchetsarastribhuvanārcitam ..
snānamātreṇa labhate tiladhenuphalaṃ naraḥ .. .. 5 ..
15.16.d:
भद्रतीर्थं ततो गच्छेत्सरस्त्रिभुवनार्चितम् ..
स्नानमात्रेण लभते तिलधेनुफलं नरः .. .. 5 ..
15.16.m: Then one should go to Bhadratīrtha, a lake worshiped by the three worlds; / by merely bathing [there], a man obtains the reward of [gifting] a cow of sesame seeds.

15.16.s:
citrātīrthaṃ tato gacchetsaraḥ paramaśobhanam ..
snānamātreṇa labhate ghṛtadhenuphalaṃ naraḥ .. 6 ..
15.16.d:
चित्रातीर्थं ततो गच्छेत्सरः परमशोभनम् ..
स्नानमात्रेण लभते घृतधेनुफलं नरः .. 6 ..
15.16.m: Then one should go to Citrātīrtha, an exceedingly beautiful lake; / by merely bathing [there], a man obtains the reward of [gifting] a cow of clarified butter.

15.16.s:
yadā dvārāvatī viprā plāvitā sāgareṇa hi ..
puṇyāni bahutīrthāni cchannāni jalapāṃsubhiḥ .. 7 ..
15.16.d:
यदा द्वारावती विप्रा प्लाविता सागरेण हि ..
पुण्यानि बहुतीर्थानि च्छन्नानि जलपांसुभिः .. 7 ..
15.16.m: When Dvārāvatī was inundated by the ocean, O brahmins, / many sacred fords were covered with water and sand.

15.16.s:
dṛśyāni katicitsaṃti hyadṛśyānyaparāṇi ca ..
tāni sarvāṇi viprendrāḥ kathayiṣyāmi sarvataḥ .. 8 ..
15.16.d:
दृश्यानि कतिचित्संति ह्यदृश्यान्यपराणि च ..
तानि सर्वाणि विप्रेन्द्राः कथयिष्यामि सर्वतः .. 8 ..
15.16.m: Some are visible, and others are invisible; / I will declare all of them completely, O chiefs of brahmins.

15.16.s:
caṃdrabhāgāṃ tato gacchetsarvapāpapraṇāśinīm ..
yatra snātvā naro bhaktyā vājapeyaphalaṃ labhet .. 9 ..
15.16.d:
चंद्रभागां ततो गच्छेत्सर्वपापप्रणाशिनीम् ..
यत्र स्नात्वा नरो भक्त्या वाजपेयफलं लभेत् .. 9 ..
15.16.m: Then one should go to the Candrabhāgā, which destroys all sins, / bathing where with devotion a man obtains the fruit of the Vājapeya sacrifice.

15.16.s:
devī caṃdrārcitā yatra yaśodā naṃdanaṃdinī ..
kaumārikā śaktihastā khaṅgakheṭakadhāriṇī .. 7.4.16.10..
15.16.d:
देवी चंद्रार्चिता यत्र यशोदा नंदनंदिनी ..
कौमारिका शक्तिहस्ता खङ्गखेटकधारिणी .. 7.4.16.10..
15.16.m: Where the goddess is worshiped by Candra—the daughter of Yaśodā and Nanda, / a maiden, lance in hand, bearing a sword and shield,

15.16.s:
keśyādidaityadalinī svasā vai rāmakṛṣṇayoḥ ..
yasyā darśanamātreṇa sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt.. 11 ..
15.16.d:
केश्यादिदैत्यदलिनी स्वसा वै रामकृष्णयोः ..
यस्या दर्शनमात्रेण सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात्.. 11 ..
15.16.m: crusher of the demons beginning with Keśin, the sister of Rāma and Kṛṣṇa, / by the mere sight of whom one obtains all desires.

15.16.s:
tato gaccheta viprendrāstīrthaṃ mahiṣasaṃjñakam ..
yasya darśanamātreṇa mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ .. 12 ..
15.16.d:
ततो गच्छेत विप्रेन्द्रास्तीर्थं महिषसंज्ञकम् ..
यस्य दर्शनमात्रेण मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः .. 12 ..
15.16.m: Then, O chiefs of brahmins, one should go to the sacred ford named Mahiṣa, / by the mere sight of which one is freed from all sins.

15.16.s: muktidvāraṃ tato gacchettīrthaṃ pāpa praṇāśanam.. 13 ..
15.16.d: मुक्तिद्वारं ततो गच्छेत्तीर्थं पाप प्रणाशनम्.. 13 ..
15.16.m: Then one should go to Muktidvāra, a sacred ford that destroys sin.

15.16.s:
vasiṣṭhena samānītā muninā yatra gomatī ..
snāto bhavati gaṃgāyāṃ yatra snātvā kalau yuge .. 14 ..
15.16.d:
वसिष्ठेन समानीता मुनिना यत्र गोमती ..
स्नातो भवति गंगायां यत्र स्नात्वा कलौ युगे .. 14 ..
15.16.m: Where the Gomatī was brought down by the sage Vasiṣṭha; / bathing where in the Kali age, one is as if bathed in the Gaṅgā.

15.16.s:
gomatī niḥsṛtā yasmā tpraviṣṭā varuṇālayam ..
tatra snātvā naro bhaktyā aśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet .. 15 ..
15.16.d:
गोमती निःसृता यस्मा त्प्रविष्टा वरुणालयम् ..
तत्र स्नात्वा नरो भक्त्या अश्वमेधफलं लभेत् .. 15 ..
15.16.m: From where the Gomatī emerges and enters the abode of Varuṇa, / bathing there with devotion a man obtains the fruit of the horse sacrifice.

15.16.s:
bhṛguṇā hi tapastaptaṃ sthāpitā yatra cāṃbikā ..
bhṛgvarcitā tato devī prasiddhā śrūyate kṣitau .. 16 ..
15.16.d:
भृगुणा हि तपस्तप्तं स्थापिता यत्र चांबिका ..
भृग्वर्चिता ततो देवी प्रसिद्धा श्रूयते क्षितौ .. 16 ..
15.16.m: Where austerity was indeed performed by Bhṛgu, and Ambikā was established; / the goddess is therefore renowned on earth as 'worshiped by Bhṛgu' (Bhṛgvarcitā).

15.16.s:
saṃsiddhiṃ paramāṃ yāti yasyāḥ saṃsmaraṇānnaraḥ ..
śivaliṃgānyanekāni yatra santi mahītale ..17..
15.16.d:
संसिद्धिं परमां याति यस्याः संस्मरणान्नरः ..
शिवलिंगान्यनेकानि यत्र सन्ति महीतले ..17..
15.16.m: By remembering whom a man attains supreme perfection; / where on the earth there are many Śiva liṅgas.

15.16.s:
tato gaccheta viprendrāḥ kālindīsara uttamam..
kālindī sūryatanayā saraścakre tvanuttamam .. 18 ..
15.16.d:
ततो गच्छेत विप्रेन्द्राः कालिन्दीसर उत्तमम्..
कालिन्दी सूर्यतनया सरश्चक्रे त्वनुत्तमम् .. 18 ..
15.16.m: Then, O chiefs of brahmins, one should go to the excellent lake of Kālindī; / Kālindī, the daughter of the sun, made an unsurpassable lake.

15.16.s:
tatra snātvā naro bhaktyā na durgatimavāpnuyāt ..
sāṃbatīrthaṃ tato gacchetsarvapāpapraṇāśanam.. 19 ..
15.16.d:
तत्र स्नात्वा नरो भक्त्या न दुर्गतिमवाप्नुयात् ..
सांबतीर्थं ततो गच्छेत्सर्वपापप्रणाशनम्.. 19 ..
15.16.m: Bathing there with devotion, a man meets with no misfortune; / then one should go to Sāmbatīrtha, which destroys all sins.

15.16.s: kṛtvā śrāddhaṃ ca vidhivallabhedgodānajaṃ phalam .. 7.4.16.20 ..
15.16.d: कृत्वा श्राद्धं च विधिवल्लभेद्गोदानजं फलम् .. 7.4.16.20 ..
15.16.m: And having performed a śrāddha according to the rules, one obtains the fruit produced by the gift of a cow.

15.16.s:
gacchecca śāṃkaraṃ tīrthaṃ tatastrailokyapāvanam ..
yatra snātvā naro bhaktyā labhedbahusuvarṇakam .. 21 ..
15.16.d:
गच्छेच्च शांकरं तीर्थं ततस्त्रैलोक्यपावनम् ..
यत्र स्नात्वा नरो भक्त्या लभेद्बहुसुवर्णकम् .. 21 ..
15.16.m: Then one should go to the sacred ford of Śaṅkara (Śāṅkara), which purifies the three worlds, / bathing where with devotion a man obtains much gold.

15.16.s:
tato nāgasaro gacchettīrthaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam ..
pitṝnsantarpya vidhivannāgalokamavāpnuyāt .. 22 ..
15.16.d:
ततो नागसरो गच्छेत्तीर्थं पापप्रणाशनम् ..
पितॄन्सन्तर्प्य विधिवन्नागलोकमवाप्नुयात् .. 22 ..
15.16.m: Then one should go to Nāgasaras, a sacred ford that destroys sins; / having satisfied the ancestors according to the rules, one reaches the world of the Nāgas.

15.16.s:
lakṣmīṃ nadīṃ tato gacchedgacchantīṃ sāgaraṃ prati ..
yasyā darśanamātreṇa mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ .. 23 ..
15.16.d:
लक्ष्मीं नदीं ततो गच्छेद्गच्छन्तीं सागरं प्रति ..
यस्या दर्शनमात्रेण मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः .. 23 ..
15.16.m: Then one should go to the Lakṣmī river, flowing towards the ocean, / by the mere sight of which one is freed from all sins.

15.16.s:
śrāddhe kṛte tu viprendrāḥ pitaro muktimāpnuyuḥ ..
dāne manorathāvāptirjāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ.. 24..
15.16.d:
श्राद्धे कृते तु विप्रेन्द्राः पितरो मुक्तिमाप्नुयुः ..
दाने मनोरथावाप्तिर्जायते नात्र संशयः.. 24..
15.16.m: When a śrāddha is performed, O chiefs of brahmins, the ancestors attain liberation; / through a gift, the attainment of one's wishes comes to pass—there is no doubt about this.

15.16.s:
kaṃbusarastato gacchettīrthaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam..
tarpaṇe ca kṛte śrāddhe hyagniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet..25..
15.16.d:
कंबुसरस्ततो गच्छेत्तीर्थं पापप्रणाशनम्..
तर्पणे च कृते श्राद्धे ह्यग्निष्टोमफलं लभेत्..25..
15.16.m: Then one should go to Kambusaras, a sacred ford that destroys sins; / when libation and a śrāddha are performed, one indeed obtains the fruit of an Agniṣṭoma sacrifice.

15.16.s:
kuśatīrthaṃ tato gacchetsnātvā santarpayetpitṝn..
dānaṃ dattvā yathāśaktyā nirmalaṃ lokamāpnuyāt..26..
15.16.d:
कुशतीर्थं ततो गच्छेत्स्नात्वा सन्तर्पयेत्पितॄन्..
दानं दत्त्वा यथाशक्त्या निर्मलं लोकमाप्नुयात्..26..
15.16.m: Then one should go to Kuśatīrtha; having bathed, one should satisfy the ancestors; / having given a gift according to one's ability, one reaches a stainless world.

15.16.s:
dyumnatīrthaṃ ca tatraiva sarvapāpapraṇāśanam..
kṛtvā śrāddhaṃ ca tatraiva vājimedhaphalaṃ labhet .. 27 ..
15.16.d:
द्युम्नतीर्थं च तत्रैव सर्वपापप्रणाशनम्..
कृत्वा श्राद्धं च तत्रैव वाजिमेधफलं लभेत् .. 27 ..
15.16.m: And right there is Dyumnatīrtha, which destroys all sins; / and having performed a śrāddha right there, one obtains the fruit of a horse sacrifice.

15.16.s:
kuśatīrthaṃ tato gacchetpitṝṇāṃ tṛptirakṣayā ..
yatra śrāddhāttarpaṇācca jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. .. 28 ..
15.16.d:
कुशतीर्थं ततो गच्छेत्पितॄणां तृप्तिरक्षया ..
यत्र श्राद्धात्तर्पणाच्च जायते नात्र संशयः .. .. 28 ..
15.16.m: Then one should go to Kuśatīrtha, where imperishable satisfaction of the ancestors / arises from śrāddha and libation—there is no doubt about this.

15.16.s:
jālatīrthaṃ tato gacchetsarvapāpaharaṃ śubham ..
durvāsasā yatra śaptāḥ kopādyadukumārakāḥ .. 29 ..
15.16.d:
जालतीर्थं ततो गच्छेत्सर्वपापहरं शुभम् ..
दुर्वाससा यत्र शप्ताः कोपाद्यदुकुमारकाः .. 29 ..
15.16.m: Then one should go to the auspicious Jālatīrtha, which removes all sins, / where the Yadu youths were cursed out of anger by Durvāsas.

15.16.s:
devo jāleśvarastatra saṃ babhūva umāpatiḥ ..
jāleśvaraṃ naro dṛṣṭvā sadyaḥ pāpātpramucyate .. 7.4.16.30 ..
15.16.d:
देवो जालेश्वरस्तत्र सं बभूव उमापतिः ..
जालेश्वरं नरो दृष्ट्वा सद्यः पापात्प्रमुच्यते .. 7.4.16.30 ..
15.16.m: There the god Jāleśvara, the husband of Umā, appeared; / seeing Jāleśvara, a man is immediately freed from sin.

15.16.s: saṃpūjya devaṃ bhaktyā ca śivalokamavāpnuyāt .. 31 ..
15.16.d: संपूज्य देवं भक्त्या च शिवलोकमवाप्नुयात् .. 31 ..
15.16.m: And worshiping the god with devotion, one reaches the world of Śiva.

15.16.s:
cakrasvāmisutīrthaṃ ca tato gaccheddhi mānavaḥ ..
kṛtvā snānaṃ pitṝṃstarpya viṣṇulokamavāpnuyāt .. 32 ..
15.16.d:
चक्रस्वामिसुतीर्थं च ततो गच्छेद्धि मानवः ..
कृत्वा स्नानं पितॄंस्तर्प्य विष्णुलोकमवाप्नुयात् .. 32 ..
15.16.m: Then indeed a man should go to the excellent sacred ford Cakrasvāmin; / having performed ritual ablution and offered water libations to the ancestors, one reaches the world of Viṣṇu.

15.16.s:
jaratkārukṛtaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ..
snātvā tatra dvijaśreṣṭhā na durgatimavāpnuyāt .. 33 ..
15.16.d:
जरत्कारुकृतं तीर्थं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् ..
स्नात्वा तत्र द्विजश्रेष्ठा न दुर्गतिमवाप्नुयात् .. 33 ..
15.16.m: The sacred ford made by Jaratkāru destroys all sins. / Having bathed there, O best of the twice-born, one does not go to an evil state. 33.

15.16.s:
tato gaccheddvijaśreṣṭhāstīrthaṃ khañjanakābhidham ..
āsītkhañjanako nāma daityaścātibalānvitaḥ .. 34 ..
15.16.d:
ततो गच्छेद्द्विजश्रेष्ठास्तीर्थं खञ्जनकाभिधम् ..
आसीत्खञ्जनको नाम दैत्यश्चातिबलान्वितः .. 34 ..
15.16.m: Then, O best of the twice-born, one should go to the sacred ford named Khañjanaka. / There was a Daitya named Khañjanaka, endowed with immense strength. 34.

15.16.s:
tataḥ khañjanakaṃ tīrthaṃ tasya nāmneti viśrutam ..
tatra snātvā naro yāti somalokaṃ na saṃśayaḥ .. 35 ..
15.16.d:
ततः खञ्जनकं तीर्थं तस्य नाम्नेति विश्रुतम् ..
तत्र स्नात्वा नरो याति सोमलोकं न संशयः .. 35 ..
15.16.m: From him, that sacred ford became renowned by his name as Khañjanaka. / Having bathed there, a man goes to the world of Soma, without doubt. 35.

15.16.s:
santi tīrthānyanekāni suguptāni dvijottamāḥ ..
tāni gacchettu viprendrāḥ sarvapāpāpanuttaye .. 36 ..
15.16.d:
सन्ति तीर्थान्यनेकानि सुगुप्तानि द्विजोत्तमाः ..
तानि गच्छेत्तु विप्रेन्द्राः सर्वपापापनुत्तये .. 36 ..
15.16.m: There are many sacred fords, well-hidden, O best of the twice-born. / To them one should go, O lords of brahmins, to remove all sins. 36.

15.16.s:
tato gaccheddvijaśreṣṭhāstīrthamānakadundubheḥ ..
śūratīrthaṃ paramakaṃ gadatīrthamataḥ param .. 37 ..
15.16.d:
ततो गच्छेद्द्विजश्रेष्ठास्तीर्थमानकदुन्दुभेः ..
शूरतीर्थं परमकं गदतीर्थमतः परम् .. 37 ..
15.16.m: Then, O best of the twice-born, one should go to the sacred ford of Ānakadundubhi, / the supreme sacred ford of Śūra, and after that the sacred ford of Gada, 37.

15.16.s:
gāvalgaṇasya tīrthaṃ ca akrūrasya mahātmanaḥ ..
baladevasya tīrthaṃ tu ugrasenasya cāparam .. 38 ..
15.16.d:
गावल्गणस्य तीर्थं च अक्रूरस्य महात्मनः ..
बलदेवस्य तीर्थं तु उग्रसेनस्य चापरम् .. 38 ..
15.16.m: the sacred ford of Gāvalgaṇa, and that of the great-souled Akrūra, / the sacred ford of Baladeva, and another of Ugrasena, 38.

15.16.s:
arjunasya ca tīrthaṃ tu subhadrātīrthameva ca ..
devakītīrthamādyaṃ tu rohiṇītīrthameva ca .. 39 ..
15.16.d:
अर्जुनस्य च तीर्थं तु सुभद्रातीर्थमेव च ..
देवकीतीर्थमाद्यं तु रोहिणीतीर्थमेव च .. 39 ..
15.16.m: and the sacred ford of Arjuna, and the sacred ford of Subhadrā, / the primal sacred ford of Devakī, and the sacred ford of Rohiṇī, 39.

15.16.s:
uddhavasya ca tīrthaṃ tu sāraṃgākhyaṃ tathaiva ca ..
satyabhāmākṛtaṃ tīrthaṃ bhadrātīrthamataḥ param .. 7.4.16.40 ..
15.16.d:
उद्धवस्य च तीर्थं तु सारंगाख्यं तथैव च ..
सत्यभामाकृतं तीर्थं भद्रातीर्थमतः परम् .. 7.4.16.40 ..
15.16.m: and the sacred ford of Uddhava, and likewise that named Sāraṅga, / the sacred ford made by Satyabhāmā, and after that the sacred ford of Bhadrā, 40.

15.16.s:
jāmadagnyasya tīrthaṃ tu rāmasya ca mahātmanaḥ ..
bhāsatīrthaṃ ca tatraiva śukatīrthamataḥ param .. 41 ..
15.16.d:
जामदग्न्यस्य तीर्थं तु रामस्य च महात्मनः ..
भासतीर्थं च तत्रैव शुकतीर्थमतः परम् .. 41 ..
15.16.m: the sacred ford of Jāmadagnya Rāma, the great-souled, / and the sacred ford of Bhāsa right there, and after that the sacred ford of Śuka, 41.

15.16.s:
kardamasya ca tīrthaṃ tu kapilasya mahātmanaḥ ..
somatīrthaṃ ca tatraiva rohiṇītīrthameva ca .. 42 ..
15.16.d:
कर्दमस्य च तीर्थं तु कपिलस्य महात्मनः ..
सोमतीर्थं च तत्रैव रोहिणीतीर्थमेव च .. 42 ..
15.16.m: the sacred ford of Kardama, and of the great-souled Kapila, / and the sacred ford of Soma right there, and the sacred ford of Rohiṇī. 42.

15.16.s:
etānyanyāni saṃkṣepānmayā vaḥ kathitāni ca ..
sarvapāpaharāṇīha mokṣadāni na saṃśayaḥ .. 43 ..
15.16.d:
एतान्यन्यानि संक्षेपान्मया वः कथितानि च ..
सर्वपापहराणीह मोक्षदानि न संशयः .. 43 ..
15.16.m: These and others have been told to you in brief by me; / they take away all sins here [in this world] and bestow liberation, without doubt. 43.

15.16.s:
pracchannāni dvijavarāstīrthāni kalisaṃkrame ..
plāvitāni samudreṇa pāṃsunā'pyudakena ca .. 44 ..
15.16.d:
प्रच्छन्नानि द्विजवरास्तीर्थानि कलिसंक्रमे ..
प्लावितानि समुद्रेण पांसुनाऽप्युदकेन च .. 44 ..
15.16.m: Hidden are the sacred fords, O best of the twice-born, at the onset of Kali, / inundated by the ocean, by dust, and by water. 44.

15.16.s:
etanmayā vaḥ kathitaṃ saṃkṣepāttīrthavistaram ..
ātmaprajñānumānena kimanyacchrotumicchatha .. 45 ..
15.16.d:
एतन्मया वः कथितं संक्षेपात्तीर्थविस्तरम् ..
आत्मप्रज्ञानुमानेन किमन्यच्छ्रोतुमिच्छथ .. 45 ..
15.16.m: This extent of the sacred fords has been recounted by me in brief to you, / according to the deduction of my own intellect. What else do you wish to hear? 45.

15.16.s:
śṛṇuyātparayā bhaktyā tīrthayātrāmimāṃ dvijāḥ ..
sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati .. 46 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakā māhātmye tīrthavṛndamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 16 ..
15.16.d:
शृणुयात्परया भक्त्या तीर्थयात्रामिमां द्विजाः ..
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो विष्णुलोकं स गच्छति .. 46 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे चतुर्थे द्वारका माहात्म्ये तीर्थवृन्दमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षोडशोऽध्यायः .. 16 ..
15.16.m:
Whoever listens to this pilgrimage of sacred fords with supreme devotion, O twice-born, / completely freed from all sins, goes to the world of Viṣṇu. 46.
Thus ends the sixteenth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of the Multitude of Sacred Fords', in the Dvārakā-māhātmya, the fourth [part] of the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, the seventh [book], in the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa. 16.

15.17.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
kṛtvā'bhiṣekaṃ tīrtheṣu yathāvaddatta dakṣiṇaḥ ..
pūjayecca tato devaṃ kṛṣṇākhyaṃ puruṣaṃ param .. 1 ..
15.17.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
कृत्वाऽभिषेकं तीर्थेषु यथावद्दत्त दक्षिणः ..
पूजयेच्च ततो देवं कृष्णाख्यं पुरुषं परम् .. 1 ..
15.17.m: Prahlāda said: / Having performed ritual ablution in the sacred fords, [and] having given priestly fees properly, / one should then worship the god named Kṛṣṇa, the Supreme Person. 1.

15.17.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
pūjāvidhiṃ tu kṛṣṇasya śrotukāmāḥ samāsataḥ ..
kathayā''caraṇopetaṃ yathāvaddaityasattama .. 2 ..
15.17.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
पूजाविधिं तु कृष्णस्य श्रोतुकामाः समासतः ..
कथया'ऽचरणोपेतं यथावद्दैत्यसत्तम .. 2 ..
15.17.m: The seers said: / Wishing to hear in brief the rules of worship for Kṛṣṇa, / tell [it], along with its conduct, properly, O best of Daityas! 2.

15.17.s:
dvārapālāśca ke tatra kaḥ pūrvaṃ kaśca pṛṣṭhataḥ ..
purīyaṃ sarvato daitya tiṣṭhate kena pālitā .. 3 ..
15.17.d:
द्वारपालाश्च के तत्र कः पूर्वं कश्च पृष्ठतः ..
पुरीयं सर्वतो दैत्य तिष्ठते केन पालिता .. 3 ..
15.17.m: And who are the door-keepers there, who is at the front and who is at the back? / Guarded by whom does this city stand on all sides, O Daitya? 3.

15.17.s:
ānupūrvyātsamāsena pūjanīyā yathāvidhi ..
kathayasva vidhijño'si kṛṣṇaikacaraṇapriyaḥ .. 4 ..
15.17.d:
आनुपूर्व्यात्समासेन पूजनीया यथाविधि ..
कथयस्व विधिज्ञोऽसि कृष्णैकचरणप्रियः .. 4 ..
15.17.m: How they should be worshipped according to rule in brief and in order, / tell [us]; you know the procedure, being devoted to Kṛṣṇa’s feet alone. 4.

15.17.s:
.. śrīprahlāda uvāca .. ..
śrūyatāṃ pūjanaṃ viprāḥ śrutapūrvaṃ vidhānataḥ ..
kalau kṛṣṇasya viprendrā yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ .. 5 ..
15.17.d:
.. श्रीप्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
श्रूयतां पूजनं विप्राः श्रुतपूर्वं विधानतः ..
कलौ कृष्णस्य विप्रेन्द्रा यथावदनुपूर्वशः .. 5 ..
15.17.m: Glorious Prahlāda said: / O brahmins, hear the worship of Kṛṣṇa in the Kali [age], / heard formerly according to rule, properly in due order, O lords of brahmins. 5.

15.17.s:
pūrvadvārasthitāndevāñchuṇudhvaṃ susamāhitāḥ ..
jayaṃtaḥ prathamaṃ pūjyaḥ sarvapāpaharaḥ śubhaḥ .. 6 ..
15.17.d:
पूर्वद्वारस्थितान्देवाञ्छुणुध्वं सुसमाहिताः ..
जयंतः प्रथमं पूज्यः सर्वपापहरः शुभः .. 6 ..
15.17.m: Hear with minds fully focused of the gods stationed at the eastern gate: / Jayanta is to be worshipped first, auspicious, the remover of all sins, 6.

15.17.s:
sthāpito devarājena pūjārthaṃ keśavasya hi ..
tasyaivānucarānvakṣye tānnibodhata sattamāḥ .. 7 ..
15.17.d:
स्थापितो देवराजेन पूजार्थं केशवस्य हि ..
तस्यैवानुचरान्वक्ष्ये तान्निबोधत सत्तमाः .. 7 ..
15.17.m: installed indeed by the king of the gods for the worship of Keśava. / I shall tell of his attendants; learn of them, O best ones: 7.

15.17.s:
vajranābhaḥ sunābhaśca vajrabāhurmahā hanuḥ ..
vajradaṃṣṭro vajradhārī vajrahā vajralocanaḥ .. 8 ..
15.17.d:
वज्रनाभः सुनाभश्च वज्रबाहुर्महा हनुः ..
वज्रदंष्ट्रो वज्रधारी वज्रहा वज्रलोचनः .. 8 ..
15.17.m: Vajranābha, Sunābha, Vajrabāhu, Mahāhanu, / Vajradaṃṣṭra, Vajradhārī, Vajrahā, Vajralocana, 8.

15.17.s:
śvetamūrdhā śvetamālī jayantānucarāśca te ..
ete śastrodyatakarā rakṣante tamaharniśam .. 9 ..
15.17.d:
श्वेतमूर्धा श्वेतमाली जयन्तानुचराश्च ते ..
एते शस्त्रोद्यतकरा रक्षन्ते तमहर्निशम् .. 9 ..
15.17.m: Śvetamūrdhan, and Śvetamālin—these are the attendants of Jayanta. / With weapons raised in hand, these guard him day and night, 9.

15.17.s:
pūrvadvāre susaṃnaddhā jayantoddeśakāriṇaḥ ..
pūrvadvāre ca rakṣārthaṃ naranātho vināyakaḥ .. 7.4.17.10 ..
15.17.d:
पूर्वद्वारे सुसंनद्धा जयन्तोद्देशकारिणः ..
पूर्वद्वारे च रक्षार्थं नरनाथो विनायकः .. 7.4.17.10 ..
15.17.m: fully armored at the eastern gate, carrying out Jayanta's directions. / And for protection at the eastern gate is Naranātha Vināyaka, 10.

15.17.s:
taruṇārkaśca vai sūryo devyo vai sahamātaraḥ ..
īśvaraścāpi durvāsā nāgarājastu takṣakaḥ .. 11 ..
15.17.d:
तरुणार्कश्च वै सूर्यो देव्यो वै सहमातरः ..
ईश्वरश्चापि दुर्वासा नागराजस्तु तक्षकः .. 11 ..
15.17.m: and the sun [as] Taruṇārka, and the goddesses together with the Mothers, / and Īśvara, and also Durvāsas, and the serpent-king Takṣaka, 11.

15.17.s:
senānīḥ kārtikeyaśca rākṣasaśca mahāhanuḥ ..
tatra dīrghanakhonāma dānavaḥ supratiṣṭhitaḥ .. 12 ..
15.17.d:
सेनानीः कार्तिकेयश्च राक्षसश्च महाहनुः ..
तत्र दीर्घनखोनाम दानवः सुप्रतिष्ठितः .. 12 ..
15.17.m: and the commander Kārtikeya, and the rākṣasa Mahāhanu. / There the Dānava named Dīrghanakha is well-established, 12.

15.17.s:
viśvāvasuśca gandharvo menakā ca varāpsarāḥ ..
sanatkumārasahito vasiṣṭho bhagavānṛṣiḥ .. 13 ..
15.17.d:
विश्वावसुश्च गन्धर्वो मेनका च वराप्सराः ..
सनत्कुमारसहितो वसिष्ठो भगवानृषिः .. 13 ..
15.17.m: and the gandharva Viśvāvasu, and Menakā the excellent apsaras, / and the venerable seer Vasiṣṭha together with Sanatkumāra. 13.

15.17.s:
ete pūjyāḥ pūrvatastu nyagrodhaśca mahādrumaḥ ..
pūrvadvārasthitā hyeta āgneyāñchṛṇutātha me .. 14 ..
15.17.d:
एते पूज्याः पूर्वतस्तु न्यग्रोधश्च महाद्रुमः ..
पूर्वद्वारस्थिता ह्येत आग्नेयाञ्छृणुताथ मे .. 14 ..
15.17.m: These are to be worshipped in the east, and the banyan, the great tree. / These indeed are stationed at the eastern gate; now hear from me those of the southeast: 14.

15.17.s:
jvālāmukho'tha raktākṣaḥ smaśānanilayaḥ krathaḥ ..
māṃsādo rudhirāhāraḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇajaṭādharaḥ .. 15 ..
15.17.d:
ज्वालामुखोऽथ रक्ताक्षः स्मशाननिलयः क्रथः ..
मांसादो रुधिराहारः कृष्णः कृष्णजटाधरः .. 15 ..
15.17.m: Jvālāmukha, and Raktākṣa, Kratha whose abode is the cremation ground, / the flesh-eater, the blood-drinker, Kṛṣṇa, and Kṛṣṇajaṭādhara, 15.

15.17.s:
trāsano bhañjanaścaiva hyāgnyeyyāṃ diśi saṃsthitāḥ ..
diśaṃ rakṣaṃti saṃnaddhā dakṣiṇāṃ śṛṇutātha me .. 16 ..
15.17.d:
त्रासनो भञ्जनश्चैव ह्याग्न्येय्यां दिशि संस्थिताः ..
दिशं रक्षंति संनद्धा दक्षिणां शृणुताथ मे .. 16 ..
15.17.m: Trāsana and Bhañjana, stationed in the southeastern direction, / armored, protect the direction. Now hear from me [those of] the southern: 16.

15.17.s:
daṇḍapāṇirmahānādaḥ pāśahastaḥ sulocanaḥ ..
anivartyakramaścaiva tathā duṃdubhinisvanaḥ .. 17 ..
15.17.d:
दण्डपाणिर्महानादः पाशहस्तः सुलोचनः ..
अनिवर्त्यक्रमश्चैव तथा दुंदुभिनिस्वनः .. 17 ..
15.17.m: Daṇḍapāṇi, Mahānāda, Pāśahasta, Sulocana, / Anivartyakrama, and Dundubhinisvana, 17.

15.17.s:
kharasvano ghargharavāktathā maunapriyaḥ sadā ..
mallikākṣaśca eteṣāṃ praṇato dvārapālakaḥ .. 18 ..
15.17.d:
खरस्वनो घर्घरवाक्तथा मौनप्रियः सदा ..
मल्लिकाक्षश्च एतेषां प्रणतो द्वारपालकः .. 18 ..
15.17.m: Kharasvana, Ghargharavāc, and he who always loves silence, / and Mallikākṣa—bowed down, he is their door-keeper. 18.

15.17.s:
dakṣiṇadvārarakṣārthaṃ dundubhiśca vināyakaḥ ..
mahiṣārkaśca vai sūryo bhūṣaṇaśca tatheśvaraḥ .. 19 ..
15.17.d:
दक्षिणद्वाररक्षार्थं दुन्दुभिश्च विनायकः ..
महिषार्कश्च वै सूर्यो भूषणश्च तथेश्वरः .. 19 ..
15.17.m: For the protection of the southern gate is Dundubhi Vināyaka, / and the sun [as] Mahiṣārka, and Bhūṣaṇa the Īśvara, 19.

15.17.s:
caṇḍikā ca tathā devī hyūrddhvabāhuśca rākṣasaḥ ..
padmākṣaḥ kṣetrapālaśca nāgaścāśvatarastathā .. 7.4.17.20 ..
15.17.d:
चण्डिका च तथा देवी ह्यूर्द्ध्वबाहुश्च राक्षसः ..
पद्माक्षः क्षेत्रपालश्च नागश्चाश्वतरस्तथा .. 7.4.17.20 ..
15.17.m: and Caṇḍikā the goddess, and Ūrdhvabāhu the rākṣasa, / and Padmākṣa the field-protector, and the nāga Aśvatara, 20.

15.17.s:
citrāṃgadaśca gandharva urvaśī ca varāpsarāḥ ..
yo rājā sarvavṛkṣāṇāṃ śālaścāpi mahādrumaḥ .. 21 ..
15.17.d:
चित्रांगदश्च गन्धर्व उर्वशी च वराप्सराः ..
यो राजा सर्ववृक्षाणां शालश्चापि महाद्रुमः .. 21 ..
15.17.m: and Citrāṅgada the gandharva, and Urvaśī the excellent apsaras, / and the śāla, the great tree, which is the king of all trees, 21.

15.17.s:
sanātana ṛṣiśreṣṭho hyagastyaśca mahātapāḥ ..
ete yāmyadiśi dvāraṃ rakṣanti susamāhitāḥ .. 22 ..
15.17.d:
सनातन ऋषिश्रेष्ठो ह्यगस्त्यश्च महातपाः ..
एते याम्यदिशि द्वारं रक्षन्ति सुसमाहिताः .. 22 ..
15.17.m: and Sanātana, the best of seers, and Agastya of great austerity. / These, fully composed, protect the gate in the southern direction. 22.

15.17.s:
gītakṛnnartako nagnaḥ kaṃbalī dahanapriyaḥ ..
hasano netrabhaṃgaśca bhrūvikāro vijṛṃbhakaḥ .. 23 ..
15.17.d:
गीतकृन्नर्तको नग्नः कंबली दहनप्रियः ..
हसनो नेत्रभंगश्च भ्रूविकारो विजृंभकः .. 23 ..
15.17.m: Gītakṛt, Nartaka, Nagna, Kambalin, Dahanapriya, / Hasana, Netrabhaṅga, Bhrūvikāra, and Vijṛmbhaka— 23.

15.17.s:
muśalī prabhureteṣāṃ saṃnaddho vartate dvijāḥ ..
rakṣanti nairṛtīmāśāṃ paścimāṃ śṛṇutāparān .. 24 ..
15.17.d:
मुशली प्रभुरेतेषां संनद्धो वर्तते द्विजाः ..
रक्षन्ति नैरृतीमाशां पश्चिमां शृणुतापरान् .. 24 ..
15.17.m: Muśalī, the lord of these, stands fully armored, O twice-born. / They guard the south-western quarter. Hear of the others in the western: 24.

15.17.s:
svastikaḥ śaṃkhamūrddhā ca nīlavāsāḥ śubhānanaḥ..
pāśahastaḥ śūlahasta ekapādaikalocanaḥ.. 25..
15.17.d:
स्वस्तिकः शंखमूर्द्धा च नीलवासाः शुभाननः..
पाशहस्तः शूलहस्त एकपादैकलोचनः.. 25..
15.17.m: Svastika, Śaṅkhamūrdhan, Nīlavāsas, Śubhānana, / Pāśahasta, Śūlahasta, Ekapāda, Ekalocana; 25.

15.17.s:
paścimāyāṃ diśi tathā puṣpadanto vināyakaḥ..
uddhavārkaśca vai sūryaḥ śivaḥ satrājiteśvaraḥ .. 26 ..
15.17.d:
पश्चिमायां दिशि तथा पुष्पदन्तो विनायकः..
उद्धवार्कश्च वै सूर्यः शिवः सत्राजितेश्वरः .. 26 ..
15.17.m: in the western direction likewise, Puṣpadanta Vināyaka, / and the sun [as] Uddhavārka, and Śiva [as] Satrājiteśvara, 26.

15.17.s:
tuṃbarurnāmagandharvo ghṛtācī ca varāpsarāḥ ..
mahodaraśca nāgendro rākṣasaśca ghaṭotkacaḥ .. 27 ..
15.17.d:
तुंबरुर्नामगन्धर्वो घृताची च वराप्सराः ..
महोदरश्च नागेन्द्रो राक्षसश्च घटोत्कचः .. 27 ..
15.17.m: the gandharva named Tumburu, and Ghṛtācī the excellent apsaras, / and Mahodara the serpent-king, and Ghaṭotkaca the rākṣasa, 27.

15.17.s:
daityaḥ pañcajanonāma ṛṣiḥ kaśyapa eva ca ..
devī kapālinīnāma aśvatthastu mahādrumaḥ .. 28 ..
15.17.d:
दैत्यः पञ्चजनोनाम ऋषिः कश्यप एव च ..
देवी कपालिनीनाम अश्वत्थस्तु महाद्रुमः .. 28 ..
15.17.m: the Daitya named Pañcajana, and the seer Kaśyapa, / the goddess named Kapālinī, and the aśvattha, the great tree. 28.

15.17.s:
kapilaḥ kṣetrapālaśca pratīcīṃ pānti vai diśam ..
namaskāryāstathā pūjyā vāyavyo śṛṇutāparān .. 29 ..
15.17.d:
कपिलः क्षेत्रपालश्च प्रतीचीं पान्ति वै दिशम् ..
नमस्कार्यास्तथा पूज्या वायव्यो शृणुतापरान् .. 29 ..
15.17.m: Kapila and the kṣetrapāla protect the western quarter. / They are to be saluted and worshipped; now listen to the others of the north-western [quarter].

15.17.s:
bhaṃjano bhairavaścaiva kāliko'tha ghaṭodaraḥ ..
jhaṃjhakāmardanaḥ piṃgo ruruḥ sarvabhujovraṇī ..7.4.17.30..
15.17.d:
भंजनो भैरवश्चैव कालिकोऽथ घटोदरः ..
झंझकामर्दनः पिंगो रुरुः सर्वभुजोव्रणी ..7.4.17.30..
15.17.m: Bhañjana, Bhairava, Kālika, and Ghaṭodara, / Jhañjhākāmardana, Piṅga, Ruru, Sarvabhuj, Vraṇin,

15.17.s:
supārśvaḥ prabhureteṣāṃ saṃnaddhaḥ pālayandiśam ..
udīcyāṃ diśi viprendrāḥ śyāmalaśca gaṇādhipaḥ .. 31 ..
15.17.d:
सुपार्श्वः प्रभुरेतेषां संनद्धः पालयन्दिशम् ..
उदीच्यां दिशि विप्रेन्द्राः श्यामलश्च गणाधिपः .. 31 ..
15.17.m: [and] Supārśva their lord, armed, protecting the quarter. / In the northern quarter, O best of brahmins, is Śyāmala, the leader of the gaṇas,

15.17.s:
manvantako virūpākṣo golakaḥ śveta saṃplutaḥ ..
unmattaḥ prabhureteṣāmudīcyāṃ pālayandiśam .. 32 ..
15.17.d:
मन्वन्तको विरूपाक्षो गोलकः श्वेत संप्लुतः ..
उन्मत्तः प्रभुरेतेषामुदीच्यां पालयन्दिशम् .. 32 ..
15.17.m: Manvantaka, Virūpākṣa, Golaka, Śvetasaṃpluta, / [and] Unmatta, the lord of these, protecting the northern quarter.

15.17.s:
mūlasthānaśca vai sūryya indreśaśca maheśvaraḥ ..
devī kaṇṭheśvarīnāma kṣetrapālaśca khañjanaḥ .. 33 ..
15.17.d:
मूलस्थानश्च वै सूर्य्य इन्द्रेशश्च महेश्वरः ..
देवी कण्ठेश्वरीनाम क्षेत्रपालश्च खञ्जनः .. 33 ..
15.17.m: Mūlasthāna is Sūrya, and Indreśa is Maheśvara; / the goddess named Kaṇṭheśvarī, and Khañjana the kṣetrapāla;

15.17.s:
vāsukirnāgarājaśca kūrmapṛṣṭhaśca dānavaḥ ..
sanakaśca ṛṣiśreṣṭho golako rākṣasastathā .. 34 ..
15.17.d:
वासुकिर्नागराजश्च कूर्मपृष्ठश्च दानवः ..
सनकश्च ऋषिश्रेष्ठो गोलको राक्षसस्तथा .. 34 ..
15.17.m: Vāsuki the serpent king, and the dānava Kūrmapṛṣṭha; / Sanaka, the best of ṛṣis, and likewise the rākṣasa Golaka;

15.17.s:
nāradonāma gandharvo raṃbhā caiva varāpsarāḥ ..
ete pūjyāḥ prayatnena plakṣonāma mahādrumaḥ .. 35 ..
15.17.d:
नारदोनाम गन्धर्वो रंभा चैव वराप्सराः ..
एते पूज्याः प्रयत्नेन प्लक्षोनाम महाद्रुमः .. 35 ..
15.17.m: the gandharva named Nārada, and Rambhā the excellent apsaras; / these are to be worshipped with effort; [and] the great tree named Plakṣa.

15.17.s:
yakṣeśaḥ savitānāma śyāmaḥ pūjyaḥ prayatnataḥ ..
aiśānyāṃ diśi viprendrāḥ sthitā ye tānvadāmyaham.. 36 ..
15.17.d:
यक्षेशः सवितानाम श्यामः पूज्यः प्रयत्नतः ..
ऐशान्यां दिशि विप्रेन्द्राः स्थिता ये तान्वदाम्यहम्.. 36 ..
15.17.m: The lord of yakṣas named Savitṛ, Śyāma, is to be worshipped with effort. / O best of brahmins, I shall tell of those who are stationed in the north-eastern quarter:

15.17.s:
durdharo bhairavārāvaḥ kiṃkiṇīko mahābalaḥ ..
karālo vikaṭo mūlo balibhukto balipriyaḥ .. 37 ..
15.17.d:
दुर्धरो भैरवारावः किंकिणीको महाबलः ..
करालो विकटो मूलो बलिभुक्तो बलिप्रियः .. 37 ..
15.17.m: Durdhara, Bhairavārāva, Kiṅkiṇīka of great strength, / Karāla, Vikaṭa, Mūla, Balibhuk, [and] Balipriya.

15.17.s:
eteṣāṃ kṣetrapālānāṃ sastrīṇāṃ ca dvijottamāḥ ..
netā prabhu(ma?)śca svāmī ca jayantaḥ pālakastathā .. 38 ..
15.17.d:
एतेषां क्षेत्रपालानां सस्त्रीणां च द्विजोत्तमाः ..
नेता प्रभु(म?)श्च स्वामी च जयन्तः पालकस्तथा .. 38 ..
15.17.m: Of these kṣetrapālas along with their wives, O best among the twice-born, / the leader, master, lord, and protector is Jayanta.

15.17.s:
nigṛhṇātyanugṛhṇāti rakṣitā puravāsinām ..
jayantādeśamādāya te duṣṭānghātayanti ca .. 39 ..
15.17.d:
निगृह्णात्यनुगृह्णाति रक्षिता पुरवासिनाम् ..
जयन्तादेशमादाय ते दुष्टान्घातयन्ति च .. 39 ..
15.17.m: He restrains and he shows favor, the protector of the city-dwellers. / Receiving Jayanta's command, they destroy the wicked.

15.17.s:
nāgasthalasthitaḥ svāmī jayantaḥ pālakaḥ sadā ..
nāgarājaiḥ parivṛtaḥ pūjanīyaḥ prayatnataḥ .. 7.4.17.40 ..
15.17.d:
नागस्थलस्थितः स्वामी जयन्तः पालकः सदा ..
नागराजैः परिवृतः पूजनीयः प्रयत्नतः .. 7.4.17.40 ..
15.17.m: Dwelling in Nāgasthala, the lord Jayanta is always the protector; / surrounded by serpent kings, he is to be worshipped with effort.

15.17.s:
māṃsapriyamukhāścaita aiśānīṃ pāṃti vai diśam ..
sahasraśīrṣako devaḥ śeṣo nāgasthalasthitaḥ ..
ananto vāsukiścaiva takṣakaḥ padma eva ca .. 41 ..
15.17.d:
मांसप्रियमुखाश्चैत ऐशानीं पांति वै दिशम् ..
सहस्रशीर्षको देवः शेषो नागस्थलस्थितः ..
अनन्तो वासुकिश्चैव तक्षकः पद्म एव च .. 41 ..
15.17.m: With faces fond of meat, these protect the north-eastern quarter: / the thousand-headed god Śeṣa dwelling in Nāgasthala, / Ananta, Vāsuki, Takṣaka, and Padma,

15.17.s:
śaṃkhaḥ kaṃbalakaścaiva nāgaścāśvatarastathā ..
muktakaḥ kāliyaścaiva janako'thāparājitaḥ .. 42 ..
15.17.d:
शंखः कंबलकश्चैव नागश्चाश्वतरस्तथा ..
मुक्तकः कालियश्चैव जनकोऽथापराजितः .. 42 ..
15.17.m: Śaṅkha, Kambalaka, the serpent Aśvatara, / Muktaka, Kāliya, Janaka, and Aparājita.

15.17.s:
karkoṭakamukhā nāgāste ca santi sahasraśaḥ ..
te pūjyā gaṃdhapuṣpaiśca balibhirdhūpadīpakaiḥ ..43..
15.17.d:
कर्कोटकमुखा नागास्ते च सन्ति सहस्रशः ..
ते पूज्या गंधपुष्पैश्च बलिभिर्धूपदीपकैः ..43..
15.17.m: There are thousands of serpents headed by Karkoṭaka; / they are to be worshipped with perfumes, flowers, offerings, incense, and lamps,

15.17.s:
pāyasena ca māṃsena hyannādyaiḥ surayā tathā ..
tataḥ saṃpūjya devaśaṃ jayaṃtaṃ rakṣiṇāṃ varam .. 44 ..
15.17.d:
पायसेन च मांसेन ह्यन्नाद्यैः सुरया तथा ..
ततः संपूज्य देवशं जयंतं रक्षिणां वरम् .. 44 ..
15.17.m: with rice-milk, meat, foods and the like, and also with liquor. / Then, having worshipped the lord of gods, Jayanta, the best of protectors,

15.17.s:
gaṃdha puṣpopahāraiśca dhūpavastrādibhūṣaṇaiḥ ..
tato gaccheddvijaśreṣṭhāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ devakinandanam ..
saṃpūjyaḥ prathamaṃ tatra gaṇeśo rukmisaṃjñakaḥ..45..
15.17.d:
गंध पुष्पोपहारैश्च धूपवस्त्रादिभूषणैः ..
ततो गच्छेद्द्विजश्रेष्ठाः कृष्णं देवकिनन्दनम् ..
संपूज्यः प्रथमं तत्र गणेशो रुक्मिसंज्ञकः..45..
15.17.m: with perfumes, flowers, offerings, incense, clothes, ornaments, and the like, / one should then go, O best of brahmins, to Kṛṣṇa, the son of Devakī. / First to be worshipped there is the Gaṇeśa named Rukmin.

15.17.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
kathaṃ sa rukmidaityendro yo duṣṭo gaṇatāṃ gataḥ ..
sākṣādbhagavato dvāri pratyahaṃ pūjyate naraḥ .. 46 ..
15.17.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
कथं स रुक्मिदैत्येन्द्रो यो दुष्टो गणतां गतः ..
साक्षाद्भगवतो द्वारि प्रत्यहं पूज्यते नरः .. 46 ..
15.17.m: The ṛṣis said: / How did that lord of daityas, Rukmin, who was wicked, attain gaṇa-hood / [and become] a man worshipped every day directly at the Lord's gate?

15.17.s:
.. śrīprahlāda uvāca .. ..
kṛṣṇāya rukmiṇīṃ dātuṃ yadā bhīṣmaka udyataḥ ..
taddveṣātkrodhasaṃyukto rukmī caidyamamanyata ..47..
15.17.d:
.. श्रीप्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
कृष्णाय रुक्मिणीं दातुं यदा भीष्मक उद्यतः ..
तद्द्वेषात्क्रोधसंयुक्तो रुक्मी चैद्यममन्यत ..47..
15.17.m: Illustrious Prahlāda said: / When Bhīṣmaka was prepared to give Rukmiṇī to Kṛṣṇa, / Rukmin, out of hatred toward him, filled with anger, favored the king of Cedi.

15.17.s:
yadā jahāra bhagavānrukmiṇīmaṃbikālayāt ..
sarvānvidrāvya vai bhūpāñjarāsandhamukhānraṇe ..48..
15.17.d:
यदा जहार भगवान्रुक्मिणीमंबिकालयात् ..
सर्वान्विद्राव्य वै भूपाञ्जरासन्धमुखान्रणे ..48..
15.17.m: When the Lord carried off Rukmiṇī from the temple of Ambikā, / having routed all the kings headed by Jarāsandha in battle,

15.17.s:
tadā rukmī mahābāhurbhīṣmakasya suto balī ..
nāhatvā vinivartiṣye tamahaṃ yādavaṃ raṇe ..49..
15.17.d:
तदा रुक्मी महाबाहुर्भीष्मकस्य सुतो बली ..
नाहत्वा विनिवर्तिष्ये तमहं यादवं रणे ..49..
15.17.m: then Rukmin of mighty arms, the strong son of Bhīṣmaka, [vowed:] / 'Without slaying that Yādava in battle, I shall not return!'

15.17.s:
pratijñāṃ sarvabhūpānāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ kṛtavāndvijāḥ..
evamuktvā sa sannaddho yuddhāya paridhāvitaḥ..7.4.17.50..
15.17.d:
प्रतिज्ञां सर्वभूपानां शृण्वतां कृतवान्द्विजाः..
एवमुक्त्वा स सन्नद्धो युद्धाय परिधावितः..7.4.17.50..
15.17.m: He made this vow while all the kings were listening, O brahmins. / Having spoken thus, he equipped himself and rushed forth for battle.

15.17.s:
akṣauhiṇyā dalenaivāyuddhyatkṛṣṇena bho dvijāḥ ..
sa yudhyamānaḥ kṛṣṇena vadhyamāno hataujasaḥ ..51..
15.17.d:
अक्षौहिण्या दलेनैवायुद्ध्यत्कृष्णेन भो द्विजाः ..
स युध्यमानः कृष्णेन वध्यमानो हतौजसः ..51..
15.17.m: With the division of an akṣauhiṇī he fought with Kṛṣṇa, O brahmins. / Fighting with Kṛṣṇa, struck and deprived of his vigor,

15.17.s:
baddho bhagavatā tatra kṛtvā vairūpyameva ca ..
rāmeṇa baṃdhanānmukto maraṇāya matiṃ dadhau ..52..
15.17.d:
बद्धो भगवता तत्र कृत्वा वैरूप्यमेव च ..
रामेण बंधनान्मुक्तो मरणाय मतिं दधौ ..52..
15.17.m: he was bound there by the Lord and disfigured; / released from his bonds by Rāma, he set his mind on death.

15.17.s:
rukmiṇī bhrātaraṃ dṛṣṭvā maraṇe kṛtaniścayam..
uvāca kṛṣṇaṃ vaidarbhī bhrātaraṃ hyānayasva me ..53..
15.17.d:
रुक्मिणी भ्रातरं दृष्ट्वा मरणे कृतनिश्चयम्..
उवाच कृष्णं वैदर्भी भ्रातरं ह्यानयस्व मे ..53..
15.17.m: Rukmiṇī, the princess of Vidarbha, seeing her brother resolved upon death, / said to Kṛṣṇa: 'Bring my brother back to me!'

15.17.s:
tatastatpriyakāmārthamanumānya janārddanaḥ..
cakāra pārṣadāṃ madhye pravaraṃ vighnanāśanam ..54..
15.17.d:
ततस्तत्प्रियकामार्थमनुमान्य जनार्द्दनः..
चकार पार्षदां मध्ये प्रवरं विघ्ननाशनम् ..54..
15.17.m: Then, to fulfill her wish, Janārdana conciliated him / and made him the foremost destroyer of obstacles among his attendants.

15.17.s:
etasmātkāraṇādviprāḥ prathamaṃ pūjyate sadā ..
gaṃdhadhūpākṣatairvastrairmodakaistaṃ pratarpayet ..55..
15.17.d:
एतस्मात्कारणाद्विप्राः प्रथमं पूज्यते सदा ..
गंधधूपाक्षतैर्वस्त्रैर्मोदकैस्तं प्रतर्पयेत् ..55..
15.17.m: For this reason, O brahmins, he is always worshipped first. / One should gratify him with perfumes, incense, unbroken rice grains, clothes, and modakas.

15.17.s:
tasmiṃstuṣṭe jagannāthastuṣṭo bhavati nānyathā ..56..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye bhagavatparicārakavargakathanapūrvakarukmigarvaparihāravṛttāntavarṇanaṃ nāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 17 .. .. cha ..
15.17.d:
तस्मिंस्तुष्टे जगन्नाथस्तुष्टो भवति नान्यथा ..56..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे चतुर्थे द्वारकामाहात्म्ये भगवत्परिचारकवर्गकथनपूर्वकरुक्मिगर्वपरिहारवृत्तान्तवर्णनं नाम सप्तदशोऽध्यायः .. 17 .. .. छ ..
15.17.m:
When he is pleased, the Lord of the World becomes pleased, not otherwise.
Thus ends the seventeenth chapter, titled 'The Description of the Subdual of Rukmin's Pride Preceded by the Narration of the Lord's Attendants', in the Dvārakāmāhātmya, the fourth [sub-section] of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

15.18.s:
.. śrīprahlāda uvāca .. ..
pūjayedgaṇanāthaṃ taṃ rukmiṇaṃ rukmabhūṣitam ..
durvāsasaṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ ca balabhadraṃ ca bhaktitaḥ .. 1 ..
15.18.d:
.. श्रीप्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
पूजयेद्गणनाथं तं रुक्मिणं रुक्मभूषितम् ..
दुर्वाससं च कृष्णं च बलभद्रं च भक्तितः .. 1 ..
15.18.m: Illustrious Prahlāda said: / One should worship with devotion that lord of gaṇas, Rukmin, adorned with gold, / and Durvāsas, and Kṛṣṇa, and Balabhadra.

15.18.s:
yajatyeko mahāyajñaiḥ saṃpūrṇavaradakṣiṇaiḥ ..
ekaḥ paśyati deveśaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ tulyaphalau hi tau .. 2 ..
15.18.d:
यजत्येको महायज्ञैः संपूर्णवरदक्षिणैः ..
एकः पश्यति देवेशं कृष्णं तुल्यफलौ हि तौ .. 2 ..
15.18.m: One man offers sacrifices with great rites complete with generous gifts to priests; / another sees the lord of gods, Kṛṣṇa: both of them indeed obtain equal fruit.

15.18.s:
vāpīkūpataḍāgāni karotyekaḥ samāhitaḥ ..
ekaḥ paśyati deveśaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ tulyaphalau hi tau .. 3 ..
15.18.d:
वापीकूपतडागानि करोत्येकः समाहितः ..
एकः पश्यति देवेशं कृष्णं तुल्यफलौ हि तौ .. 3 ..
15.18.m: One man, attentive, constructs stepwells, wells, and ponds; / another sees the lord of gods, Kṛṣṇa: both of them indeed obtain equal fruit.

15.18.s:
gobhūtilahiraṇyādi dadātyeko dinedine ..
ekaḥ paśyati deveśaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ tulyaphalau hi tau .. 4 ..
15.18.d:
गोभूतिलहिरण्यादि ददात्येको दिनेदिने ..
एकः पश्यति देवेशं कृष्णं तुल्यफलौ हि तौ .. 4 ..
15.18.m: One man gives cows, land, sesame seeds, gold, and the like day after day; / another sees the lord of gods, Kṛṣṇa: both of them indeed obtain equal fruit.

15.18.s:
prāṇāyāmādisaṃyukto japadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ ..
ekaḥ paśyati deveśaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ tulyaphalau hi tau .. 5 ..
15.18.d:
प्राणायामादिसंयुक्तो जपध्यानपरायणः ..
एकः पश्यति देवेशं कृष्णं तुल्यफलौ हि तौ .. 5 ..
15.18.m: One man engages in breath control and the like, devoted to recitation and meditation; / another sees the lord of gods, Kṛṣṇa: both of them indeed obtain equal fruit.

15.18.s:
jāhnavyādiṣu tīrtheṣu susnātvaikaḥ samāhitaḥ ..
ekaḥ paśyati deveśaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ tulyaphalau hi tau ..6..
15.18.d:
जाह्नव्यादिषु तीर्थेषु सुस्नात्वैकः समाहितः ..
एकः पश्यति देवेशं कृष्णं तुल्यफलौ हि तौ ..6..
15.18.m: One man, composed, bathes well in tīrthas such as the Jāhnavī; / another sees the lord of gods, Kṛṣṇa: both of them indeed obtain equal fruit.

15.18.s:
tribhirvikramaṇairyena vikrāṃtaṃ bhuvanatrayam ..
trivikramaṃ ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā mucyate pātakatrayāt .. 7 ..
15.18.d:
त्रिभिर्विक्रमणैर्येन विक्रांतं भुवनत्रयम् ..
त्रिविक्रमं च तं दृष्ट्वा मुच्यते पातकत्रयात् .. 7 ..
15.18.m: By him who strode over the three worlds with three strides— / by seeing that Trivikrama, one is freed from the three sins.

15.18.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
kathaṃ traivikramī mṛrttirāgateyaṃ dharātale ..
kalānyāsācca kṛṣṇatvaṃ kadeyaṃ prāptavatyatha .. 8 ..
15.18.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
कथं त्रैविक्रमी मृर्त्तिरागतेयं धरातले ..
कलान्यासाच्च कृष्णत्वं कदेयं प्राप्तवत्यथ .. 8 ..
15.18.m: The ṛṣis said: / How did this form of Trivikrama come to the surface of the earth? / And when, through the imposition of parts, did it attain the state of Kṛṣṇa?

15.18.s:
daitya saṃśayamasmākaṃ chettumarhasyaśeṣataḥ ..
durvāsasaśca kṛṣṇasya saṃbhavaḥ kathyatāmiti .. 9 ..
15.18.d:
दैत्य संशयमस्माकं छेत्तुमर्हस्यशेषतः ..
दुर्वाससश्च कृष्णस्य संभवः कथ्यतामिति .. 9 ..
15.18.m: O daitya, you should resolve our doubt completely; / let the manifestation of Durvāsas and Kṛṣṇa be narrated.

15.18.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
tacchrūyatāṃ dvijaśreṣṭhā yathā mūrttistrivikramī ..
durvāsasā samāyuktā saṃbhūtā dharaṇītale .. 7.4.18.10 ..
15.18.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
तच्छ्रूयतां द्विजश्रेष्ठा यथा मूर्त्तिस्त्रिविक्रमी ..
दुर्वाससा समायुक्ता संभूता धरणीतले .. 7.4.18.10 ..
15.18.m: Prahlāda said: / Hear that, O best of brahmins, how the form of Trivikrama / along with Durvāsas arose upon the surface of the earth.

15.18.s:
pūrvaṃ kṛtayugasyāṃte balinā ca puraṃdaraḥ ..
nirjitya bhraṃśitaḥ sthānāttadarthaṃ madhusūdanaḥ .. .. 11 ..
15.18.d:
पूर्वं कृतयुगस्यांते बलिना च पुरंदरः ..
निर्जित्य भ्रंशितः स्थानात्तदर्थं मधुसूदनः .. .. 11 ..
15.18.m: Formerly, at the end of the Kṛta Yuga, Purandara was defeated / by Bali and cast down from his station; for that purpose, the slayer of Madhu,

15.18.s:
kaśyapādvāmano jajñe tato'bhūcca trivikramaḥ ..
tribhiḥ kramairmitām̐llokānākramya madhuhā hariḥ .. 12 ..
15.18.d:
कश्यपाद्वामनो जज्ञे ततोऽभूच्च त्रिविक्रमः ..
त्रिभिः क्रमैर्मिताम्̐ल्लोकानाक्रम्य मधुहा हरिः .. 12 ..
15.18.m: Hari, the slayer of Madhu, was born from Kaśyapa as Vāmana and then became Trivikrama, / having traversed the worlds measured out with three strides.

15.18.s:
baliṃ cakāra bhagavānpātālatalavāsi nam ..
bhaktyā tvananyayā kṛṣṇo daityena paritoṣitaḥ .. 13 ..
15.18.d:
बलिं चकार भगवान्पातालतलवासि नम् ..
भक्त्या त्वनन्यया कृष्णो दैत्येन परितोषितः .. 13 ..
15.18.m: The Lord made Bali an inhabitant of the realm of Pātāla. / Gratified by the Daitya with exclusive devotion, Kṛṣṇa

15.18.s:
svayaṃ caivā'vasattatra bhaktyā krīto haristadā ..
anugrahāya bhagavāndvārapālo babhūva ha ..14..
15.18.d:
स्वयं चैवाऽवसत्तत्र भक्त्या क्रीतो हरिस्तदा ..
अनुग्रहाय भगवान्द्वारपालो बभूव ह ..14..
15.18.m: dwelt there himself, bought by devotion at that time; / to show favor, the Lord indeed became his doorkeeper.

15.18.s:
durvāsāścāpi bhagavānātreyo munisattamaḥ..
aṭaṃstīrthāni mokṣārthaṃ muktikṣetramaciṃtayat ..15..
15.18.d:
दुर्वासाश्चापि भगवानात्रेयो मुनिसत्तमः..
अटंस्तीर्थानि मोक्षार्थं मुक्तिक्षेत्रमचिंतयत् ..15..
15.18.m: And the venerable Durvāsas, the son of Atri, best of sages, / wandering among sacred fords for the sake of liberation, thought about a sacred field of liberation.

15.18.s:
evaṃ citayamānaḥ sa jñānadṛṣṭyā mahāmuniḥ..
gomatyā saṃgamo yatra cakratīrthena bho dvijāḥ .. 16 ..
15.18.d:
एवं चितयमानः स ज्ञानदृष्ट्या महामुनिः..
गोमत्या संगमो यत्र चक्रतीर्थेन भो द्विजाः .. 16 ..
15.18.m: As he was thus thinking, that great sage, through vision born of wisdom, / [saw the place] where the confluence of the Gomatī is with Cakratīrtha, O twice-born ones!

15.18.s:
tanmuktikṣetramājñāya gamanāya matiṃ dadhe ..
sotītya nagaragrāmānudyānāni vanāni ca .. 17 ..
15.18.d:
तन्मुक्तिक्षेत्रमाज्ञाय गमनाय मतिं दधे ..
सोतीत्य नगरग्रामानुद्यानानि वनानि च .. 17 ..
15.18.m: Knowing that sacred field of liberation, he set his mind on going. / Passing beyond towns, villages, gardens, and forests,

15.18.s:
ānarttaviṣayaṃ prāpya daityabhūmiṃ viveśa ha ..
niḥsvādhyāyavaṣaṭkārāṃ vedadhvanivivarjjitām ..18..
15.18.d:
आनर्त्तविषयं प्राप्य दैत्यभूमिं विवेश ह ..
निःस्वाध्यायवषट्कारां वेदध्वनिविवर्ज्जिताम् ..18..
15.18.m: and reaching the country of Ānarta, he entered the land of the Daityas, / which was devoid of sacred recitation and the vaṣaṭ-call, and bereft of the sound of the Vedas,

15.18.s:
kuśena daityarājena sevitāṃ pālitāṃ tathā ..
bahumleccha samākīrṇāmadharmopārjakairjanaiḥ .. 19 ..
15.18.d:
कुशेन दैत्यराजेन सेवितां पालितां तथा ..
बहुम्लेच्छ समाकीर्णामधर्मोपार्जकैर्जनैः .. 19 ..
15.18.m: resorted to and protected by Kuśa, the Daitya king, / and overrun with many barbarians, with people accumulating unrighteousness.

15.18.s:
pratyāsannāmiti jñātvā cakratīrthamagāddvijaḥ ..
snātvā ca saṃgame puṇye mokṣye'haṃ ca kṛtāhnikaḥ .. 7.4.18.20 ..
15.18.d:
प्रत्यासन्नामिति ज्ञात्वा चक्रतीर्थमगाद्द्विजः ..
स्नात्वा च संगमे पुण्ये मोक्ष्येऽहं च कृताह्निकः .. 7.4.18.20 ..
15.18.m: Knowing it to be near, the twice-born went to Cakratīrtha: / 'Having bathed in the holy confluence, and having performed my daily rites, I shall eat.'

15.18.s:
iti kṛtvā sa niyamaṃ yayau śīghraṃ munistadā ..
snātvā śīghraṃ prayāsyāmi daityabhūmiṃ vihāya ca..21..
15.18.d:
इति कृत्वा स नियमं ययौ शीघ्रं मुनिस्तदा ..
स्नात्वा शीघ्रं प्रयास्यामि दैत्यभूमिं विहाय च..21..
15.18.m: Having made this vow, the sage then went quickly: / 'Having bathed, I will quickly leave, departing from the land of the Daityas.'

15.18.s:
ityevaṃ ciṃtayanmārge śīghrameva jagāma saḥ..
dṛṣṭvā ca saṃgamaṃ puṇyaṃ gomatyā sāgarasya ca .. 22 ..
15.18.d:
इत्येवं चिंतयन्मार्गे शीघ्रमेव जगाम सः..
दृष्ट्वा च संगमं पुण्यं गोमत्या सागरस्य च .. 22 ..
15.18.m: Reflecting thus on the way, he went very quickly, / and saw the holy confluence of the Gomatī and the ocean.

15.18.s:
nidhāya vāsasī tatra mṛdamālabhya gomayam ..
śikhāṃ ca baddhvā karayoḥ kṛtvā ca niyataḥ kuśān .. .. 23 ..
15.18.d:
निधाय वाससी तत्र मृदमालभ्य गोमयम् ..
शिखां च बद्ध्वा करयोः कृत्वा च नियतः कुशान् .. .. 23 ..
15.18.m: Having set down his two garments there, having applied clay and cow dung, / having tied his topknot, and holding kuśa grasses in his hands with restraint,

15.18.s:
yāvatsnāti ca vipro'sau dṛṣṭo daityairdurātmabhiḥ ..
bruvaṃtaḥ ko'yamityevaṃ hanyatāṃhanyatāmiti ..24..
15.18.d:
यावत्स्नाति च विप्रोऽसौ दृष्टो दैत्यैर्दुरात्मभिः ..
ब्रुवंतः कोऽयमित्येवं हन्यतांहन्यतामिति ..24..
15.18.m: as that brahmin bathed, he was seen by the evil-minded Daityas, / who cried out: 'Who is this? Let him be killed! Let him be killed!

15.18.s:
asmābhiḥ pālite deśe kaḥ snāti manujādhamaḥ ..
bruvaṃta iti jaghnuste jānubhirmuṣṭibhistathā .. 25 ..
15.18.d:
अस्माभिः पालिते देशे कः स्नाति मनुजाधमः ..
ब्रुवंत इति जघ्नुस्ते जानुभिर्मुष्टिभिस्तथा .. 25 ..
15.18.m: What vile man bathes in the land protected by us?' / Saying thus, they struck him with their knees and fists.

15.18.s:
brāhmaṇo'haṃ na haṃtavyaḥ śrutvā cā'tīva pīḍitaḥ ..
taṃ dṛṣṭvā hanyamānaṃ tu brāhmaṇaṃ tairdurātmabhiḥ .. 26 ..
15.18.d:
ब्राह्मणोऽहं न हंतव्यः श्रुत्वा चाऽतीव पीडितः ..
तं दृष्ट्वा हन्यमानं तु ब्राह्मणं तैर्दुरात्मभिः .. 26 ..
15.18.m: 'I am a brahmin! I must not be killed!' Hearing this, and seeing him struck / exceedingly and seeing that brahmin being beaten by those evil-minded ones,

15.18.s:
nivārayāmāsa ca tānrururnāma mahāsuraḥ ..
jagṛhustasya vastrāṇi kuśāṃste cikṣipurjale .. 27 ..
15.18.d:
निवारयामास च तान्रुरुर्नाम महासुरः ..
जगृहुस्तस्य वस्त्राणि कुशांस्ते चिक्षिपुर्जले .. 27 ..
15.18.m: a great asura named Ruru restrained them. / They seized his clothes and threw the kuśa grasses into the water;

15.18.s:
cakarṣuścaraṇau gṛhya śapaṃto duṣṭacetasaḥ ..
pade gṛhītvā tamṛṣiṃ nītvā sīmni vyasarjayan .. 28 ..
15.18.d:
चकर्षुश्चरणौ गृह्य शपंतो दुष्टचेतसः ..
पदे गृहीत्वा तमृषिं नीत्वा सीम्नि व्यसर्जयन् .. 28 ..
15.18.m: seizing his feet, the wicked-minded ones dragged him, cursing. / Grasping that ṛṣi by the feet and carrying him away, they cast him out at the border.

15.18.s:
taṃ tadā mūrchitaprāyaṃ dṛṣṭvocuḥ kupitāśca te ..
atrāgato yadi punarhaniṣyāmo na saṃśayaḥ ..
ānarttaviṣayāṃstānvai dṛṣṭvā tatra jalāśayam .. 29 ..
15.18.d:
तं तदा मूर्छितप्रायं दृष्ट्वोचुः कुपिताश्च ते ..
अत्रागतो यदि पुनर्हनिष्यामो न संशयः ..
आनर्त्तविषयांस्तान्वै दृष्ट्वा तत्र जलाशयम् .. 29 ..
15.18.m: Seeing him then almost unconscious, they said in anger: / 'If you come here again, we will surely kill you!' / Seeing those lands of Ānarta and the body of water there,

15.18.s:
prāṇasaṃśayamāpannastataściṃtāparo'bhavat ..
śapyehaṃ yadi daiteyāṃstapasaḥ kiṃ vyayena me .. 7.4.18.30 ..
15.18.d:
प्राणसंशयमापन्नस्ततश्चिंतापरोऽभवत् ..
शप्येहं यदि दैतेयांस्तपसः किं व्ययेन मे .. 7.4.18.30 ..
15.18.m: brought to mortal danger, he then became overwhelmed with anxiety: / 'If I curse the Daityas, what is the use of exhausting my austerity?

15.18.s:
athavā niyamabhraṣṭastyakṣye cedaṃ kalevaram ..
mama pakṣaṃ ca kaḥ kuryyātko me dāsyati jīvitam .. 31 ..
15.18.d:
अथवा नियमभ्रष्टस्त्यक्ष्ये चेदं कलेवरम् ..
मम पक्षं च कः कुर्य्यात्को मे दास्यति जीवितम् .. 31 ..
15.18.m: Or else, fallen from my vow, I will give up this body. / Who will take my side? Who will give me my life?

15.18.s:
cakratīrthe ca kaḥ snānaṃ kārayiṣyati māmiha ..
ko vā daityagaṇānetāñchakto jetuṃ mahāmṛdhe ..
taṃ vinā puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ bhaktānāmabhayapradam .. 32 ..
15.18.d:
चक्रतीर्थे च कः स्नानं कारयिष्यति मामिह ..
को वा दैत्यगणानेताञ्छक्तो जेतुं महामृधे ..
तं विना पुण्डरीकाक्षं भक्तानामभयप्रदम् .. 32 ..
15.18.m: And who will cause me to take a bath here at Cakratīrtha? / Or who is capable of conquering these hosts of Daityas in a great battle, / without that lotus-eyed one who grants fearlessness to his devotees,

15.18.s:
brahmādīnāṃ ca netāraṃ śaraṇāgatavatsalam ..
cakrahastaṃ vinā medya konyaḥ śarmmaprado bhavet .. 33 ..
15.18.d:
ब्रह्मादीनां च नेतारं शरणागतवत्सलम् ..
चक्रहस्तं विना मेद्य कोन्यः शर्म्मप्रदो भवेत् .. 33 ..
15.18.m: the leader of Brahmā and the others, who is tender to those seeking refuge? / Without the one holding the discus in hand, who else could grant me peace today?'

15.18.s:
iti dhyātvā ca suciraṃ jñātvā pātālavāsi nam ..
ātreyo viṣṇuśaraṇaṃ jagāma dharaṇītalam .. 34 ..
15.18.d:
इति ध्यात्वा च सुचिरं ज्ञात्वा पातालवासि नम् ..
आत्रेयो विष्णुशरणं जगाम धरणीतलम् .. 34 ..
15.18.m: Having meditated thus for a long time, and knowing [him] to be living in Pātāla, / the son of Atri, seeking refuge in Viṣṇu, went to the subterranean world.

15.18.s:
upavāsaiḥ kṛśo dīno bhūtalaṃ praviveśa ha ..
sa daittyarājabhavanaṃ gandharvāpsarasāvṛtam .. .. 35 ..
15.18.d:
उपवासैः कृशो दीनो भूतलं प्रविवेश ह ..
स दैत्त्यराजभवनं गन्धर्वाप्सरसावृतम् .. .. 35 ..
15.18.m: Emaciated by fasts and wretched, he entered the netherworld. / He reached the palace of the Daitya king, surrounded by gandharvas and apsarases,

15.18.s:
śobhitaṃ suramukhyena viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā ..
durvāsāḥ praviveśātha prahṛṣṭenāṃtarātmanā.. 36 ..
15.18.d:
शोभितं सुरमुख्येन विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना ..
दुर्वासाः प्रविवेशाथ प्रहृष्टेनांतरात्मना.. 36 ..
15.18.m: adorned by Viṣṇu, the chief of the gods and mighty lord. / Durvāsas then entered with a rejoiced heart.

15.18.s:
durvāsasamathāyāṃtaṃ dṛṣṭvā daityapatistadā ..
pratyutthāyārhayāṃcakre svāsane saṃnyaveśayat ..37..
15.18.d:
दुर्वाससमथायांतं दृष्ट्वा दैत्यपतिस्तदा ..
प्रत्युत्थायार्हयांचक्रे स्वासने संन्यवेशयत् ..37..
15.18.m: Seeing Durvāsas approaching then, the lord of the Daityas / stood up, honored him, and made him sit on his own seat.

15.18.s:
madhuparkaṃ ca gāṃ caiva dattvārghyaṃ pārśvataḥ sthitaḥ ..
provāca praṇato brahmankathamatrāgato bhavān ..38..
15.18.d:
मधुपर्कं च गां चैव दत्त्वार्घ्यं पार्श्वतः स्थितः ..
प्रोवाच प्रणतो ब्रह्मन्कथमत्रागतो भवान् ..38..
15.18.m: Having offered the madhuparka offering, a cow, and water of welcome, standing by his side, / he bowed and said: 'O brahmin, how have you arrived here?'

15.18.s:
sukhopaviṣṭaḥ sa ṛṣistatrāpaśyattrivikramam ..
daityendradvāradeśe tu tiṣṭhantamakutobhayam .. 39 ..
15.18.d:
सुखोपविष्टः स ऋषिस्तत्रापश्यत्त्रिविक्रमम् ..
दैत्येन्द्रद्वारदेशे तु तिष्ठन्तमकुतोभयम् .. 39 ..
15.18.m: Seated comfortably, that ṛṣi saw Trivikrama there, / standing fearless at the gateway of the Daitya king.

15.18.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā devadeveśaṃ śrīvatsāṃkaṃ caturbhujam ..
ruroda sa ṛṣiśreṣṭhastrāhitrāhītyuvāca ca .. 7.4.18.40 ..
15.18.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा देवदेवेशं श्रीवत्सांकं चतुर्भुजम् ..
रुरोद स ऋषिश्रेष्ठस्त्राहित्राहीत्युवाच च .. 7.4.18.40 ..
15.18.m: Seeing him, the lord of the chiefs of gods, marked with the Śrīvatsa, four-armed, / that best of ṛṣis wept and said: 'Save me! Save me!

15.18.s:
saṃsārabhayabhītānāṃ duḥkhitānāṃ janārdana ..
śatrubhiḥ paribhūtānāṃ śaraṇaṃ bhava keśava .. 41 ..
15.18.d:
संसारभयभीतानां दुःखितानां जनार्दन ..
शत्रुभिः परिभूतानां शरणं भव केशव .. 41 ..
15.18.m: O Janārdana, for those terrified of the fear of worldly existence, the distressed, / and those overcome by enemies, be the refuge, O Keśava!

15.18.s:
mama duḥkhābhitaptasya śatrubhiḥ karṣitasya ca ..
parābhūtasya dīnasya kṣudhayā pīḍitasya ca .. 42 ..
15.18.d:
मम दुःखाभितप्तस्य शत्रुभिः कर्षितस्य च ..
पराभूतस्य दीनस्य क्षुधया पीडितस्य च .. 42 ..
15.18.m: For me, tormented by sorrow and dragged down by enemies, / defeated, wretched, and afflicted by hunger,

15.18.s:
apūrṇaniyamasyā'tha kleśitatya ca dānavaiḥ ..
brahmaṇyadeva viprasya śaraṇaṃ bhava keśava .. 43 ..
15.18.d:
अपूर्णनियमस्याऽथ क्लेशितत्य च दानवैः ..
ब्रह्मण्यदेव विप्रस्य शरणं भव केशव .. 43 ..
15.18.m: whose vow is unfulfilled and who am tormented by the Dānavas— / O god beneficial to brahmins, be the refuge of a brahmin, O Keśava!'

15.18.s:
ityuktvā darśayāmāsa śarīraṃ daityatāḍitam ..
tadbrāhmaṇāvamānaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā cukrodha vāmanaḥ .. 44 ..
15.18.d:
इत्युक्त्वा दर्शयामास शरीरं दैत्यताडितम् ..
तद्ब्राह्मणावमानं च दृष्ट्वा चुक्रोध वामनः .. 44 ..
15.18.m: Having spoken thus, he showed his body beaten by the Daityas. / Seeing that insult to the brahmin, Vāmana became enraged:

15.18.s:
kenāpamānito brahmanniyamaḥ kena khaṇḍitaḥ ..
kathayasva mahābhāga dharmapāle mayi sthite .. 45 ..
15.18.d:
केनापमानितो ब्रह्मन्नियमः केन खण्डितः ..
कथयस्व महाभाग धर्मपाले मयि स्थिते .. 45 ..
15.18.m: 'By whom were you insulted, O brahmin? By whom was your vow broken? / Tell me, O fortunate one, while I stand as the protector of dharma!'

15.18.s:
.. durvāsā uvāca .. ..
muktitīrthamahaṃ jñātvā jñānena madhusūdana ..
cakratīrthaṃ gataḥ snātuṃ yātrāyāṃ harṣasaṃyutaḥ .. 46 ..
15.18.d:
.. दुर्वासा उवाच .. ..
मुक्तितीर्थमहं ज्ञात्वा ज्ञानेन मधुसूदन ..
चक्रतीर्थं गतः स्नातुं यात्रायां हर्षसंयुतः .. 46 ..
15.18.m: Durvāsas said: / 'Knowing it to be a sacred ford of liberation through wisdom, O Madhusūdana, / I went to Cakratīrtha to bathe, filled with joy on the pilgrimage.

15.18.s:
akṛtasnāna evā'haṃ dṛṣṭo daityairdurāsadaiḥ ..
gale gṛhītaḥ kṛṣṇāhaṃ muṣṭibhistāḍitastathā .. 47 ..
15.18.d:
अकृतस्नान एवाऽहं दृष्टो दैत्यैर्दुरासदैः ..
गले गृहीतः कृष्णाहं मुष्टिभिस्ताडितस्तथा .. 47 ..
15.18.m: Before I had even bathed, I was seen by the unassailable Daityas. / I was seized by the throat, O Kṛṣṇa, and beaten with fists.

15.18.s:
balādgṛhītvā vāsāṃsi kuśāṃścaivākṣataiḥ saha ..
jale kṣiptvā caraṇayorgṛhītvā māṃ samākṛṣan .. 48 ..
15.18.d:
बलाद्गृहीत्वा वासांसि कुशांश्चैवाक्षतैः सह ..
जले क्षिप्त्वा चरणयोर्गृहीत्वा मां समाकृषन् .. 48 ..
15.18.m: Forcibly taking my garments and kuśa grasses along with the unbroken grains, / throwing them into the water, and seizing me by the feet, they dragged me away.

15.18.s:
sīmāṃte māṃ tu prakṣipya procuste dānavādhamāḥ ..
haniṣyāmo yadi punarāgaṃtāsi na saṃśayaḥ .. 49 ..
15.18.d:
सीमांते मां तु प्रक्षिप्य प्रोचुस्ते दानवाधमाः ..
हनिष्यामो यदि पुनरागंतासि न संशयः .. 49 ..
15.18.m: Casting me out at the boundary, those vile Dānavas said: / 'If you come again, we will surely kill you!'

15.18.s:
snāto'haṃ cakratīrthe tu kariṣye bhojanaṃ vibho ..
tasmātsnāpaya goviṃda niyamaṃ saphalaṃ kuru .. 7.4.18.50 ..
15.18.d:
स्नातोऽहं चक्रतीर्थे तु करिष्ये भोजनं विभो ..
तस्मात्स्नापय गोविंद नियमं सफलं कुरु .. 7.4.18.50 ..
15.18.m: Only having bathed in Cakratīrtha will I eat food, O Lord. / Therefore cause me to bathe, O Govinda; make my vow fruitful!

15.18.s:
tava prasādātsnātvā'haṃ bhuktvā ca prītamānasaḥ ..
pratijñāṃ saphalāṃ kṛtvā vicariṣye mahīmimām .. 51 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye cakratīrthamāhātmye rākṣasakṛtadurvāsaḥparābhavavṛttāntavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 18 ..
15.18.d:
तव प्रसादात्स्नात्वाऽहं भुक्त्वा च प्रीतमानसः ..
प्रतिज्ञां सफलां कृत्वा विचरिष्ये महीमिमाम् .. 51 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे चतुर्थे द्वारकामाहात्म्ये चक्रतीर्थमाहात्म्ये राक्षसकृतदुर्वासःपराभववृत्तान्तवर्णनं नामाष्टादशोऽध्यायः .. 18 ..
15.18.m:
Having bathed by your grace and having eaten with a delighted mind, / having fulfilled my vow, I will wander this earth.'
Thus ends the eighteenth chapter, named 'Account of the Humiliation of Durvāsas by the Rākṣasas,' in the praise of Cakratīrtha, in the Dvārakāmāhātmya, in the fourth Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the seventh part of the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand verses.

15.19.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
tacchrutvā devadeveśaściṃtayitvā punaḥpunaḥ .. uvāca vacanaṃ tatra durvāsasamakalmaṣam .. 1..
15.19.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा देवदेवेशश्चिंतयित्वा पुनःपुनः .. उवाच वचनं तत्र दुर्वाससमकल्मषम् .. 1..
15.19.m: Prahlāda said: / Having heard that, the lord of the chiefs of gods, reflecting again and again, / spoke words there to the stainless Durvāsas.

15.19.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
parādhīno'smi viprendra bhaktyā krīto'smi nānyathā ..
balerādeśakārī ca daityendravaśago hyaham.. 2 ..
15.19.d:
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
पराधीनोऽस्मि विप्रेन्द्र भक्त्या क्रीतोऽस्मि नान्यथा ..
बलेरादेशकारी च दैत्येन्द्रवशगो ह्यहम्.. 2 ..
15.19.m: The Holy One said: / 'I am dependent on another, O best of brahmins; I have been bought by devotion and not otherwise. / And I am one who executes Bali's orders, truly subservient to the lord of the Daityas.

15.19.s:
tasmātprārthaya viprendra daityaṃ vairocaniṃ balim..
asyādeśātkariṣyāmi yadabhīṣṭaṃ tavādhunā .. 3 ..
15.19.d:
तस्मात्प्रार्थय विप्रेन्द्र दैत्यं वैरोचनिं बलिम्..
अस्यादेशात्करिष्यामि यदभीष्टं तवाधुना .. 3 ..
15.19.m: Therefore request, O best of brahmins, the Daitya Bali, son of Virocana. / By his command I will now accomplish whatever is desired by you.

15.19.s:
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ vipro baliṃ provāca satvaram ..
yajvanāṃ tvaṃ variṣṭhaśca dātṝṇāṃ tvaṃ mato'dhikaḥ .. 4 ..
15.19.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं विप्रो बलिं प्रोवाच सत्वरम् ..
यज्वनां त्वं वरिष्ठश्च दातॄणां त्वं मतोऽधिकः .. 4 ..
15.19.m: Hearing that speech, the brahmin spoke quickly to Bali: / 'You are the best among sacrificers, and you are considered preeminent among givers.

15.19.s:
pārāvāraḥ kṛpāyāśca dayāṃ kuru mamopari ..
preṣayasva mahābhāga devaṃ daityavinigrahe .. 5 ..
15.19.d:
पारावारः कृपायाश्च दयां कुरु ममोपरि ..
प्रेषयस्व महाभाग देवं दैत्यविनिग्रहे .. 5 ..
15.19.m: You are an ocean of compassion; take pity on me! / O noble one, send the Lord to restrain the Daityas,

15.19.s:
saṃpūrṇaniyamaḥ snātastvatprasādādbhavāmyaham..
tacchutvā vacanaṃ daityo nātihṛṣṭamanāstadā ..
durvāsasamuvācedaṃ naitadevaṃ bhaviṣyati .. 6 ..
15.19.d:
संपूर्णनियमः स्नातस्त्वत्प्रसादाद्भवाम्यहम्..
तच्छुत्वा वचनं दैत्यो नातिहृष्टमनास्तदा ..
दुर्वाससमुवाचेदं नैतदेवं भविष्यति .. 6 ..
15.19.m: so that, through your grace, I may have my vows fulfilled and my ritual ablution performed.' / Hearing that speech, the Daitya, his mind not at all pleased then, / said this to Durvāsas: 'This shall not be so!

15.19.s:
anyatprārthaya viprendra yatte manasi varttate ..
taddāsyāmi na sandeho yadyapi syātsudurlabham .. 7 ..
15.19.d:
अन्यत्प्रार्थय विप्रेन्द्र यत्ते मनसि वर्त्तते ..
तद्दास्यामि न सन्देहो यद्यपि स्यात्सुदुर्लभम् .. 7 ..
15.19.m: Request something else, O best of brahmins, whatever is in your mind. / I will grant that without doubt, even if it be extremely difficult to obtain.

15.19.s:
ātmānamapi dāsyāmi nāhaṃ tyakṣye hariṃ dvija ..
bahubhiḥ sukṛtaiḥ prāptaṃ kathaṃ tyakṣyāmi keśavam .. 8 ..
15.19.d:
आत्मानमपि दास्यामि नाहं त्यक्ष्ये हरिं द्विज ..
बहुभिः सुकृतैः प्राप्तं कथं त्यक्ष्यामि केशवम् .. 8 ..
15.19.m: I will give even myself, [but] I will not give up Hari, O twice-born! / How can I abandon Keśava, attained through many good deeds?'

15.19.s:
.. durvāsā uvāca .. ..
nātilubdhaṃ hi māṃ viddhi kimanyatprārthayāmyaham ..
rakṣa me jīvitaṃ daitya preṣayasva janārddanam .. 9 ..
15.19.d:
.. दुर्वासा उवाच .. ..
नातिलुब्धं हि मां विद्धि किमन्यत्प्रार्थयाम्यहम् ..
रक्ष मे जीवितं दैत्य प्रेषयस्व जनार्द्दनम् .. 9 ..
15.19.m: Durvāsas said: / 'Know that I am not overly greedy! What else should I request? / Protect my life, O Daitya; send Janārdana!'

15.19.s:
.. baliruvāca .. ..
jānāsi tvaṃ yathā vipra hiraṇyākṣaṃ nipātitam ..
bhūtvā yajñavarāhastu dadhārorvīṃ balāddivi .. 7.4.19.10 ..
15.19.d:
.. बलिरुवाच .. ..
जानासि त्वं यथा विप्र हिरण्याक्षं निपातितम् ..
भूत्वा यज्ञवराहस्तु दधारोर्वीं बलाद्दिवि .. 7.4.19.10 ..
15.19.m: Bali said: / 'You know, O brahmin, how Hiraṇyākṣa was struck down; / having become the sacrificial boar, [he] held the earth by force in heaven.

15.19.s:
yathā ca daityapravaramavadhyaṃ daityadānavaiḥ ..
hatavānhiraṇyakaśipuṃ nṛsiṃhaḥ sarvagaḥ prabhuḥ .. 11 ..
15.19.d:
यथा च दैत्यप्रवरमवध्यं दैत्यदानवैः ..
हतवान्हिरण्यकशिपुं नृसिंहः सर्वगः प्रभुः .. 11 ..
15.19.m: And how the all-pervading Lord Nṛsiṃha slew Hiraṇyakaśipu, / the foremost of the Daityas, who was incapable of being killed by Daityas and Dānavas.

15.19.s:
tathaiva vṛtraṃ namuciṃ rakṣo laṃkeśa saṃjñakam ..
jaghāna māyayā viṣṇuḥ surārthaṃ surasattamaḥ .. 12 ..
15.19.d:
तथैव वृत्रं नमुचिं रक्षो लंकेश संज्ञकम् ..
जघान मायया विष्णुः सुरार्थं सुरसत्तमः .. 12 ..
15.19.m: In the same way, Viṣṇu, the best of the gods, by means of illusion, for the sake of the gods, / slew Vṛtra, Namuci, and the rakṣas known as the Lord of Laṅkā.

15.19.s:
prathamaṃ vāmano bhūtvā hyayācata padatrayam ..
punastrivikramo bhūtvā bhuvanāni jahāra me .. 13 ..
15.19.d:
प्रथमं वामनो भूत्वा ह्ययाचत पदत्रयम् ..
पुनस्त्रिविक्रमो भूत्वा भुवनानि जहार मे .. 13 ..
15.19.m: First having become Vāmana, he indeed begged for three paces; / then having become Trivikrama, he took away my worlds.

15.19.s:
mayā puṇyavaśādviṣṇuryadi prāptaḥ kathañcana ..
nāhaṃ tyakṣye jagannāthaṃ māyāvāmanakaṃ prabhum .. 14 ..
15.19.d:
मया पुण्यवशाद्विष्णुर्यदि प्राप्तः कथञ्चन ..
नाहं त्यक्ष्ये जगन्नाथं मायावामनकं प्रभुम् .. 14 ..
15.19.m: If somehow by the power of merit Viṣṇu has been obtained by me, / I will not give up the Lord of the universe, the master who was the illusory Dwarf.'

15.19.s:
.. durvāsā uvāca .. ..
nāhaṃ bhokṣye vinā snānaṃ gomatyudadhisaṃgame ..
yadi na preṣyasi hariṃ tatastyakṣye kalevaram .. 15 ..
15.19.d:
.. दुर्वासा उवाच .. ..
नाहं भोक्ष्ये विना स्नानं गोमत्युदधिसंगमे ..
यदि न प्रेष्यसि हरिं ततस्त्यक्ष्ये कलेवरम् .. 15 ..
15.19.m: Durvāsas said: / 'I shall not eat without a ritual ablution at the confluence of the Gomatī and the ocean. / If you will not send Hari, then I will abandon my body.'

15.19.s:
.. baliruvāca .. ..
yadbhāvyaṃ tadbhavatu te yajjānāsi tathā kuru ..
brahmarudrendranamitaṃ nāhaṃ tyakṣye padadvayam .. 16 ..
15.19.d:
.. बलिरुवाच .. ..
यद्भाव्यं तद्भवतु ते यज्जानासि तथा कुरु ..
ब्रह्मरुद्रेन्द्रनमितं नाहं त्यक्ष्ये पदद्वयम् .. 16 ..
15.19.m: Bali said: / 'Whatever is to happen, let that happen to you; do as you know [best]. / I will not give up the two feet bowed to by Brahmā, Rudra, and Indra.'

15.19.s:
tadā vivadamānau tau dṛṣṭvā sa jagadīśvaraḥ ..
brahmaṇyadevaḥ kṛpayā brāhmaṇaṃ tamuvāca ha .. 17 ..
15.19.d:
तदा विवदमानौ तौ दृष्ट्वा स जगदीश्वरः ..
ब्रह्मण्यदेवः कृपया ब्राह्मणं तमुवाच ह .. 17 ..
15.19.m: Then, seeing those two disputing, the Lord of the universe, / the deity who is kindly disposed to brahmins, spoke to that brāhmaṇa out of compassion:

15.19.s:
svastho bhava dvijaśreṣṭha snāpayiṣye na saṃśayaḥ ..
hatvā daityagaṇānsarvāngomatyudadhisaṃgame .. 18 ..
15.19.d:
स्वस्थो भव द्विजश्रेष्ठ स्नापयिष्ये न संशयः ..
हत्वा दैत्यगणान्सर्वान्गोमत्युदधिसंगमे .. 18 ..
15.19.m: 'Be at ease, O best of the twice-born! I will certainly cause you to bathe, / having slain all the hosts of Daityas at the confluence of the Gomatī and the ocean.'

15.19.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. .. .
śrutvā bhagavato vākyaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ prati daityarāṭ ..
dṛḍhaṃ jagrāha caraṇau patitvā pādayostadā .. 19 ..
15.19.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. .. .
श्रुत्वा भगवतो वाक्यं ब्राह्मणं प्रति दैत्यराट् ..
दृढं जग्राह चरणौ पतित्वा पादयोस्तदा .. 19 ..
15.19.m: Prahlāda said: / Hearing the Lord's words to the brāhmaṇa, the king of the Daityas then / fell at [his] feet and seized both feet firmly.

15.19.s:
tataḥ samṛddhimagamatpādau dattvā baleḥ prabhuḥ ..
śaṃkhacakragadāpāṇirviṣṇurdurvāsasā'nvitaḥ .. 7.4.19.20 ..
15.19.d:
ततः समृद्धिमगमत्पादौ दत्त्वा बलेः प्रभुः ..
शंखचक्रगदापाणिर्विष्णुर्दुर्वाससाऽन्वितः .. 7.4.19.20 ..
15.19.m: Then, having given his feet to Bali, the Lord, holding a conch, discus, and mace in hand, / Viṣṇu, accompanied by Durvāsas, went to [his full] glory.

15.19.s:
prasthitau tau tadā dṛṣṭvā durvāsasajanārddanau ..
anantaḥ puruṣo 'gacchanmuśalī ca halāyudhaḥ .. 21 ..
15.19.d:
प्रस्थितौ तौ तदा दृष्ट्वा दुर्वाससजनार्द्दनौ ..
अनन्तः पुरुषो ऽगच्छन्मुशली च हलायुधः .. 21 ..
15.19.m: Seeing those two, Durvāsas and Janārdana, departed, / the primeval Person, Ananta, who carries a club and has a plow for a weapon, went [also].

15.19.s:
muśalī cāgrato'gacchattato viṣṇustrivikramaḥ ..
tayoranvagamadviprā durvāsā bhūtalādbahiḥ .. 22 ..
15.19.d:
मुशली चाग्रतोऽगच्छत्ततो विष्णुस्त्रिविक्रमः ..
तयोरन्वगमद्विप्रा दुर्वासा भूतलाद्बहिः .. 22 ..
15.19.m: The bearer of the club went ahead, and after him Viṣṇu Trivikrama; / behind them went Durvāsas out of the underworld, O brahmins.

15.19.s:
bhittvā rasātalaṃ sarve samuttasthustvarānvitāḥ ..
āvirbabhūvustatraiva gomatyudadhisaṃgame .. 23 ..
15.19.d:
भित्त्वा रसातलं सर्वे समुत्तस्थुस्त्वरान्विताः ..
आविर्बभूवुस्तत्रैव गोमत्युदधिसंगमे .. 23 ..
15.19.m: Breaking through Rasātala, they all rose up with haste, / and appeared right there at the confluence of the Gomatī and the ocean.

15.19.s:
sannaddhau dṛḍhadhanvānau saṃkarṣaṇajanārdanau ..
ūcatustau tadā vipraṃ kuru snānaṃ yadṛcchayā .. 24 ..
15.19.d:
सन्नद्धौ दृढधन्वानौ संकर्षणजनार्दनौ ..
ऊचतुस्तौ तदा विप्रं कुरु स्नानं यदृच्छया .. 24 ..
15.19.m: Equipped with armor and holding firm bows, Saṃkarṣaṇa and Janārdana / then said to the brahmin: 'Perform your ritual ablution at will.'

15.19.s:
tayostu vacanaṃ śrutvā snānaṃ cakre tvarānvitaḥ ..
snātvā cāvaśyakaṃ karma kartumārabhata dvijaḥ .. 25 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye cakratīrthe kṛṣṇabalarāmadurvāsasasamāgamapūrvakaṃ durvāsasaḥ snānādyāhnikavidhividhāna- varṇanaṃnāmaikonaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. .. 19 ..
15.19.d:
तयोस्तु वचनं श्रुत्वा स्नानं चक्रे त्वरान्वितः ..
स्नात्वा चावश्यकं कर्म कर्तुमारभत द्विजः .. 25 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे चतुर्थे द्वारकामाहात्म्ये चक्रतीर्थे कृष्णबलरामदुर्वासससमागमपूर्वकं दुर्वाससः स्नानाद्याह्निकविधिविधान- वर्णनंनामैकोनविंशतितमोऽध्यायः .. .. 19 ..
15.19.m:
Hearing their words, he performed his ritual ablution in haste; / and having bathed, the twice-born began to perform his obligatory rites.
Thus, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, in the collection of eighty-one thousand verses, in the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the fourth Dvārakāmāhātmya, the nineteenth chapter, entitled 'The Description of Durvāsas's Ritual Ablution and Daily Rites preceded by the Meeting of Kṛṣṇa, Balarāma, and Durvāsas at Cakratīrtha.'

15.20.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
brahmaghoṣadhvaniṃ śrutvā dānavo durmukhastadā ..
krodhasaṃraktanayano durvāsasamathābravīt .. 1 ..
15.20.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
ब्रह्मघोषध्वनिं श्रुत्वा दानवो दुर्मुखस्तदा ..
क्रोधसंरक्तनयनो दुर्वाससमथाब्रवीत् .. 1 ..
15.20.m: Prahlāda said: / Hearing the sound of the chanting of the Veda, the Dānava Durmukha then, / his eyes reddened with rage, spoke to Durvāsas:

15.20.s:
hanyamānastvamasmābhiryadi muktosi vai dvija ..
kasmātpunaḥ samāyāto maraṇāya ca duṣṭadhīḥ .. 2 ..
15.20.d:
हन्यमानस्त्वमस्माभिर्यदि मुक्तोसि वै द्विज ..
कस्मात्पुनः समायातो मरणाय च दुष्टधीः .. 2 ..
15.20.m: 'When you were being slain by us, if indeed you were released, O twice-born, / why, O evil-minded one, have you come here again to your death?'

15.20.s:
ityuktvā muṣṭinā hantuṃ prādravaddānavādhamaḥ ..
prāha pradhāvamānaṃ taṃ durvāsā munisattamaḥ .. 3 ..
15.20.d:
इत्युक्त्वा मुष्टिना हन्तुं प्राद्रवद्दानवाधमः ..
प्राह प्रधावमानं तं दुर्वासा मुनिसत्तमः .. 3 ..
15.20.m: Having spoken thus, the vile Dānava ran forward to strike him with his fist. / Durvāsas, the best of sages, said to him as he was rushing:

15.20.s:
sparśaṃ mā kuru pāpiṣṭha brāhmaṇaṃ māṃ kṛtāhnikam ..
taṃ dṛṣṭvā dānavaṃ viṣṇurbrāhmaṇaṃ hantumudyatam .. 13 ..
tasya kruddho jagannātho durvāsasaḥ kṛte tadā ..
cakreṇa kṣuradhāreṇa śiraściccheda līlayā .. 5 ..
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
durmukhaṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā dānavo duḥsahastadā ..
ākrośaduccairditijāñchīghramāgamyatāmiti ..6..
śrutvā daityagaṇāḥ sarve durmukhaṃ nihataṃ tadā ..
durvāsasaṃ punastatra paritrātaṃ ca viṣṇunā .. .. 7 ..
kūrmapṛṣṭho golakaśca krodhano vedadūṣakaḥ ..
yajñaghno yajñahaṃtā ca dharmāntakastapasvihā .. 8 ..
ete cānye ca bahavo vividhāyudhapāṇayaḥ .. ..
krodhasaṃraktanayanāḥ śapanto brāhmaṇaṃ tathā .. 9 ..
parikṣipya tadātreyaṃ viṣṇuṃ saṃkarṣaṇaṃ tathā ..
tomarairbhindipālaiśca muśalaiśca bhuśuṃḍibhiḥ .. 7.4.20.10 ..
15.20.d:
स्पर्शं मा कुरु पापिष्ठ ब्राह्मणं मां कृताह्निकम् ..
तं दृष्ट्वा दानवं विष्णुर्ब्राह्मणं हन्तुमुद्यतम् .. 13 ..
तस्य क्रुद्धो जगन्नाथो दुर्वाससः कृते तदा ..
चक्रेण क्षुरधारेण शिरश्चिच्छेद लीलया .. 5 ..
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
दुर्मुखं निहतं दृष्ट्वा दानवो दुःसहस्तदा ..
आक्रोशदुच्चैर्दितिजाञ्छीघ्रमागम्यतामिति ..6..
श्रुत्वा दैत्यगणाः सर्वे दुर्मुखं निहतं तदा ..
दुर्वाससं पुनस्तत्र परित्रातं च विष्णुना .. .. 7 ..
कूर्मपृष्ठो गोलकश्च क्रोधनो वेददूषकः ..
यज्ञघ्नो यज्ञहंता च धर्मान्तकस्तपस्विहा .. 8 ..
एते चान्ये च बहवो विविधायुधपाणयः .. ..
क्रोधसंरक्तनयनाः शपन्तो ब्राह्मणं तथा .. 9 ..
परिक्षिप्य तदात्रेयं विष्णुं संकर्षणं तथा ..
तोमरैर्भिन्दिपालैश्च मुशलैश्च भुशुंडिभिः .. 7.4.20.10 ..
15.20.m:
'Do not touch me, an evil-doer [like you]—I am a brāhmaṇa who has performed his daily rites!' / Seeing that Dānava intent on slaying the brāhmaṇa,
the Lord of the universe, enraged on behalf of Durvāsas, / effortlessly cut off his head with his razor-sharp discus.
Prahlāda said: / Seeing Durmukha slain, the Dānava Duḥsaha then / shouted loudly to the sons of Diti: 'Come quickly!'
All the hosts of Daityas, hearing that Durmukha was slain / and that Durvāsas had been protected there again by Viṣṇu,
[namely] Kūrmapṛṣṭha, Golaka, Krodhana, Vedadūṣaka, / Yajñaghna, Yajñahantṛ, Dharmāntaka, and Tapasvihā,
these and many others, with various weapons in their hands, / their eyes reddened with anger, cursing the brāhmaṇa,
then surrounded the son of Atri, as well as Viṣṇu and Saṃkarṣaṇa, / with javelins, barbed missiles, clubs, and iron maces.

15.20.s:
astrairnānāvidhaiścāpi yuyudhuḥ krodhamūrchitāḥ ..
dānavaiḥ saṃvṛto viṣṇuḥ samantādghoradarśanaiḥ .. 11 ..
saṃkarṣaṇaśca śuśubhe caṃdrādityau ghanairiva ..
gṛhītvā dhanuṣī divye śīghraṃ saṃyojya cāśugān .. 12 ..
tānmārgaṇagaṇairdaityāñjaghnatuste mahāmṛdhe ..
te hanyamānāḥ samare viṣṇunā vidrutā diśaḥ .. 13 ..
15.20.d:
अस्त्रैर्नानाविधैश्चापि युयुधुः क्रोधमूर्छिताः ..
दानवैः संवृतो विष्णुः समन्ताद्घोरदर्शनैः .. 11 ..
संकर्षणश्च शुशुभे चंद्रादित्यौ घनैरिव ..
गृहीत्वा धनुषी दिव्ये शीघ्रं संयोज्य चाशुगान् .. 12 ..
तान्मार्गणगणैर्दैत्याञ्जघ्नतुस्ते महामृधे ..
ते हन्यमानाः समरे विष्णुना विद्रुता दिशः .. 13 ..
15.20.m:
Overwhelmed with wrath, they fought with various kinds of missiles. / Viṣṇu, surrounded on all sides by Dānavas of terrifying appearance,
and Saṃkarṣaṇa shone like the moon and the sun surrounded by clouds. / Taking up their two divine bows and quickly joining swift arrows,
they struck those Daityas in the great battle with volleys of arrows. / Being struck in battle by Viṣṇu, they fled in all directions.

15.20.s:
dānavānvidrutāndṛṣṭvā viṣṇunā nihatānparān ..
golakaḥ kūrmapṛṣṭhaśca mānaṃ kṛtvā nyavartatām .. 14 ..
15.20.d:
दानवान्विद्रुतान्दृष्ट्वा विष्णुना निहतान्परान् ..
गोलकः कूर्मपृष्ठश्च मानं कृत्वा न्यवर्तताम् .. 14 ..
15.20.m: Seeing the Dānavas routed and the others slain by Viṣṇu, / Golaka and Kūrmapṛṣṭha, summoning their pride, turned back.

15.20.s:
saṃkarṣaṇaṃ golakaśca hyājaghāna tribhiḥ śaraiḥ ..
anantaṃ vyathitaṃ dṛṣṭvā golakaḥ krodhamūrchitaḥ ..15 ..
15.20.d:
संकर्षणं गोलकश्च ह्याजघान त्रिभिः शरैः ..
अनन्तं व्यथितं दृष्ट्वा गोलकः क्रोधमूर्छितः ..15 ..
15.20.m: Golaka struck Saṃkarṣaṇa with three arrows; / seeing Ananta tormented, Golaka, faint with anger,

15.20.s:
utpatya tarasā mūrdhni durvāsasamatāḍayat ..
sa muṣṭighātābhihataścukrośa patitaḥ kṣitau ..16..
15.20.d:
उत्पत्य तरसा मूर्ध्नि दुर्वाससमताडयत् ..
स मुष्टिघाताभिहतश्चुक्रोश पतितः क्षितौ ..16..
15.20.m: leapt forward swiftly and struck Durvāsas on the head. / Smitten by the blow of his fist, he cried out and fell to the ground.

15.20.s:
saṃkarṣaṇastu patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā mūrdhni pratāḍitam ..
dṛṣṭvā cukopa bhagavāṃstiṣṭhatiṣṭheti cābravīt ..
saṃgṛhya muśalaṃ vīro jaghāna samare ripum .. 17 ..
15.20.d:
संकर्षणस्तु पतितं दृष्ट्वा मूर्ध्नि प्रताडितम् ..
दृष्ट्वा चुकोप भगवांस्तिष्ठतिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत् ..
संगृह्य मुशलं वीरो जघान समरे रिपुम् .. 17 ..
15.20.m: Seeing Saṃkarṣaṇa fallen, struck on the head, / and seeing it, the Blessed One became enraged and said, "Stand! Stand!" / Grasping his club, the hero struck the enemy in battle.

15.20.s:
muśalenāhato mūrdhni golako vikalendriyaḥ ..
saṃbhinnamastakaścaiva papāta ca mamāra ca .. 18 ..
15.20.d:
मुशलेनाहतो मूर्ध्नि गोलको विकलेन्द्रियः ..
संभिन्नमस्तकश्चैव पपात च ममार च .. 18 ..
15.20.m: Struck on the head by the club, Golaka, his senses bewildered, / his skull completely shattered, fell down and died.

15.20.s:
golakaṃ patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā krandaṃtaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ tathā ..
kūrmapṛṣṭhaṃ ca bhagavānviṣṇurhantuṃ mano dadhe ..
nārācena sutīkṣṇena jaghāna hṛdaye ripum .. 19 ..
15.20.d:
गोलकं पतितं दृष्ट्वा क्रन्दंतं ब्राह्मणं तथा ..
कूर्मपृष्ठं च भगवान्विष्णुर्हन्तुं मनो दधे ..
नाराचेन सुतीक्ष्णेन जघान हृदये रिपुम् .. 19 ..
15.20.m: Seeing Golaka fallen, and the brahmin crying out, / the Blessed Lord Viṣṇu set his mind on slaying Kūrmapṛṣṭha. / With a very sharp iron arrow, he struck the enemy in the heart.

15.20.s:
sa viṣṇubāṇābhihatastyaktaśastraḥ palāyitaḥ ..
tasminprabhinne'tibale gate vai kūrmapṛṣṭhake ..
abhajyata balaṃ sarvaṃ vidrutaṃ ca diśo daśa .. 7.4.20.20 ..
15.20.d:
स विष्णुबाणाभिहतस्त्यक्तशस्त्रः पलायितः ..
तस्मिन्प्रभिन्नेऽतिबले गते वै कूर्मपृष्ठके ..
अभज्यत बलं सर्वं विद्रुतं च दिशो दश .. 7.4.20.20 ..
15.20.m: Struck by Viṣṇu's arrow, abandoning his weapon, he fled. / When that very mighty Kūrmapṛṣṭhaka was routed and gone, / the entire army was broken and fled in the ten directions.

15.20.s:
tatprabhagraṃ balaṃ sarvaṃ nihataṃ golakaṃ tathā ..
dvārasthaḥ kathayāmāsa daityarājñe kuśāya saḥ .. 21 ..
15.20.d:
तत्प्रभग्रं बलं सर्वं निहतं गोलकं तथा ..
द्वारस्थः कथयामास दैत्यराज्ञे कुशाय सः .. 21 ..
15.20.m: That entire broken army, and also that Golaka was slain, / the door-keeper reported to the Daitya king, Kuśa.

15.20.s:
golakaṃ nihataṃ śrutvā daityānanyāṃśca daityarāṭ ..
yodhānājñāpayāmāsa sannaddhānsvabalasya ca .. 22 ..
15.20.d:
गोलकं निहतं श्रुत्वा दैत्यानन्यांश्च दैत्यराट् ..
योधानाज्ञापयामास सन्नद्धान्स्वबलस्य च .. 22 ..
15.20.m: Hearing that Golaka and other Daityas were slain, the Daitya king / ordered the warriors of his army to be clad in armor.

15.20.s:
ājñāṃ kuśasya te labdhvā daityāḥ paṃcajanādayaḥ ..
yuddhāyābhimukhāḥ sarve rathairnāgaiśca niryayuḥ .. 23 ..
15.20.d:
आज्ञां कुशस्य ते लब्ध्वा दैत्याः पंचजनादयः ..
युद्धायाभिमुखाः सर्वे रथैर्नागैश्च निर्ययुः .. 23 ..
15.20.m: Having received the command of Kuśa, the Daityas led by Pañcajana, / all facing toward the battle, set forth on chariots and elephants.

15.20.s:
anīkaṃ daśasāhasraṃ kūrmapṛṣṭhasya niryayau ..
ayute dve rathānāṃ tu nāgānāmayutaṃ tathā .. 24 ..
15.20.d:
अनीकं दशसाहस्रं कूर्मपृष्ठस्य निर्ययौ ..
अयुते द्वे रथानां तु नागानामयुतं तथा .. 24 ..
15.20.m: An army of ten thousand belonging to Kūrmapṛṣṭha set out, / with twenty thousand chariots and ten thousand elephants,

15.20.s:
daśāyutāni cāśvānāmuṣṭrāṇāṃ ca tathaiva ca ..
bakaśca niryayau daityo bahusainyasamanvitaḥ .. 25 ..
15.20.d:
दशायुतानि चाश्वानामुष्ट्राणां च तथैव च ..
बकश्च निर्ययौ दैत्यो बहुसैन्यसमन्वितः .. 25 ..
15.20.m: and one hundred thousand horses, as well as camels. / And the Daitya Baka set out, accompanied by a large army.

15.20.s:
tathā dīrghanakho daityaḥ svenānīkena saṃvṛtaḥ ..
maṃtriputro mahāmāyo daityarāja kuśasya vai ..
niryayau vighaso daityaḥ praghasaśca mahābalaḥ .. 26 ..
15.20.d:
तथा दीर्घनखो दैत्यः स्वेनानीकेन संवृतः ..
मंत्रिपुत्रो महामायो दैत्यराज कुशस्य वै ..
निर्ययौ विघसो दैत्यः प्रघसश्च महाबलः .. 26 ..
15.20.m: Likewise, the Daitya Dīrghanakha set out, surrounded by his own army; / and the chief minister's son, full of great illusion, of the Daitya king Kuśa— / the Daitya Vighasa set out, and the very mighty Praghasa.

15.20.s:
ūrddhvabāhurvakraśirāḥ kañcukaśca śivolukaiḥ ..
brahmaghno yajñahā daityo rāhurbarbarakastathā .. 27 ..
15.20.d:
ऊर्द्ध्वबाहुर्वक्रशिराः कञ्चुकश्च शिवोलुकैः ..
ब्रह्मघ्नो यज्ञहा दैत्यो राहुर्बर्बरकस्तथा .. 27 ..
15.20.m: Ūrdhvabāhu, Vakraśiras, Kañcuka with Śivolukas, / the slayer of brahmins Brahmaghna, the destroyer of sacrifices Yajñahā, Rāhu, and Barbaraka;

15.20.s:
sunāmā vasunāmā ca maṃtriṇau buddhisattamau ..
senāpatiścogradaṃṣṭastasya bhrātā mahāhanuḥ .. 28 ..
15.20.d:
सुनामा वसुनामा च मंत्रिणौ बुद्धिसत्तमौ ..
सेनापतिश्चोग्रदंष्टस्तस्य भ्राता महाहनुः .. 28 ..
15.20.m: Sunāman and Vasunāman, the two ministers of excellent intellect; / and the commander Ugradaṃṣṭra, and his brother Mahāhanu.

15.20.s:
ete cānye ca bahavo daityāḥ krodhasamanvitāḥ ..
mahatā rathaghoṣeṇa niryayuryuddhakāṃkṣiṇaḥ .. 29 ..
15.20.d:
एते चान्ये च बहवो दैत्याः क्रोधसमन्विताः ..
महता रथघोषेण निर्ययुर्युद्धकांक्षिणः .. 29 ..
15.20.m: These and many other Daityas, filled with wrath, / with a great roar of chariots, marched forth eager for battle.

15.20.s:
snātvā śuklāṃbaradharaḥ śuklamālāvibhūṣitaḥ ..
kuśaḥ śaṃbhuṃ mahādevaṃ bhavānīpatimavyayam ..
ārcayamāsa bhūteśaṃ parameṇa samādhinā .. 7.4.20.30 ..
15.20.d:
स्नात्वा शुक्लांबरधरः शुक्लमालाविभूषितः ..
कुशः शंभुं महादेवं भवानीपतिमव्ययम् ..
आर्चयमास भूतेशं परमेण समाधिना .. 7.4.20.30 ..
15.20.m: Having bathed, wearing white garments, adorned with white garlands, / Kuśa worshiped Śambhu, Mahādeva, the imperishable Lord of Bhavānī, / the Lord of beings, with supreme concentration.

15.20.s:
paṃcāmṛtena saṃsnāpya tathā gandhairvi lipya ca ..
arcayāmāsa daityendro hyanekakusumotkaraiḥ .. 31 ..
15.20.d:
पंचामृतेन संस्नाप्य तथा गन्धैर्वि लिप्य च ..
अर्चयामास दैत्येन्द्रो ह्यनेककुसुमोत्करैः .. 31 ..
15.20.m: Having bathed him with the five nectars and smeared him with fragrant perfumes, / the lord of Daityas worshiped him with heaps of manifold flowers.

15.20.s:
gītavāditraśabdaiśca tathā maṃgalavācakaiḥ ..
pūjayitvā mahādevaṃ brāhmaṇānsvasti vācya ca .. 32 ..
15.20.d:
गीतवादित्रशब्दैश्च तथा मंगलवाचकैः ..
पूजयित्वा महादेवं ब्राह्मणान्स्वस्ति वाच्य च .. 32 ..
15.20.m: With the sounds of singing and musical instruments, and with recitations of auspicious blessings, / having worshiped Mahādeva, and having had brahmins pronounce auspiciousness,

15.20.s:
bhūṣayitvā bhūṣaṇaiśca maṇivajravibhūṣaṇaiḥ ..
mukuṭenārkavarṇena jvaladbhāskararociṣā .. 33 ..
15.20.d:
भूषयित्वा भूषणैश्च मणिवज्रविभूषणैः ..
मुकुटेनार्कवर्णेन ज्वलद्भास्कररोचिषा .. 33 ..
