15.20.m: adorned with ornaments, with gems and diamonds, / with a diadem of solar brilliance shining like the blazing sun,

15.20.s:
bhrājamāno daityarājo hāreṇā'tīva śobhitaḥ ..
saṃnahya ca mahābāhuḥ sārathiṃ samudaikṣata .. 34 ..
15.20.d:
भ्राजमानो दैत्यराजो हारेणाऽतीव शोभितः ..
संनह्य च महाबाहुः सारथिं समुदैक्षत .. 34 ..
15.20.m: the radiant Daitya king, exceptionally splendid with his necklace, / clad in armor, the mighty-armed one looked towards his charioteer.

15.20.s:
sunāmānaṃ vasuṃ caiva maṃtriṇau vākyamabravīt ..
kaścāyamasurānhaṃti kimarthaṃ jñāyatāmiti .. .. 35 ..
15.20.d:
सुनामानं वसुं चैव मंत्रिणौ वाक्यमब्रवीत् ..
कश्चायमसुरान्हंति किमर्थं ज्ञायतामिति .. .. 35 ..
15.20.m: He spoke these words to the two ministers, Sunāman and Vasu: / "Who is this who slays the asuras, and for what purpose? Let it be known!"

15.20.s:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā rururvacanamabravīt ..
gatehni brāhmaṇaḥ snātuṃ gomatyāḥ saṃgame kila .. 36 ..
15.20.d:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा रुरुर्वचनमब्रवीत् ..
गतेह्नि ब्राह्मणः स्नातुं गोमत्याः संगमे किल .. 36 ..
15.20.m: Hearing those words of his, Ruru spoke these words: / "On the day gone by, a brahmin [came] to bathe at the confluence of the Gomatī, it is said.

15.20.s:
āgataḥ pratiṣiddhaḥ sandaityaistatra mahī pate ..
tena viṣṇuḥ samānītaḥ saṃkarṣaṇasamanvitaḥ .. 37 ..
15.20.d:
आगतः प्रतिषिद्धः सन्दैत्यैस्तत्र मही पते ..
तेन विष्णुः समानीतः संकर्षणसमन्वितः .. 37 ..
15.20.m: When he arrived, he was prevented there by the Daityas, O lord of the earth! / By him Viṣṇu was brought, accompanied by Saṃkarṣaṇa.

15.20.s:
so'smānhaṃti mahārāja brahmaṇyo jagadīśvaraḥ ..
tena te bahavo daityā hatāḥ kecitpalāyitāḥ .. 38 ..
15.20.d:
सोऽस्मान्हंति महाराज ब्रह्मण्यो जगदीश्वरः ..
तेन ते बहवो दैत्या हताः केचित्पलायिताः .. 38 ..
15.20.m: He is slaying us, O great king, devoted to brahmins, the Lord of the universe. / By him many of your Daityas have been slain, and some have fled."

15.20.s:
.. sunāmovāca .. ..
snātvā gacchatu vipro'sau vāsudevasamanvitaḥ ..
rājanvṛthā vigraheṇa kiṃ kāryaṃ kathayasva naḥ .. 39 ..
15.20.d:
.. सुनामोवाच .. ..
स्नात्वा गच्छतु विप्रोऽसौ वासुदेवसमन्वितः ..
राजन्वृथा विग्रहेण किं कार्यं कथयस्व नः .. 39 ..
15.20.m: Sunāman said: / "Having bathed, let this vipra go, accompanied by Vāsudeva. / O King, what is to be gained by a useless conflict? Tell us!"

15.20.s:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā kuśaḥ krodhasamanvitaḥ ..
kathaṃ golakahaṃtāraṃ na haniṣyāmi keśavam ..7.4.20.40..
15.20.d:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा कुशः क्रोधसमन्वितः ..
कथं गोलकहंतारं न हनिष्यामि केशवम् ..7.4.20.40..
15.20.m: Hearing that speech of his, Kuśa, filled with wrath, [said]: / "How shall I not slay Keśava, the slayer of Golaka?"

15.20.s:
etāvaduktvā sa kruddho yayau daityapatistadā ..
tato vāditra śabdaiśca bherīśabdaiḥ samanvitaḥ .. 41 ..
15.20.d:
एतावदुक्त्वा स क्रुद्धो ययौ दैत्यपतिस्तदा ..
ततो वादित्र शब्दैश्च भेरीशब्दैः समन्वितः .. 41 ..
15.20.m: Having said this much, the enraged lord of Daityas then went forth, / accompanied by the sounds of musical instruments and kettle-drums.

15.20.s:
dadarśa tatra deveśaṃ sahasraśirasaṃ prabhum ..
tathā viṣṇuṃ cakrapāṇiṃ durvāsasamakalmaṣam .. 42 ..
15.20.d:
ददर्श तत्र देवेशं सहस्रशिरसं प्रभुम् ..
तथा विष्णुं चक्रपाणिं दुर्वाससमकल्मषम् .. 42 ..
15.20.m: He saw there the Lord of the gods, the thousand-headed Lord, / and also Viṣṇu with the discus in his hand, and the sinless Durvāsas.

15.20.s:
īśvarāṃśaṃ ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā na hantavyo'yamīśvaraḥ ..
viṣṇumuddiśya tānsarvānprerayāmāsa dānavān .. 43 ..
15.20.d:
ईश्वरांशं च तं दृष्ट्वा न हन्तव्योऽयमीश्वरः ..
विष्णुमुद्दिश्य तान्सर्वान्प्रेरयामास दानवान् .. 43 ..
15.20.m: Seeing that he is a portion of Īśvara, [he thought], "This lord must not be slain." / He directed all those Dānavas towards Viṣṇu.

15.20.s:
nāgaiḥ parvatasaṃkāśai rathairjaladasannibhaiḥ ..
aśvairmahājavaiścaiva parivavruḥ samaṃtataḥ .. 44 ..
15.20.d:
नागैः पर्वतसंकाशै रथैर्जलदसन्निभैः ..
अश्वैर्महाजवैश्चैव परिवव्रुः समंततः .. 44 ..
15.20.m: With elephants resembling mountains, with chariots resembling clouds, / and with horses of great speed, they surrounded [him] on all sides.

15.20.s:
tato yuddhaṃ samabhavaddevayordānavaiḥ saha ..
ācchāditau tau dadṛśurdaityairdevagaṇāstadā .. 45 ..
15.20.d:
ततो युद्धं समभवद्देवयोर्दानवैः सह ..
आच्छादितौ तौ ददृशुर्दैत्यैर्देवगणास्तदा .. 45 ..
15.20.m: Then a battle took place between the two gods and the Dānavas. / The hosts of gods then saw the two enveloped by the Daityas.

15.20.s:
tato gṛhītvā muśalaṃ halaṃ ca balavānhalī ..
jaghāna daityapravarānkālānalayamopamān .. 46 ..
15.20.d:
ततो गृहीत्वा मुशलं हलं च बलवान्हली ..
जघान दैत्यप्रवरान्कालानलयमोपमान् .. 46 ..
15.20.m: Then, seizing his club and plow, the mighty plow-wielder [Balarāma] / struck the foremost Daityas, who were like the fire of destruction and Yama.

15.20.s:
te hanyamānā daiteyā balena balaśālinā ..
sarvato vidrutā bhagnāḥ kuśameva yayustadā .. 47 ..
15.20.d:
ते हन्यमाना दैतेया बलेन बलशालिना ..
सर्वतो विद्रुता भग्नाः कुशमेव ययुस्तदा .. 47 ..
15.20.m: Those Daityas, being struck down by Bala full of might, / broken and fleeing everywhere, then went to Kuśa alone.

15.20.s:
bakaśca yajñakopaśca brahmaghno vedadūṣakaḥ ..
mahāmakhaghno jaṃbhaśca rāhurvakraśirāstathā ..48..
15.20.d:
बकश्च यज्ञकोपश्च ब्रह्मघ्नो वेददूषकः ..
महामखघ्नो जंभश्च राहुर्वक्रशिरास्तथा ..48..
15.20.m: Baka, Yajñakopa, Brahmaghna, the defiler of the Vedas, / the destroyer of great sacrifices, Jambha, Rāhu, and Vakraśiras—

15.20.s:
ete cānye ca bahavaḥ pravarā dānavottamāḥ ..
krodhasaṃraktanayanā bibhiduste janārddanam .. 49 ..
15.20.d:
एते चान्ये च बहवः प्रवरा दानवोत्तमाः ..
क्रोधसंरक्तनयना बिभिदुस्ते जनार्द्दनम् .. 49 ..
15.20.m: these and many other foremost of the best Dānavas, / with eyes blood-red with anger, pierced Janārdana.

15.20.s:
tataḥ krodhasamāyuktau saṃkarṣaṇajanārdanau ..
cakralāṃgalaghātena jaghnaturdānavottamān .. 7.4.20.50 .. .
15.20.d:
ततः क्रोधसमायुक्तौ संकर्षणजनार्दनौ ..
चक्रलांगलघातेन जघ्नतुर्दानवोत्तमान् .. 7.4.20.50 .. .
15.20.m: Then, filled with wrath, Saṃkarṣaṇa and Janārdana / struck the best of the Dānavas with blows of the discus and plow.

15.20.s:
cakreṇa ca śiraḥ kāyāccicchedāśu bakasya vai ..
cūrṇayāmāsa muśalī yajñahaṃtārameva ca .. 51 ..
15.20.d:
चक्रेण च शिरः कायाच्चिच्छेदाशु बकस्य वै ..
चूर्णयामास मुशली यज्ञहंतारमेव च .. 51 ..
15.20.m: With the discus, he quickly severed Baka's head from his body, / and the wielder of the club crushed the destroyer of sacrifices.

15.20.s:
rāhuṃ jaghāna cakreṇa tathānyānmuśalena ca ..
te hatā hanyamānāśca bhagnā jagmurdiśo daśa ..52..
15.20.d:
राहुं जघान चक्रेण तथान्यान्मुशलेन च ..
ते हता हन्यमानाश्च भग्ना जग्मुर्दिशो दश ..52..
15.20.m: He struck Rāhu with the discus, and others with the club. / Slain and being slain, they broke and fled in the ten directions.

15.20.s:
kuśaḥ svāṃ vāhinīṃ dṛṣṭvā vidrutāṃ nihatāṃ tathā ..
krodhasaṃraktanayanaḥ prāha yāhīti sārathim ..53..
15.20.d:
कुशः स्वां वाहिनीं दृष्ट्वा विद्रुतां निहतां तथा ..
क्रोधसंरक्तनयनः प्राह याहीति सारथिम् ..53..
15.20.m: Kuśa, seeing his own army routed and slain, / his eyes blood-red with rage, said to his charioteer, "Go!"

15.20.s:
sa tayoraṃtikaṃ gatvā nāma viśrāvya cātmanaḥ ..
uvāca kastvaṃ daiteyānmama haṃsi gadādhara .. 54 ..
15.20.d:
स तयोरंतिकं गत्वा नाम विश्राव्य चात्मनः ..
उवाच कस्त्वं दैतेयान्मम हंसि गदाधर .. 54 ..
15.20.m: Approaching the two and proclaiming his own name, / he said, "Who are you, wielder of the mace, that you slay my Daityas?"

15.20.s:
.. śrīvāsudeva uvāca .. ..
yasmādvimuktidaṃ puṇyaṃ gomatyudadhisaṃgamam ..
ruddhaṃ durātmabhiḥ pāpaistasmātte nihatā mayā .. 55 ..
15.20.d:
.. श्रीवासुदेव उवाच .. ..
यस्माद्विमुक्तिदं पुण्यं गोमत्युदधिसंगमम् ..
रुद्धं दुरात्मभिः पापैस्तस्मात्ते निहता मया .. 55 ..
15.20.m: The Blessed Vāsudeva said: / "Because the sacred confluence of the Gomatī and the ocean, which grants liberation, / was blocked by wicked, sinful ones, therefore they have been slain by me."

15.20.s:
.. kuśa uvāca .. ..
māṃ na jānāsi cātrasthaṃ kathaṃ jīvanprayāsyasi ..
yudhyasva tvaṃ sthiro bhūtvā tatastyakṣyasi jīvitam .. 56 ..
15.20.d:
.. कुश उवाच .. ..
मां न जानासि चात्रस्थं कथं जीवन्प्रयास्यसि ..
युध्यस्व त्वं स्थिरो भूत्वा ततस्त्यक्ष्यसि जीवितम् .. 56 ..
15.20.m: Kuśa said: / "Do you not know me standing here? How will you depart alive? / Fight, standing firm, and then you will surrender your life!"

15.20.s:
ityuktvā paṃcaviṃśatyā tāḍayāmāsa keśavam ..
anaṃtaṃ cāṣṭabhirbāṇairhatvā''treyaṃ nirīkṣya tam ..
īśvarāṃśaṃ ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā prāha yāhīti mā ciram .. 57 ..
15.20.d:
इत्युक्त्वा पंचविंशत्या ताडयामास केशवम् ..
अनंतं चाष्टभिर्बाणैर्हत्वा'ऽत्रेयं निरीक्ष्य तम् ..
ईश्वरांशं च तं दृष्ट्वा प्राह याहीति मा चिरम् .. 57 ..
15.20.m: Having said this, he struck Keśava with twenty-five [arrows], / and Ananta with eight arrows. Having struck, and beholding that son of Atri, / and seeing him as a portion of Īśvara, he said, "Go, do not delay!"

15.20.s:
sa bāṇairbhinnasarvāṃgaḥ śārṅgaṃ hi dhanuṣāṃ varam ..
vikṛṣya ghātayāmāsa caturbhiścaturo hayān .. 58 ..
15.20.d:
स बाणैर्भिन्नसर्वांगः शार्ङ्गं हि धनुषां वरम् ..
विकृष्य घातयामास चतुर्भिश्चतुरो हयान् .. 58 ..
15.20.m: His entire body pierced with arrows, drawing Śārṅga, the best of bows, / with four [arrows] he struck down the four horses.

15.20.s:
sārathestu śiraḥ kāyādarddhacaṃdreṇa pattriṇā ..
ciccheda dhanurekena dhvajamekena cicchide .. 59 ..
15.20.d:
सारथेस्तु शिरः कायादर्द्धचंद्रेण पत्त्रिणा ..
चिच्छेद धनुरेकेन ध्वजमेकेन चिच्छिदे .. 59 ..
15.20.m: With a crescent-shaped arrow he severed the charioteer's head from his body; / with one he broke his bow, and with one he shattered his banner.

15.20.s:
sa cchinnadhanvā viratho hatāśvo hatasārathiḥ ..
pragṛhya ca mahākhaṅgamuvāca vacanaṃ tadā .. 7.4.20.60 ..
15.20.d:
स च्छिन्नधन्वा विरथो हताश्वो हतसारथिः ..
प्रगृह्य च महाखङ्गमुवाच वचनं तदा .. 7.4.20.60 ..
15.20.m: His bow broken, his chariot destroyed, his horses killed, his charioteer slain, / seizing a great sword, he then spoke these words:

15.20.s:
yadi tvāṃ pātayiṣyāmi kīrtirme hyatulā bhavet ..
pātito'haṃ tvayā vīra yāsyāmi paramāṃ gatim .. 61 ..
15.20.d:
यदि त्वां पातयिष्यामि कीर्तिर्मे ह्यतुला भवेत् ..
पातितोऽहं त्वया वीर यास्यामि परमां गतिम् .. 61 ..
15.20.m: "If I bring you down, my fame will indeed be peerless; / struck down by you, O hero, I shall attain the supreme state.

15.20.s:
tiṣṭhatiṣṭha hare sthāne śaraṇaṃ me sadāśivaḥ ..
dhāvaṃtamatisaṃkruddhaṃ khaṅgahastaṃ nirīkṣya tam ..
cakreṇa śitadhāreṇa śiraściccheda līlayā .. 62 ..
15.20.d:
तिष्ठतिष्ठ हरे स्थाने शरणं मे सदाशिवः ..
धावंतमतिसंक्रुद्धं खङ्गहस्तं निरीक्ष्य तम् ..
चक्रेण शितधारेण शिरश्चिच्छेद लीलया .. 62 ..
15.20.m: Stand! Stand, O Hari, in this place! Sadāśiva is my refuge!" / Seeing him rushing forward, sword in hand and enraged, / with his sharp-edged discus he playfully cut off his head.

15.20.s:
taṃ chinnaśirasaṃ bhūmau patitaṃ vīkṣya dānavam ..
athovāha rathenājau daityaḥ khaṃjanakastathā .. 63 ..
15.20.d:
तं छिन्नशिरसं भूमौ पतितं वीक्ष्य दानवम् ..
अथोवाह रथेनाजौ दैत्यः खंजनकस्तथा .. 63 ..
15.20.m: Seeing that Dānava with his head cut off fallen upon the ground, / the Daitya Khañjanaka then bore him away on his chariot in the battle.

15.20.s:
apayāte kuśe daitye viṣṇuḥ saṃkarṣaṇastadā ..
durvāsasā ca sahitaḥ saṃnyavartata harṣitaḥ .. 64 ..
15.20.d:
अपयाते कुशे दैत्ये विष्णुः संकर्षणस्तदा ..
दुर्वाससा च सहितः संन्यवर्तत हर्षितः .. 64 ..
15.20.m: When the Daitya Kuśa had been carried off, Viṣṇu, together with Saṃkarṣaṇa / and Durvāsas, then returned delighted.

15.20.s:
śivālaye tu patitaṃ kuśaṃ nikṣipya dānavaḥ ..
snānagandhārcanairdhūpairgītavādyairatoṣayat .. 65 ..
15.20.d:
शिवालये तु पतितं कुशं निक्षिप्य दानवः ..
स्नानगन्धार्चनैर्धूपैर्गीतवाद्यैरतोषयत् .. 65 ..
15.20.m: The Dānava placed the fallen Kuśa in the temple of Śiva, / and propitiated [Śiva] with ritual ablutions, fragrant offerings, worship, incense, and vocal and instrumental music.

15.20.s:
avāpa jīvitaṃ sadyaḥ prasādācchaṃkarasya ca ..
utthitaḥ sa tadā daityo bruvañchivaśiveti ca .. 66 ..
15.20.d:
अवाप जीवितं सद्यः प्रसादाच्छंकरस्य च ..
उत्थितः स तदा दैत्यो ब्रुवञ्छिवशिवेति च .. 66 ..
15.20.m: At once he regained life through the grace of Śaṃkara; / the Daitya then arose, saying, "Śiva, Śiva!"

15.20.s:
taṃ punarjovitaṃ dṛṣṭvā daityaṃ daityagaṇastadā ..
uvāca sumanā vākyaṃ varddhasva suciraṃ vibho ..67..
15.20.d:
तं पुनर्जोवितं दृष्ट्वा दैत्यं दैत्यगणस्तदा ..
उवाच सुमना वाक्यं वर्द्धस्व सुचिरं विभो ..67..
15.20.m: Seeing that Daitya alive once more, the host of Daityas, / [and especially] Sumanas, spoke these words: "Flourish for a very long time, O lord!

15.20.s:
snāpayitvā yadi punarbrāhmaṇaṃ vinivarttate ..
yatheṣṭaṃ gacchatu tadā kiṃ vṛthā vigraheṇa te .. 68 ..
15.20.d:
स्नापयित्वा यदि पुनर्ब्राह्मणं विनिवर्त्तते ..
यथेष्टं गच्छतु तदा किं वृथा विग्रहेण ते .. 68 ..
15.20.m: If he returns after having given the bath to the brahmin, / let him go as he pleases; what use is your pointless conflict?"

15.20.s:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā kuśo vacanamabravīt ..
gaccha preṣaya tau śīghraṃ vipratrāṇakarāvubhau .. 69 ..
15.20.d:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा कुशो वचनमब्रवीत् ..
गच्छ प्रेषय तौ शीघ्रं विप्रत्राणकरावुभौ .. 69 ..
15.20.m: Hearing his words, Kuśa spoke this speech: / "Go, quickly send those two who protect the brahmin."

15.20.s:
sa ca rājñā samādiṣṭa sumanā munisattamāḥ ..
uvāca viṣṇumānamya namaskṛtya halāyudham .. 7.4.20.70 ..
15.20.d:
स च राज्ञा समादिष्ट सुमना मुनिसत्तमाः ..
उवाच विष्णुमानम्य नमस्कृत्य हलायुधम् .. 7.4.20.70 ..
15.20.m: Commanded by the king, O best of sages, Sumanas / bowed to Viṣṇu, offered obeisance to the plow-wielding [Balarāma], and said:

15.20.s:
kuśena preṣitaścāsmi samīpe te janārdana ..
kiṃ tavāpakṛtaṃ nātha yena daityāñjighāṃsasi.. 71..
15.20.d:
कुशेन प्रेषितश्चास्मि समीपे ते जनार्दन ..
किं तवापकृतं नाथ येन दैत्याञ्जिघांससि.. 71..
15.20.m: "I have been sent into your presence by Kuśa, O Janārdana. / What wrong has been done to you, O lord, that you wish to slay the Daityas?

15.20.s:
durvāsasaṃ snāpayitvā gaccha mukto'si mānada ..
amaratvaṃ mahādevātprāptaṃ viddhi kuśena hi .. 72 .. ..
15.20.d:
दुर्वाससं स्नापयित्वा गच्छ मुक्तोऽसि मानद ..
अमरत्वं महादेवात्प्राप्तं विद्धि कुशेन हि .. 72 .. ..
15.20.m: Having bathed Durvāsas, depart; you are released, O giver of honor! / Know that immortality has indeed been obtained by Kuśa from Mahādeva."

15.20.s:
.. śrīviṣṇuruvāca .. ..
muktitīrthamidaṃ ruddhaṃ bhavadbhiḥ pāpakarmabhiḥ ..
tasmāddhaniṣye sarvāṃśca dānavānnātra saṃśayaḥ ..73..
15.20.d:
.. श्रीविष्णुरुवाच .. ..
मुक्तितीर्थमिदं रुद्धं भवद्भिः पापकर्मभिः ..
तस्माद्धनिष्ये सर्वांश्च दानवान्नात्र संशयः ..73..
15.20.m: Lord Viṣṇu said: / "This sacred ford of liberation has been blocked by you evil-doers; / therefore I will slay all the Dānavas; of this there is no doubt.

15.20.s:
durvāsasaśca ye darbhāstilāścaivākṣataiḥ saha ..
punastānānayadhvaṃ hi kṣiptā ye varuṇālaye .. 74 ..
15.20.d:
दुर्वाससश्च ये दर्भास्तिलाश्चैवाक्षतैः सह ..
पुनस्तानानयध्वं हि क्षिप्ता ये वरुणालये .. 74 ..
15.20.m: Durvāsas's darbha-grasses, sesamum seeds, and unbroken grains— / bring them back at once, which were thrown into the abode of Varuṇa!

15.20.s:
savāhanaparīvārāḥ sajātikulabāṃdhavāḥ ..
puṇyatīrthamidaṃ hitvā praviśadhvaṃ dharātale .. 75 ..
15.20.d:
सवाहनपरीवाराः सजातिकुलबांधवाः ..
पुण्यतीर्थमिदं हित्वा प्रविशध्वं धरातले .. 75 ..
15.20.m: With your mounts and retinues, with your kinsmen and family, / leave this holy sacred ford and enter beneath the surface of the earth!"

15.20.s:
sumanāstadvacaḥ śrutvā krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ ..
yudhyadhvamiti taṃ coktvā naitadevaṃ bhaviṣyati .. 76 ..
15.20.d:
सुमनास्तद्वचः श्रुत्वा क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः ..
युध्यध्वमिति तं चोक्त्वा नैतदेवं भविष्यति .. 76 ..
15.20.m: Hearing his words, his eyes reddened with rage, / Sumanas said to him, "Fight! This shall not be so!"

15.20.s:
kuśāya kathayāmāsa yaduktaṃ śārṅgadhanvinā ..
kruddhastadvacanaṃ śrutvā maṃtriṇā samudīritam .. 77 ..
15.20.d:
कुशाय कथयामास यदुक्तं शार्ङ्गधन्विना ..
क्रुद्धस्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा मंत्रिणा समुदीरितम् .. 77 ..
15.20.m: He reported to Kuśa what was spoken by the wielder of the Śārṅga bow. / Hearing the words uttered by his minister, enraged,

15.20.s:
rathamāruhya vegena yayau yoddhumariṃdamaḥ ..
saṃsmṛtya manasā devaṃ pinākiṃ vṛṣabhadhvajam .. 78 ..
15.20.d:
रथमारुह्य वेगेन ययौ योद्धुमरिंदमः ..
संस्मृत्य मनसा देवं पिनाकिं वृषभध्वजम् .. 78 ..
15.20.m: mounting his chariot swiftly, the subduer of foes went to fight, / remembering in his mind the bow-wielding god who bears the bull upon his banner.

15.20.s:
tataḥ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ sumahallomaharṣaṇam ..
anyeṣāṃ dānavānāṃ ca keśavasya kuśasya ca .. 79 ..
15.20.d:
ततः प्रववृते युद्धं सुमहल्लोमहर्षणम् ..
अन्येषां दानवानां च केशवस्य कुशस्य च .. 79 ..
15.20.m: Then a very great battle, causing the hair to stand on end, / commenced between Keśava and Kuśa and the other Dānavas.

15.20.s:
yajñaghno gadayā gurvyā saṃkarṣaṇamatāḍayat ..
saṃkarṣaṇahataḥ śīrṣṇi musalena papāta ha .. 7.4.20.80 ..
15.20.d:
यज्ञघ्नो गदया गुर्व्या संकर्षणमताडयत् ..
संकर्षणहतः शीर्ष्णि मुसलेन पपात ह .. 7.4.20.80 ..
15.20.m: Yajñaghna struck Saṃkarṣaṇa with a heavy club; / struck on the head by Saṃkarṣaṇa with his pestle, he fell.

15.20.s:
kañcukaṃ ca jaghānāśu cakreṇa bhagavānhariḥ ..
ulmukaścātha nihato brahmaghnaśca nipātitaḥ .. .. 81 ..
15.20.d:
कञ्चुकं च जघानाशु चक्रेण भगवान्हरिः ..
उल्मुकश्चाथ निहतो ब्रह्मघ्नश्च निपातितः .. .. 81 ..
15.20.m: And the Lord Hari swiftly slew Kañcuka with his discus; / then Ulmuka was killed, and Brahmaghna was struck down.

15.20.s:
ete cānye ca bahavo ghātitāḥ keśavena hi ..
dānavānpatitāndṛṣṭvā kuśaḥ paramakopitaḥ ..82..
15.20.d:
एते चान्ये च बहवो घातिताः केशवेन हि ..
दानवान्पतितान्दृष्ट्वा कुशः परमकोपितः ..82..
15.20.m: These and many others were slain by Keśava. / Seeing the Dānavas fallen, Kuśa was exceedingly enraged.

15.20.s:
jaghāna yudhi saṃrabdhaḥ paramāstreṇa keśavam ..
bhagavānkrodhasaṃyuktaścakreṇa cāharacchiraḥ .. 83 ..
15.20.d:
जघान युधि संरब्धः परमास्त्रेण केशवम् ..
भगवान्क्रोधसंयुक्तश्चक्रेण चाहरच्छिरः .. 83 ..
15.20.m: Furious in battle, he struck Keśava with a supreme weapon; / filled with wrath, the Lord severed his head with his discus.

15.20.s:
taṃ chinnaśirasaṃ bhūmau pātitaṃ vīkṣya keśavaḥ ..
ciccheda bāhū pādau ca khaṅgena tilaśastathā ..84..
15.20.d:
तं छिन्नशिरसं भूमौ पातितं वीक्ष्य केशवः ..
चिच्छेद बाहू पादौ च खङ्गेन तिलशस्तथा ..84..
15.20.m: Seeing him fallen on the ground with his head cut off, Keśava / also hacked his arms and legs to pieces like sesame seeds with his sword.

15.20.s:
khaṃḍaśo ghātitaṃ dṛṣṭvā keśavena kuśaṃ tadā ..
saṃgṛhya te punardetyā ninyuḥ sarve śivālayam .. 85 ..
15.20.d:
खंडशो घातितं दृष्ट्वा केशवेन कुशं तदा ..
संगृह्य ते पुनर्देत्या निन्युः सर्वे शिवालयम् .. 85 ..
15.20.m: Seeing Kuśa chopped to pieces then by Keśava, / gathering [the parts], all those Daityas brought them again to the temple of Śiva.

15.20.s:
prasādācchūlinaḥ sadyo jīvitaṃ prāpya dānavaḥ ..
utthitaḥ sahasā kruddhaḥ kva viṣṇuriti cābravīt .. 86 ..
15.20.d:
प्रसादाच्छूलिनः सद्यो जीवितं प्राप्य दानवः ..
उत्थितः सहसा क्रुद्धः क्व विष्णुरिति चाब्रवीत् .. 86 ..
15.20.m: Regaining his life at once by the grace of the trident-bearer, the Dānava / stood up suddenly in anger and said, "Where is Viṣṇu?"

15.20.s:
gadāmudyamya saṃkruddho yoddhumāgājjanārddanam ..
tamudyatagadaṃ dṛṣṭvā nihataṃ jīvitaṃ punaḥ .. .. 87 ..
15.20.d:
गदामुद्यम्य संक्रुद्धो योद्धुमागाज्जनार्द्दनम् ..
तमुद्यतगदं दृष्ट्वा निहतं जीवितं पुनः .. .. 87 ..
15.20.m: Raising his mace, exceedingly enraged, he came to fight Janārdana. / Seeing him with mace raised, slain and yet alive again,

15.20.s:
durvāsasamathovāca kimidaṃ na mriyeta yat ..
mayā'sakṛcchiraśchinnaṃ khaṃḍaśastilaśaḥ kṛtam .. 88 ..
15.20.d:
दुर्वाससमथोवाच किमिदं न म्रियेत यत् ..
मयाऽसकृच्छिरश्छिन्नं खंडशस्तिलशः कृतम् .. 88 ..
15.20.m: he then spoke to Durvāsas: "What is this, that he does not die? / Repeatedly his head was severed by me and cut into pieces like sesame seeds.

15.20.s:
jīvatyayaṃ punaḥ kasmātkāraṇaṃ katha yasva naḥ ..
ityuktaściṃtayāmāsa dhyānena ṛṣisattamaḥ .. 89 ..
15.20.d:
जीवत्ययं पुनः कस्मात्कारणं कथ यस्व नः ..
इत्युक्तश्चिंतयामास ध्यानेन ऋषिसत्तमः .. 89 ..
15.20.m: Why does he live again? Tell us the reason!" / Addressed thus, the best of ṛṣis contemplated in meditation.

15.20.s:
jñātvā tatkāraṇaṃ sarvamuvāca madhusūdanam ..
mahādevena tuṣṭena kuśo'yamamaraḥ kṛtaḥ .. .. 7.4.20.90 ..
15.20.d:
ज्ञात्वा तत्कारणं सर्वमुवाच मधुसूदनम् ..
महादेवेन तुष्टेन कुशोऽयममरः कृतः .. .. 7.4.20.90 ..
15.20.m: Knowing the whole reason, he said to the slayer of Madhu: / "Being pleased, Mahādeva made this Kuśa immortal.

15.20.s:
khaṃḍaśaśca kṛtaścāpi na ca prāṇairviyujyate ..
tataḥ sa vismayāviṣṭo haṃtavyo'yaṃ mayā katham .. 91 ..
15.20.d:
खंडशश्च कृतश्चापि न च प्राणैर्वियुज्यते ..
ततः स विस्मयाविष्टो हंतव्योऽयं मया कथम् .. 91 ..
15.20.m: Even when hacked to pieces, he is not parted from his life-breaths." / Thereupon he was filled with wonder: "How is he to be slain by me?

15.20.s:
upāyaṃ ca kariṣyāmi yenāyaṃ na bhave diti ..
tataḥ sa jīvitaṃ prāpya prasādācchaṃkarasya ca ..
carmakhaṅgamathādāya tiṣṭhatiṣṭheti cābravīt .. 92 ..
15.20.d:
उपायं च करिष्यामि येनायं न भवे दिति ..
ततः स जीवितं प्राप्य प्रसादाच्छंकरस्य च ..
चर्मखङ्गमथादाय तिष्ठतिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत् .. 92 ..
15.20.m: I shall devise a means by which he may cease to be." / Then, having regained life by the grace of Śaṃkara, / taking up his shield and sword, he said: "Stand! Stand!"

15.20.s:
tamāyāṃtaṃ tato dṛṣṭvā kuśaṃ śivaparigraham ..
jaghāna gadayā gurvyā gadāhastaṃ tadā kuśam .. 93 ..
15.20.d:
तमायांतं ततो दृष्ट्वा कुशं शिवपरिग्रहम् ..
जघान गदया गुर्व्या गदाहस्तं तदा कुशम् .. 93 ..
15.20.m: Seeing Kuśa, who was protected by Śiva, approaching, / he struck Kuśa, who held a mace in his hand, with a heavy mace.

15.20.s:
sa bhinnamūrddhā nyapatatkeśavenābhitāḍitaḥ ..
bhūmau nipatitaṃ vegātparigṛhya kuśaṃ hariḥ .. .. 94 ..
15.20.d:
स भिन्नमूर्द्धा न्यपतत्केशवेनाभिताडितः ..
भूमौ निपतितं वेगात्परिगृह्य कुशं हरिः .. .. 94 ..
15.20.m: With his head split open, struck by Keśava, he fell down. / Seizing Kuśa swiftly as he fell upon the ground,

15.20.s:
garte nikṣipya taddehaṃ pūrayāmāsa vai punaḥ ..
liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpayāmāsa tasyopari janārddanaḥ .. 95 ..
15.20.d:
गर्ते निक्षिप्य तद्देहं पूरयामास वै पुनः ..
लिंगं संस्थापयामास तस्योपरि जनार्द्दनः .. 95 ..
15.20.m: Hari cast his body into a pit and filled it back up; / Janārdana then installed a liṅga upon him.

15.20.s:
sa labdhasaṃjño danujaḥ śivaliṃgamapaśyata ..
ātmoparisthitaṃ tacca tadā cintāparo'bhavat.. 96 ..
iti śrīskāndemahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye cakratīrthe rākṣasakuśaviṣṇuyuddhe kuśarākṣasopari viṣṇunā śivaliṃgasthāpanavarṇanaṃnāma viṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 20 ..
15.20.d:
स लब्धसंज्ञो दनुजः शिवलिंगमपश्यत ..
आत्मोपरिस्थितं तच्च तदा चिन्तापरोऽभवत्.. 96 ..
इति श्रीस्कान्देमहापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे चतुर्थे द्वारकामाहात्म्ये चक्रतीर्थे राक्षसकुशविष्णुयुद्धे कुशराक्षसोपरि विष्णुना शिवलिंगस्थापनवर्णनंनाम विंशतितमोऽध्यायः .. 20 ..
15.20.m:
Regaining consciousness, the Danuja saw the Śivaliṅga / placed upon himself, and then he became filled with anxiety.
Thus ends the twentieth chapter, named "The Description of the Installation of the Śivaliṅga upon the Rākṣasa Kuśa by Viṣṇu in the Battle between Viṣṇu and the Rākṣasa Kuśa at Cakra-tīrtha," in the Dvārakā-māhātmya, the fourth [sub-section] of the Prabhāsa-khaṇḍa, the seventh [part] of the glorious Skanda-mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

15.21.s:
.. śrīprahlāda uvāca .. ..
śivaligamalaṃghyaṃ hi buddhipūrvaṃ hato hyaham ..
uvāca kṛṣṇaṃ danujaśchalito'haṃ tvayā'nagha .. 1 ..
15.21.d:
.. श्रीप्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
शिवलिगमलंघ्यं हि बुद्धिपूर्वं हतो ह्यहम् ..
उवाच कृष्णं दनुजश्छलितोऽहं त्वयाऽनघ .. 1 ..
15.21.m: Glorious Prahlāda said: / "A Śivaliṅga is indeed not to be transgressed; I have indeed been destroyed through intellect!" / The Danuja spoke to Kṛṣṇa: "I have been tricked by you, O sinless one!"

15.21.s:
.. śrīviṣṇu ruvāca .. ..
parituṣṭosmi te daitya śauryeṇa śivasaṃśrayāt ..
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te yadicchasi mahāmate .. 2 ..
15.21.d:
.. श्रीविष्णु रुवाच .. ..
परितुष्टोस्मि ते दैत्य शौर्येण शिवसंश्रयात् ..
वरं वरय भद्रं ते यदिच्छसि महामते .. 2 ..
15.21.m:
Śrī Viṣṇu said:
“Daitya, I am pleased with your valour, because of your resort to Śiva. / Choose a boon, good fortune to you, whatever you desire, O highly intelligent one!”

15.21.s:
.. kuśa uvāca .. ..
yathā pūjyo mahādevo mama tvaṃ ca tathā hare ..
eka eva dvidhāmūrtistasmāttvāṃ varayāmyaham .. 3 ..
15.21.d:
.. कुश उवाच .. ..
यथा पूज्यो महादेवो मम त्वं च तथा हरे ..
एक एव द्विधामूर्तिस्तस्मात्त्वां वरयाम्यहम् .. 3 ..
15.21.m:
Kuśa said:
“Just as Mahādeva is worthy of worship for me, so too are you, Hari. / The form is one, doubled; therefore I choose [a boon from] you.

15.21.s:
śivaliṃgaṃ tvayā nātha sthāpitaṃ yanmamopari ..
mama nāmnā bhavatu ca kuśeśvara iti smṛtam ..4..
15.21.d:
शिवलिंगं त्वया नाथ स्थापितं यन्ममोपरि ..
मम नाम्ना भवतु च कुशेश्वर इति स्मृतम् ..4..
15.21.m: The Śivaliṅga that has been placed upon me by you, O Lord— / let it be known by my name as Kuśeśvara.

15.21.s:
anugrāhyo yadyahaṃ te mama kīrtirbhavatviyam ..
evaṃ bhaviṣyatītyuktastatraivāvasthito'suraḥ .. 5 ..
15.21.d:
अनुग्राह्यो यद्यहं ते मम कीर्तिर्भवत्वियम् ..
एवं भविष्यतीत्युक्तस्तत्रैवावस्थितोऽसुरः .. 5 ..
15.21.m: If I am to receive your grace, let this fame be mine!” / Being told, “So shall it be,” the Asura remained right there.

15.21.s:
tato'nyadānavānsarvānpreṣayāmāsa mādhavaḥ ..
rasātalagatā kecitkecidviṣṇuṃ samāgatāḥ .. 6 ..
15.21.d:
ततोऽन्यदानवान्सर्वान्प्रेषयामास माधवः ..
रसातलगता केचित्केचिद्विष्णुं समागताः .. 6 ..
15.21.m: Then Mādhava dispatched all the other Dānavas. / Some went to Rasātala, and some came to Viṣṇu.

15.21.s:
anaṃtaḥ saṃsthitastatra viṣṇuśca tadanaṃtaram ..
jñātvā vimuktidaṃ tīrthaṃ durvāsā munipuṃgavaḥ .. 7 ..
15.21.d:
अनंतः संस्थितस्तत्र विष्णुश्च तदनंतरम् ..
ज्ञात्वा विमुक्तिदं तीर्थं दुर्वासा मुनिपुंगवः .. 7 ..
15.21.m: Ananta remained there, and Viṣṇu immediately after him. / Knowing that sacred ford to bestow ultimate liberation, Durvāsas, the eminent sage,

15.21.s:
gomatyāṃ cakratīrthe ca bhagavāṃśca trivikramaḥ ..
tena tanmuktidaṃ matvā durvāsāstatra saṃsthitaḥ .. 8 ..
15.21.d:
गोमत्यां चक्रतीर्थे च भगवांश्च त्रिविक्रमः ..
तेन तन्मुक्तिदं मत्वा दुर्वासास्तत्र संस्थितः .. 8 ..
15.21.m: and the blessed Trivikrama [remained] at the Gomatī and at Cakra-tīrtha. / Deeming it bestower of liberation on that account, Durvāsas stayed there.

15.21.s:
evaṃ trivikramaḥ svāmī tadāprabhṛti saṃsthitaḥ ..
kalau punaḥ kalānyāsātkṛṣṇatvamagamatprabhuḥ .. 9 ..
15.21.d:
एवं त्रिविक्रमः स्वामी तदाप्रभृति संस्थितः ..
कलौ पुनः कलान्यासात्कृष्णत्वमगमत्प्रभुः .. 9 ..
15.21.m: Thus the Lord Trivikrama remained from that time forward. / In the Kali age, moreover, by the manifestation of parts, the Lord attained Krishna-hood.

15.21.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
pūjāvidhiṃ harerviprāḥ śṛṇudhvaṃ susamāhitāḥ ..
viśeṣātphaladaḥ proktaḥ pūjito madhumādhave .. 7.4.21.10 ..
15.21.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
पूजाविधिं हरेर्विप्राः शृणुध्वं सुसमाहिताः ..
विशेषात्फलदः प्रोक्तः पूजितो मधुमाधवे .. 7.4.21.10 ..
15.21.m:
Prahlāda said:
O brahmins, listen attentively to the rite of worshipping Hari. / It is said to grant special fruit when he is worshipped in Madhu and Mādhava.

15.21.s:
madhusūdanīṃ naro yastu dvāravatyāṃ karoti ca ..
pūjayetkṛṣṇadevaṃ ca snāpayitvā vilipya ca .. 11 ..
15.21.d:
मधुसूदनीं नरो यस्तु द्वारवत्यां करोति च ..
पूजयेत्कृष्णदेवं च स्नापयित्वा विलिप्य च .. 11 ..
15.21.m: A man who observes the Madhusūdanī [vow] in Dvāravatī / should worship the god Krishna, having bathed him and anointed him,

15.21.s:
gandhaiśca vāsasā''cchādya dhūpairdīpairanekadhā ..
naivedyairbhūṣaṇaiścaiva tāṃbūlena phalena ca .. 12 ..
15.21.d:
गन्धैश्च वाससा'ऽच्छाद्य धूपैर्दीपैरनेकधा ..
नैवेद्यैर्भूषणैश्चैव तांबूलेन फलेन च .. 12 ..
15.21.m: covering him with fragrances and a garment, with various incenses and lamps, / food offerings, ornaments, betel, and fruit.

15.21.s:
ārārtikena saṃpūjya daṇḍavatpraṇipatya ca ..
ghṛtena dīpakaṃ dattvā rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ tathā ..
kuryyācca gītavāditraistathā pustakavācakaiḥ .. 13 ..
15.21.d:
आरार्तिकेन संपूज्य दण्डवत्प्रणिपत्य च ..
घृतेन दीपकं दत्त्वा रात्रौ जागरणं तथा ..
कुर्य्याच्च गीतवादित्रैस्तथा पुस्तकवाचकैः .. 13 ..
15.21.m: Worshipping with the waving of lights and bowing down like a rod, / having offered a lamp of clarified butter, he should keep a vigil at night, / and perform it with songs and musical instruments, and with reciters of scriptures.

15.21.s: kṛtvā caivaṃ vidhiṃ bhaktyā sarvānkāmānavāpnu yāt .. 14 ..
15.21.d: कृत्वा चैवं विधिं भक्त्या सर्वान्कामानवाप्नु यात् .. 14 ..
15.21.m: Having thus performed the rite with devotion, he obtains all desires.

15.21.s:
tathā nabhasi sampūjya pavitrāropaṇena ca ..
pitṝṇāṃ cākṣayā tṛptiḥ saphalāḥ syurmanorathāḥ .. 15 ..
15.21.d:
तथा नभसि सम्पूज्य पवित्रारोपणेन च ..
पितॄणां चाक्षया तृप्तिः सफलाः स्युर्मनोरथाः .. 15 ..
15.21.m: Likewise, having worshipped in Nabhas by the investiture of the sacred thread, / there is imperishable satisfaction for the ancestors, and desires become fruitful.

15.21.s:
prabodhavāsare prāpte kārtike dvija sattamāḥ ..
saṃpūjya kṛṣṇaṃ deveśaṃ parāṃ gatimavāpnuyāt .. 16 ..
15.21.d:
प्रबोधवासरे प्राप्ते कार्तिके द्विज सत्तमाः ..
संपूज्य कृष्णं देवेशं परां गतिमवाप्नुयात् .. 16 ..
15.21.m: When the day of awakening arrives in Kārttika, O best of brahmins, / having worshipped Krishna, the Lord of gods, one attains the supreme state.

15.21.s:
tathā nabhasye saṃpūjya pavitrāropaṇena ca ..
sarvānkāmānavāpnoti viṣṇulokaṃ ca gacchati .. 17 ..
15.21.d:
तथा नभस्ये संपूज्य पवित्रारोपणेन च ..
सर्वान्कामानवाप्नोति विष्णुलोकं च गच्छति .. 17 ..
15.21.m: Likewise, having worshipped in Nabhasya by the investiture of the sacred thread, / one attains all desires and goes to the realm of Viṣṇu.

15.21.s:
yugādiṣu ca saṃpūjya hyayane dakṣiṇottare ..
āṣāḍhajyeṣṭhamāgheṣu pauṣādidvādaśīṣu ca .. 18 ..
15.21.d:
युगादिषु च संपूज्य ह्ययने दक्षिणोत्तरे ..
आषाढज्येष्ठमाघेषु पौषादिद्वादशीषु च .. 18 ..
15.21.m: And having worshipped on the beginnings of the yugas, on the southern and northern solstices, / in Āṣāḍha, Jyeṣṭha, and Māgha, and on the twelfth days beginning with Pauṣa,

15.21.s:
kalau kṛṣṇaṃ pūjayitvā gomatyudadhisaṃgame ..
vimalaṃ lokamāpnoti yatra gatvā na śocati .. 19 ..
15.21.d:
कलौ कृष्णं पूजयित्वा गोमत्युदधिसंगमे ..
विमलं लोकमाप्नोति यत्र गत्वा न शोचति .. 19 ..
15.21.m: having worshipped Krishna in the Kali age at the confluence of the Gomatī and the ocean, / one reaches the spotless realm, having gone to which one does not grieve.”

15.21.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye gomatītīrastha kṣetrastha bhagavatpūjāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 21 ..
15.21.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे चतुर्थे द्वारकामाहात्म्ये गोमतीतीरस्थ क्षेत्रस्थ भगवत्पूजामाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकविंशतितमोऽध्यायः .. 21 ..
15.21.m: Thus ends the twenty-first chapter, entitled 'Description of the Glory of the Worship of the Lord in the Sacred Field on the Bank of the Gomatī', in the Dvārakā-māhātmya, the fourth [sub-section] in the Prabhāsa Section, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.

15.22.s:
.. śrīprahlāda uvāca .. ..
śṛṇudhvaṃ dvijaśārdūlā yathāvatkathayāmi vaḥ ..
snāpayitvā jagannāthaṃ tathā gaṃdhairvilipya ca ..
pūjayitvā tulasyā tu bhūṣayitvā ca bhūṣaṇaiḥ .. 1 ..
15.22.d:
.. श्रीप्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
शृणुध्वं द्विजशार्दूला यथावत्कथयामि वः ..
स्नापयित्वा जगन्नाथं तथा गंधैर्विलिप्य च ..
पूजयित्वा तुलस्या तु भूषयित्वा च भूषणैः .. 1 ..
15.22.m:
Śrī Prahlāda said:
“Listen, O tigers among brahmins, I shall tell you as it truly is. / Having bathed the Lord of the World and smeared him with perfumes, / having worshipped him with tulasī and adorned him with ornaments,

15.22.s:
naivedyena ca santarpya tathā nīrājanādibhiḥ ..
durvāsasaṃ tathā pūjya puṃḍarīkākṣameva ca ..2..
15.22.d:
नैवेद्येन च सन्तर्प्य तथा नीराजनादिभिः ..
दुर्वाससं तथा पूज्य पुंडरीकाक्षमेव च ..2..
15.22.m: and satisfied him with food offerings, waving of lights, and the like, / having likewise worshipped Durvāsas and the Lotus-eyed One,

15.22.s:
anaṃtaṃ vainateyādīnbhaktyā sampūjya mānavaḥ ..
dadyāddānaṃ svaśaktyā ca vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ .. 3 ..
15.22.d:
अनंतं वैनतेयादीन्भक्त्या सम्पूज्य मानवः ..
दद्याद्दानं स्वशक्त्या च वित्तशाठ्यविवर्जितः .. 3 ..
15.22.m: and having worshipped Ananta, the son of Vinatā, and others with devotion, a man / should give a gift according to his ability, free from dishonesty regarding wealth.

15.22.s: dīnāṃdhakṛpaṇāṃstatra tarpayecca samāśritān .. 4 ..
15.22.d: दीनांधकृपणांस्तत्र तर्पयेच्च समाश्रितान् .. 4 ..
15.22.m: There he should satisfy the poor, the blind, and the miserable who have taken refuge.

15.22.s:
rukmiṇīṃ ca tato gacchedvidarbhatanayāṃ naraḥ ..
upahṛtyopahārāṃśca balibhirgaṃdhadīpakaiḥ .. 5 ..
15.22.d:
रुक्मिणीं च ततो गच्छेद्विदर्भतनयां नरः ..
उपहृत्योपहारांश्च बलिभिर्गंधदीपकैः .. 5 ..
15.22.m: Then a man should go to Rukmiṇī, the daughter of the king of Vidarbha, / having brought offerings, with oblations, perfumes, and lamps.

15.22.s:
pīḍayaṃti grahāstāvadvyādhayo'bhibhavaṃti ca ..
bhaktyā na paśyati naro yāvatkṛṣṇapriyāṃ kalau .. 6 ..
15.22.d:
पीडयंति ग्रहास्तावद्व्याधयोऽभिभवंति च ..
भक्त्या न पश्यति नरो यावत्कृष्णप्रियां कलौ .. 6 ..
15.22.m: Planets afflict, and diseases overpower, / only so long as a man does not behold Krishna's beloved with devotion in the Kali age.

15.22.s:
upasargabhayaṃ tāvadduḥkhaṃ ca bhūtasaṃbhavam ..
bhaktyā na paśyati naro yāvatkṛṣṇapriyāṃ kalau .. 7 ..
15.22.d:
उपसर्गभयं तावद्दुःखं च भूतसंभवम् ..
भक्त्या न पश्यति नरो यावत्कृष्णप्रियां कलौ .. 7 ..
15.22.m: Fear of calamities and sorrow born of evil spirits last / only so long as a man does not behold Krishna's beloved with devotion in the Kali age.

15.22.s:
bhaveddaridrī duḥkhī ca tāvadvai parayācakaḥ ..
bhaktyā na paśyati naro yāvatkṛṣṇapriyāṃ kalau .. 8 ..
15.22.d:
भवेद्दरिद्री दुःखी च तावद्वै परयाचकः ..
भक्त्या न पश्यति नरो यावत्कृष्णप्रियां कलौ .. 8 ..
15.22.m: He remains poor, miserable, and begging from others / only so long as a man does not behold Krishna's beloved with devotion in the Kali age.

15.22.s:
tāvanmṛtaprajā nārī durbhāgyā duḥkhasaṃyutā ..
bhaktyā na paśyati yadā nārīkṛṣṇapriyāṃ tathā .. 9 ..
15.22.d:
तावन्मृतप्रजा नारी दुर्भाग्या दुःखसंयुता ..
भक्त्या न पश्यति यदा नारीकृष्णप्रियां तथा .. 9 ..
15.22.m: A woman has dead offspring, is unfortunate, and full of sorrow / only so long as a woman does not behold Krishna's beloved with devotion.

15.22.s:
tāvacchatrubhayaṃ puṃsāṃ gṛhabhaṃgaṃ ca mūrkhatā ..
bhaktyā na paśyati naro yāvatkṛṣṇapriyāṃ kalau..7.4.22.10..
15.22.d:
तावच्छत्रुभयं पुंसां गृहभंगं च मूर्खता ..
भक्त्या न पश्यति नरो यावत्कृष्णप्रियां कलौ..7.4.22.10..
15.22.m: Fear of enemies, ruin of the household, and foolishness befall men / only so long as a man does not behold Krishna's beloved with devotion in the Kali age.

15.22.s:
saṃpūjya krṛṣṇaṃ vidhivadrukmiṇīṃ pūjayettataḥ ..
snāpayeddadhidugdhābhyāṃ madhuśarkarayā tathā .. 11 ..
15.22.d:
संपूज्य क्रृष्णं विधिवद्रुक्मिणीं पूजयेत्ततः ..
स्नापयेद्दधिदुग्धाभ्यां मधुशर्करया तथा .. 11 ..
15.22.m: Having worshipped Krishna according to the rules, one should then worship Rukmiṇī. / One should bathe her with curds and milk, and with honey and sugar,

15.22.s:
ghṛtena vividhairgandhaistathaivekṣurasena ca ..
tīrthodakena saṃsnāpya sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt .. 12 ..
15.22.d:
घृतेन विविधैर्गन्धैस्तथैवेक्षुरसेन च ..
तीर्थोदकेन संस्नाप्य सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात् .. 12 ..
15.22.m: with clarified butter, diverse fragrances, and sugarcane juice. / Having bathed her thoroughly with water from sacred fords, one obtains all desires.

15.22.s:
evaṃ yaḥ snāpaye ddevīṃ rukmiṇīṃ krṛṣṇavallabhām ..
na tasya durllabhaṃ kiṃcidiha loke paratra ca .. 13 ..
15.22.d:
एवं यः स्नापये द्देवीं रुक्मिणीं क्रृष्णवल्लभाम् ..
न तस्य दुर्ल्लभं किंचिदिह लोके परत्र च .. 13 ..
15.22.m: He who thus bathes the goddess Rukmiṇī, beloved of Krishna— / nothing is difficult for him to attain in this world or in the next.

15.22.s:
śrīkhaṇḍakuṃkumenaiva tathā mṛgamadena ca ..
vilepayedaputrastu sa putraṃ labhate dhuvam .. 14 ..
15.22.d:
श्रीखण्डकुंकुमेनैव तथा मृगमदेन च ..
विलेपयेदपुत्रस्तु स पुत्रं लभते धुवम् .. 14 ..
15.22.m: One who is sonless who anoints her with sandalwood, saffron, and musk, / surely obtains a son.

15.22.s:
sadā sa bhogī bhavati rūpavāñjanapūjitaḥ ..
pūjayenmālatīpuṣpaiḥ śatapatraiḥ sugandhibhiḥ .. 15 ..
15.22.d:
सदा स भोगी भवति रूपवाञ्जनपूजितः ..
पूजयेन्मालतीपुष्पैः शतपत्रैः सुगन्धिभिः .. 15 ..
15.22.m: He always enjoys pleasures, is handsome, and revered by the people. / One should worship her with mālatī flowers and fragrant lotuses,

15.22.s:
karavīrairmallikābhiśca campakaistu viśeṣataḥ ..
kamalairvārisaṃbhūtaiḥ ketakībhiśca pāṭalaiḥ .. 16 ..
15.22.d:
करवीरैर्मल्लिकाभिश्च चम्पकैस्तु विशेषतः ..
कमलैर्वारिसंभूतैः केतकीभिश्च पाटलैः .. 16 ..
15.22.m: with oleanders, jasmine, and especially with campakas, / with water-born lotuses, with ketakīs, and pāṭalas,

15.22.s:
dhūpenāguruṇā caiva pūjayedgauggu lena ca ..
vastraiḥ sukomalaiḥ śubhrairnānādeśasamudbhavaiḥ .. 17 ..
15.22.d:
धूपेनागुरुणा चैव पूजयेद्गौग्गु लेन च ..
वस्त्रैः सुकोमलैः शुभ्रैर्नानादेशसमुद्भवैः .. 17 ..
15.22.m: and with agallochum incense and guggulu one should worship her. / With very soft, white garments originating from diverse regions,

15.22.s:
bhaktyā saṃchādya vaidarbhīṃ rukmiṇīṃ kṛṣṇavallabhām ..
bhūṣaṇairbhūṣayeddevīṃ maṇiratna samanvitaiḥ .. 18 ..
15.22.d:
भक्त्या संछाद्य वैदर्भीं रुक्मिणीं कृष्णवल्लभाम् ..
भूषणैर्भूषयेद्देवीं मणिरत्न समन्वितैः .. 18 ..
15.22.m: having clothed the lady of Vidarbha, Rukmiṇī, the beloved of Krishna, with devotion, / one should adorn the goddess with ornaments studded with jewels and gems.

15.22.s:
tasminkule nā'sukhaḥ syānnā'dharmo nā'dhanastathā ..
nā'putro na vikarmasthaḥ kitavo nīcasevakaḥ .. 19 ..
15.22.d:
तस्मिन्कुले नाऽसुखः स्यान्नाऽधर्मो नाऽधनस्तथा ..
नाऽपुत्रो न विकर्मस्थः कितवो नीचसेवकः .. 19 ..
15.22.m: In his family there will be no one unhappy, unrighteous, or destitute, / nor sonless, engaged in wrongdoing, a gambler, or a servant of the vile,

15.22.s:
yaiḥ pūjitā jaganmātā rukmiṇī mānavaiḥ kalau ..
naivedyairbhakṣyabhojyādyairdevī me prīyatāmiti ..
tāṃbūlaṃ ca sakarpūraṃ bhāvena vinivedayet .. 7.4.22.20 ..
15.22.d:
यैः पूजिता जगन्माता रुक्मिणी मानवैः कलौ ..
नैवेद्यैर्भक्ष्यभोज्याद्यैर्देवी मे प्रीयतामिति ..
तांबूलं च सकर्पूरं भावेन विनिवेदयेत् .. 7.4.22.20 ..
15.22.m: among those men by whom Rukmiṇī, the Mother of the Universe, has been worshipped in the Kali age / with food offerings of chewables, edibles, and the like, saying: 'May the goddess be pleased with me!' / and who devotedly offers betel accompanied with camphor.

15.22.s:
gṛhītvā ca phalaṃ śubhraṃ hyakṣataiśca samanvitam..
mantreṇānena vai viprā hyarghyaṃ dadyādvidhānataḥ .. 21 ..
15.22.d:
गृहीत्वा च फलं शुभ्रं ह्यक्षतैश्च समन्वितम्..
मन्त्रेणानेन वै विप्रा ह्यर्घ्यं दद्याद्विधानतः .. 21 ..
15.22.m: Having taken bright fruit accompanied with unbroken rice grains, / O brahmins, one should offer the arghya according to the rule with this mantra:

15.22.s:
kṛṣṇapriye namastubhyaṃ vidarbhādhipanaṃdini ..
sarvakāmaprade devi gṛhāṇārghyaṃ namo'stu te .. 22 ..
15.22.d:
कृष्णप्रिये नमस्तुभ्यं विदर्भाधिपनंदिनि ..
सर्वकामप्रदे देवि गृहाणार्घ्यं नमोऽस्तु ते .. 22 ..
15.22.m: ‘Salutations to you, O beloved of Krishna, daughter of the king of Vidarbha! / O goddess who grants all desires, accept the arghya, salutations to you!’

15.22.s:
ārārtikaṃ tataḥ kuryājjvalantaṃ bhāvanānvitaḥ ..
nīrājanaṃ prakartavyaṃ karpūreṇa viśeṣataḥ .. 23 ..
15.22.d:
आरार्तिकं ततः कुर्याज्ज्वलन्तं भावनान्वितः ..
नीराजनं प्रकर्तव्यं कर्पूरेण विशेषतः .. 23 ..
15.22.m: Then, full of devotion, one should perform the waving of a blazing light; / the waving of lights must be performed especially with camphor.”

15.22.s:
śaṃkhe kṛtvā tu pānīyaṃ bhrāmayedbhāvasaṃyutaḥ ..
bhrāmayitvā ca śirasā dhāraṇīyaṃ viśuddhaye .. 24 ..
15.22.d:
शंखे कृत्वा तु पानीयं भ्रामयेद्भावसंयुतः ..
भ्रामयित्वा च शिरसा धारणीयं विशुद्धये .. 24 ..
15.22.m: Putting water in a conch shell, one should circle it with devotion; / and having circled it, one should place it upon one's head for purification. // 24

15.22.s:
daṇḍavatpraṇamedbhūmau namaḥ kṛṣṇapriyeti ca ..
viprapatnīśca viprāṃśca pūjayecchaktito dvijāḥ.. 25 ..
15.22.d:
दण्डवत्प्रणमेद्भूमौ नमः कृष्णप्रियेति च ..
विप्रपत्नीश्च विप्रांश्च पूजयेच्छक्तितो द्विजाः.. 25 ..
15.22.m: One should bow down flat like a stick on the earth, saying, 'Salutations to the beloved of Kṛṣṇa!' / And according to one's means, O twice-born, one should worship brahmins and brahmins' wives // 25

15.22.s:
grīvāsūtrakasindūrairvāsobhiḥ kañcukaistathā ..
sugandhakusumairarcya kuṃkumena vilipya ca .. 26 ..
15.22.d:
ग्रीवासूत्रकसिन्दूरैर्वासोभिः कञ्चुकैस्तथा ..
सुगन्धकुसुमैरर्च्य कुंकुमेन विलिप्य च .. 26 ..
15.22.m: with necklaces, vermilion, garments, and bodices, / worshipping with fragrant flowers and smearing with saffron, // 26

15.22.s:
kausuṃbhakaiḥ kajjalena tāṃbūlena ca toṣayet ..
bhakṣyairbhojyaimodakaiśca ikṣubhirmadhusarpibhiḥ .. 27 ..
15.22.d:
कौसुंभकैः कज्जलेन तांबूलेन च तोषयेत् ..
भक्ष्यैर्भोज्यैमोदकैश्च इक्षुभिर्मधुसर्पिभिः .. 27 ..
15.22.m: and gratify them with safflower robes, collyrium, and betel, / with edibles, foods, sweetmeats, sugarcanes, honey, and ghee. // 27

15.22.s:
prīto bhavati deveśo rukmiṇyā saha keśavaḥ ..
viśeṣataḥ phalānīha dātavyāni dvijottamāḥ .. 28 ..
15.22.d:
प्रीतो भवति देवेशो रुक्मिण्या सह केशवः ..
विशेषतः फलानीह दातव्यानि द्विजोत्तमाः .. 28 ..
15.22.m: Keśava, the lord of gods, becomes pleased together with Rukmiṇī. / In particular, fruits should be given here, O best of the twice-born. // 28

15.22.s:
unmattakaṃ tato devaṃ dvārapālaṃ prapūjayet ..
snāpayitvā sugandhena kuṃkumena vilipya ca .. 29 ..
15.22.d:
उन्मत्तकं ततो देवं द्वारपालं प्रपूजयेत् ..
स्नापयित्वा सुगन्धेन कुंकुमेन विलिप्य च .. 29 ..
15.22.m: Then one should worship the deity Unmattaka, the door-keeper, / bathing him with perfume and smearing him with saffron. // 29

15.22.s:
dhūpena dhūpayitvā tu puṣpādyaiḥ saṃprapūjayeta ..
naivedyairbhakṣyabhojyaiśca māṃsena surayā tathā .. 7.4.22.30 ..
15.22.d:
धूपेन धूपयित्वा तु पुष्पाद्यैः संप्रपूजयेत ..
नैवेद्यैर्भक्ष्यभोज्यैश्च मांसेन सुरया तथा .. 7.4.22.30 ..
15.22.m: Having fumigated him with incense, one should fully worship him with flowers and the like, / with offerings of food, edibles, dishes, as well as meat and liquor, // 30

15.22.s:
prabhūtabalibhiścaiva piṣṭena vividhena ca ..
yoginīnāṃ catuḥṣaṣṭiṃ tasminpīṭhe prapūjayet .. 31 ..
15.22.d:
प्रभूतबलिभिश्चैव पिष्टेन विविधेन च ..
योगिनीनां चतुःषष्टिं तस्मिन्पीठे प्रपूजयेत् .. 31 ..
15.22.m: and with abundant oblations and various types of flour cakes. / At that pīṭha one should worship the sixty-four Yoginīs; // 31

15.22.s:
arcayeddharasiddhiṃ ca kṣetrapālaṃ ca sarvaśaḥ ..
virūpasvāminīṃ tatra tathā vai saptamātaraḥ .. 32 ..
15.22.d:
अर्चयेद्धरसिद्धिं च क्षेत्रपालं च सर्वशः ..
विरूपस्वामिनीं तत्र तथा वै सप्तमातरः .. 32 ..
15.22.m: one should worship Harasiddhi and the Kṣetrapāla on all sides, / Virūpasvāminī there, and likewise the Seven Mothers. // 32

15.22.s:
aṣṭamūrtīḥ kṛṣṇapatnīḥ pīṭhe tasminprapūjayet ..
rukmiṇīṃ satyabhāmāṃ ca śubhāṃ jāṃbavatīṃ tathā .. 33 ..
15.22.d:
अष्टमूर्तीः कृष्णपत्नीः पीठे तस्मिन्प्रपूजयेत् ..
रुक्मिणीं सत्यभामां च शुभां जांबवतीं तथा .. 33 ..
15.22.m: At that pīṭha one should worship the eight forms of Kṛṣṇa's wives: / Rukmiṇī, Satyabhāmā, and auspicious Jāmbavatī, // 33

15.22.s:
mitravindāṃ ca kālindīṃ bhadrāṃ nāgnajitīṃ tathā ..
aṣṭamīṃ lakṣmaṇāṃ tatra pūjayetkṛṣṇavallabhāḥ .. 34 ..
15.22.d:
मित्रविन्दां च कालिन्दीं भद्रां नाग्नजितीं तथा ..
अष्टमीं लक्ष्मणां तत्र पूजयेत्कृष्णवल्लभाः .. 34 ..
15.22.m: Mitravindā, Kālindī, Bhadrā, and Nāgnajitī, / and eighth, Lakṣmaṇā: there one should worship these beloved wives of Kṛṣṇa. // 34

15.22.s:
etāḥ saṃpūjya vidhivatsaṃtarpya dadhipāyasaiḥ ..
gītavāditraghoṣeṇa dīpairjāgaraṇena ca .. 35 ..
15.22.d:
एताः संपूज्य विधिवत्संतर्प्य दधिपायसैः ..
गीतवादित्रघोषेण दीपैर्जागरणेन च .. 35 ..
15.22.m: Having worshipped these according to rule and gratified them with curd and rice pudding, / with the sound of song and musical instruments, with lamps, and keeping vigil, // 35

15.22.s:
putra pautrasamāyukto dhanadhānyasamanvitaḥ ..
sarvānkāmānavāpnoti tasya viṣṇuḥ prasīdati .. 36 ..
15.22.d:
पुत्र पौत्रसमायुक्तो धनधान्यसमन्वितः ..
सर्वान्कामानवाप्नोति तस्य विष्णुः प्रसीदति .. 36 ..
15.22.m: endowed with sons and grandsons, and possessing wealth and grain, / one attains all desires, and Viṣṇu is pleased with him. // 36

15.22.s:
kiṃ tasya vahudānaistu kiṃ vratairniyamaistathā ..
yena dṛṣṭā jaganmātā rukmiṇī kṛṣṇavallabhā .. 37 ..
15.22.d:
किं तस्य वहुदानैस्तु किं व्रतैर्नियमैस्तथा ..
येन दृष्टा जगन्माता रुक्मिणी कृष्णवल्लभा .. 37 ..
15.22.m: What need has he of many gifts, or of vows and observances, / by whom the mother of the universe, Rukmiṇī, beloved of Kṛṣṇa, has been seen? // 37

15.22.s:
kiṃ yajñairbahubhistasya saṃpūrṇavaradakṣiṇaiḥ ..
yena dṛṣṭā jaganmātā rukmiṇī kṛṣṇavallabhā .. 38 ..
15.22.d:
किं यज्ञैर्बहुभिस्तस्य संपूर्णवरदक्षिणैः ..
येन दृष्टा जगन्माता रुक्मिणी कृष्णवल्लभा .. 38 ..
15.22.m: What need has he of many sacrifices with full and excellent priestly fees, / by whom the mother of the universe, Rukmiṇī, beloved of Kṛṣṇa, has been seen? // 38

15.22.s:
tena dattaṃ hutaṃ tena japtaṃ tena sanātanam ..
yena dṛṣṭā jaganmātā rukmiṇī kṛṣṇavallabhā ..39..
15.22.d:
तेन दत्तं हुतं तेन जप्तं तेन सनातनम् ..
येन दृष्टा जगन्माता रुक्मिणी कृष्णवल्लभा ..39..
15.22.m: Given by him, offered in fire by him, chanted eternally by him [is all], / by whom the mother of the universe, Rukmiṇī, beloved of Kṛṣṇa, has been seen. // 39

15.22.s:
helayā tena saṃprāptāḥ siddhayo'ṣṭau na saṃśayaḥ ..
gatvā dvāravatīṃ yena dṛṣṭā keśavavallabhā .. 7.4.22.40 ..
15.22.d:
हेलया तेन संप्राप्ताः सिद्धयोऽष्टौ न संशयः ..
गत्वा द्वारवतीं येन दृष्टा केशववल्लभा .. 7.4.22.40 ..
15.22.m: Effortlessly the eight perfections are attained by him, of this there is no doubt, / by whom, having gone to Dvāravatī, the beloved of Keśava has been seen. // 40

15.22.s:
saphalaṃ jīvitaṃ tasya saphalāśca manorathāḥ ..
kalau kṛṣṇapurīṃ gatvā dṛṣṭvā mādhavavallabhām .. 41 ..
15.22.d:
सफलं जीवितं तस्य सफलाश्च मनोरथाः ..
कलौ कृष्णपुरीं गत्वा दृष्ट्वा माधववल्लभाम् .. 41 ..
15.22.m: Fruitful is his life, and fruitful are his wishes, / who in the Kali age goes to Kṛṣṇa's city and beholds the beloved of Mādhava. // 41

15.22.s:
deva rājyena kiṃ tasya tathā muktipadena ca ..
na dṛṣṭā cejjaganmātā rukmiṇī kṛṣṇavallabhā .. 42 ..
15.22.d:
देव राज्येन किं तस्य तथा मुक्तिपदेन च ..
न दृष्टा चेज्जगन्माता रुक्मिणी कृष्णवल्लभा .. 42 ..
15.22.m: What need has he of the sovereignty over gods, and likewise of the state of liberation, / if the mother of the universe, Rukmiṇī, beloved of Kṛṣṇa, has not been seen? // 42

15.22.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena rukmiṇī kṛṣṇavallabhā ..
sadā'rcanīyā manujairdraṣṭavyā sarvakāmadā..43..
viśeṣataḥ pūjanīyā navarātre sadāśvine ..
navamyāṃ tu narairyaistu pūjitā harivallabhā..41..
15.22.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन रुक्मिणी कृष्णवल्लभा ..
सदाऽर्चनीया मनुजैर्द्रष्टव्या सर्वकामदा..43..
विशेषतः पूजनीया नवरात्रे सदाश्विने ..
नवम्यां तु नरैर्यैस्तु पूजिता हरिवल्लभा..41..
15.22.m:
Therefore, with every effort Rukmiṇī, beloved of Kṛṣṇa, / who grants all desires, is ever to be worshipped and beheld by men. // 43
She should be especially worshipped during the Navarātra in the month of Āśvina; / by those men who worship the beloved of Hari on the ninth day, // 44

15.22.s:
snānagandhādi vastraistu prabhūtabalibhistathā ..
gītavāditraghoṣeṇa dīpajāgaraṇena ca ..
toṣitā bhīṣmakasutā sarvānkāmānprayacchati .. 45 ..
15.22.d:
स्नानगन्धादि वस्त्रैस्तु प्रभूतबलिभिस्तथा ..
गीतवादित्रघोषेण दीपजागरणेन च ..
तोषिता भीष्मकसुता सर्वान्कामान्प्रयच्छति .. 45 ..
15.22.m: with baths, perfumes, and garments, and with abundant oblations, / with the sound of song and musical instruments, and keeping vigil with lamps, / the daughter of Bhīṣmaka, being gratified, grants all desires. // 45

15.22.s:
tathā dīpotsavadine caturddaśyāṃ samāhitaḥ ..
pūjayitvā yathāśāstramīpsitaṃ labhate phalam .. 46 ..
15.22.d:
तथा दीपोत्सवदिने चतुर्द्दश्यां समाहितः ..
पूजयित्वा यथाशास्त्रमीप्सितं लभते फलम् .. 46 ..
15.22.m: Likewise on the fourteenth day of the Dīpotsava festival, being composed, / having worshipped according to the scriptures, one obtains the desired fruit. // 46

15.22.s:
māghamāse sitāṣṭamyāṃ kandarppajananī tu yaiḥ ..
pūjitā gandhapuṣpādyairupahārairanekaśaḥ ..
saphalaṃ jīvitaṃ teṣāṃ saphalāśca manorathāḥ .. 47 ..
15.22.d:
माघमासे सिताष्टम्यां कन्दर्प्पजननी तु यैः ..
पूजिता गन्धपुष्पाद्यैरुपहारैरनेकशः ..
सफलं जीवितं तेषां सफलाश्च मनोरथाः .. 47 ..
15.22.m: On the bright eighth day in the month of Māgha, by those who worship the mother of Kandarpa / with perfumes, flowers, and many various offerings, / fruitful is their life, and fruitful are their desires. // 47

15.22.s:
dvādaśyāṃ caitramāse tu kṛṣṇena saha rukmiṇīm ..
ye paśyaṃti narā devīṃ rukmiṇīṃ madhumādhave ..
kṛṣṇena saha gacchantīṃ dhanyāste mānavā bhuvi ..48..
15.22.d:
द्वादश्यां चैत्रमासे तु कृष्णेन सह रुक्मिणीम् ..
ये पश्यंति नरा देवीं रुक्मिणीं मधुमाधवे ..
कृष्णेन सह गच्छन्तीं धन्यास्ते मानवा भुवि ..48..
15.22.m: On the twelfth day in the month of Caitra, those men who behold Rukmiṇī with Kṛṣṇa, / the goddess Rukmiṇī in the spring months / going together with Kṛṣṇa, blessed are those men on earth! // 48

15.22.s:
putrapautrasamāyuktā dhanadhānyasamanvitāḥ..
jīvite vyādhinirmuktāḥ padaṃ gacchantyanāmayam .. 49 ..
15.22.d:
पुत्रपौत्रसमायुक्ता धनधान्यसमन्विताः..
जीविते व्याधिनिर्मुक्ताः पदं गच्छन्त्यनामयम् .. 49 ..
15.22.m: Endowed with sons and grandsons, and possessing wealth and grain, / freed from disease in life, they go to the sorrowless abode. // 49

15.22.s:
jyeṣṭhāṣṭamyāṃ narairyaistu pūjitā kuṣṇavallabhā ..
teṣāṃ manorathāvāptirjāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 7.4.22.50 ..
15.22.d:
ज्येष्ठाष्टम्यां नरैर्यैस्तु पूजिता कुष्णवल्लभा ..
तेषां मनोरथावाप्तिर्जायते नात्र संशयः .. 7.4.22.50 ..
15.22.m: By those men who worship the beloved of Kṛṣṇa on the eighth day of Jyeṣṭha, / the attainment of their desires comes to pass, of this there is no doubt. // 50

15.22.s:
tathā bhādrapade māsi mātuḥ pūjā kṛtā tu yaiḥ ..
sarvapāpavinirmuktā yāṃti viṣṇupade narāḥ .. 51 ..
15.22.d:
तथा भाद्रपदे मासि मातुः पूजा कृता तु यैः ..
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्ता यांति विष्णुपदे नराः .. 51 ..
15.22.m: Likewise, by those who perform the worship of the Mother in the month of Bhādrapada, / freed from all sins, those men go to the abode of Viṣṇu. // 51

15.22.s:
kārttike māsi dvādaśyāṃ rukmiṇīṃ kṛṣṇasaṃyutām ..
ye paśyaṃti narāsteṣāṃ na bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit .. 52 ..
15.22.d:
कार्त्तिके मासि द्वादश्यां रुक्मिणीं कृष्णसंयुताम् ..
ये पश्यंति नरास्तेषां न भयं विद्यते क्वचित् .. 52 ..
15.22.m: In the month of Kārttika on the twelfth day, those men who behold Rukmiṇī together with Kṛṣṇa, / for them there is nowhere any fear. // 52

15.22.s:
yastvekatra sthitāṃ paśyedrukmiṇīṃ kṛṣṇasaṃyutām ..
saphalaṃ jīvitaṃ tasya hyakṣayā putrasaṃtatiḥ ..
akṣayaṃ dhanadhānyaṃ ca kadā naiva daridratā .. 53 ..
15.22.d:
यस्त्वेकत्र स्थितां पश्येद्रुक्मिणीं कृष्णसंयुताम् ..
सफलं जीवितं तस्य ह्यक्षया पुत्रसंततिः ..
अक्षयं धनधान्यं च कदा नैव दरिद्रता .. 53 ..
15.22.m: Whoever beholds Rukmiṇī standing together with Kṛṣṇa in one place, / fruitful is his life, imperishable his lineage of sons, / imperishable his wealth and grain, and never does poverty befall him. // 53

15.22.s:
ya evaṃ rukmiṇīṃ paśyetpūjayetkṛṣṇavallabhām ..
sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati .. 54 ..
15.22.d:
य एवं रुक्मिणीं पश्येत्पूजयेत्कृष्णवल्लभाम् ..
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो विष्णुलोकं स गच्छति .. 54 ..
15.22.m: Whoever thus beholds Rukmiṇī and worships the beloved of Kṛṣṇa, / freed from all sins, goes to the world of Viṣṇu. // 54

15.22.s:
yaḥ snāyātsarvatīrtheṣu dānaṃ śaktyā dadāti yaḥ ..
tasya puṇyaphalaṃ caiva loke yajjāyate dvijāḥ ..
kathitaṃ tadaśeṣeṇa kalau kṛṣṇasya saṃsthitau .. 55 ..
15.22.d:
यः स्नायात्सर्वतीर्थेषु दानं शक्त्या ददाति यः ..
तस्य पुण्यफलं चैव लोके यज्जायते द्विजाः ..
कथितं तदशेषेण कलौ कृष्णस्य संस्थितौ .. 55 ..
15.22.m: Whoever bathes in all sacred fords, and gives gifts according to his means, / the meritorious fruit of that which arises in the world, O twice-born, / all that has been declared [attained] by residing near Kṛṣṇa in the Kali age. // 55

15.22.s:
dvārāvatīṃ vinā viprā muktirna prāpyate kalau ..
purāṇasaṃhitāmetāṃ kṛtavānbalibandhanaḥ ..
dadau sa tu prasādena pūrvaṃ mahyaṃ dvijottamāḥ .. 56 ..
15.22.d:
द्वारावतीं विना विप्रा मुक्तिर्न प्राप्यते कलौ ..
पुराणसंहितामेतां कृतवान्बलिबन्धनः ..
ददौ स तु प्रसादेन पूर्वं मह्यं द्विजोत्तमाः .. 56 ..
15.22.m: Without Dvārāvatī, O brahmins, liberation is not obtained in the Kali age. / This Purāṇic compilation was composed by the Binder of Bali; / he formerly gave it to me out of grace, O best of the twice-born. // 56

15.22.s:
ihārthe ca purā proktaṃ itihāso dvijottamāḥ ..
pradyumnena susaṃvāde mārkaṇḍena mahātmanā .. 57 ..
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye rukmiṇīpūjanamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvāviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 22 .. cha .. ..
15.22.d:
इहार्थे च पुरा प्रोक्तं इतिहासो द्विजोत्तमाः ..
प्रद्युम्नेन सुसंवादे मार्कण्डेन महात्मना .. 57 ..
इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे चतुर्थे द्वारकामाहात्म्ये रुक्मिणीपूजनमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम द्वाविंशतितमोऽध्यायः .. 22 .. छ .. ..
15.22.m:
And on this matter ancient lore was told of old, O best of the twice-born, / in the fine conversation between Pradyumna and the noble Mārkaṇḍa. // 57
Thus ends the twenty-second chapter, titled 'Description of the Glory of Rukmiṇī's Worship,' in the Dvārakāmāhātmya, the fourth [sub-section] in the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, the seventh [section] of the glorious Skandamahāpurāṇa containing eighty-one thousand verses. // 22

15.23.s:
.. mārkaṃḍeya uvāca .. ..
dvārakāyāśca māhātmyamiṃdradyumna nibodha me ..
kalau nivasate yatra kleśahā rukmiṇīpatiḥ .. 1 ..
15.23.d:
.. मार्कंडेय उवाच .. ..
द्वारकायाश्च माहात्म्यमिंद्रद्युम्न निबोध मे ..
कलौ निवसते यत्र क्लेशहा रुक्मिणीपतिः .. 1 ..
15.23.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Understand from me, O Indradyumna, the glory of Dvārakā, / where the husband of Rukmiṇī, the destroyer of distress, dwells in the Kali age. // 1

15.23.s:
kalau kṛṣṇasya māhātmyaṃ ye śṛṇvaṃti paṭhaṃti ca ..
na teṣāṃ jāyate vāso yamaloke yugāṣṭakam .. 2 ..
15.23.d:
कलौ कृष्णस्य माहात्म्यं ये शृण्वंति पठंति च ..
न तेषां जायते वासो यमलोके युगाष्टकम् .. 2 ..
15.23.m: Those who hear and read the glory of Kṛṣṇa in the Kali age, / for them there is no dwelling in the realm of Yama for eight ages. // 2

15.23.s:
nityaṃ kṛṣṇakathā yasya prāṇādapi garīyasī ..
na tasya durllabhaṃ kiṃcidiha loke paraṃ nṛpa .. 3 ..
15.23.d:
नित्यं कृष्णकथा यस्य प्राणादपि गरीयसी ..
न तस्य दुर्ल्लभं किंचिदिह लोके परं नृप .. 3 ..
15.23.m: He to whom Kṛṣṇa's story is daily dearer even than life, / for him nothing in this world or the next is difficult to attain, O king. // 3

15.23.s:
manvaṃtarasahasraistu kāśīvāsena yatphalam ..
tatphalaṃ dvārakāvāse vasatāṃ paṃcabhirdinaiḥ .. 4 ..
15.23.d:
मन्वंतरसहस्रैस्तु काशीवासेन यत्फलम् ..
तत्फलं द्वारकावासे वसतां पंचभिर्दिनैः .. 4 ..
15.23.m: Whatever fruit is obtained by dwelling in Kāśī for a thousand manvantaras, / that fruit is obtained by those dwelling in Dvārakā in five days. // 4

15.23.s:
kalau nivasate yastu śvapaco dvārakāṃ yadi ..
yatīnāṃ gatimāpnoti prāha hyevaṃ prajāpatiḥ ..5 ..
15.23.d:
कलौ निवसते यस्तु श्वपचो द्वारकां यदि ..
यतीनां गतिमाप्नोति प्राह ह्येवं प्रजापतिः ..5 ..
15.23.m: If even an outcaste dwells in Dvārakā in the Kali age, / he attains the goal of ascetics; thus indeed has Prajāpati declared. // 5

15.23.s:
dvārakāṃ gaṃtukāmaṃ yaḥ pratyahaṃ kurute naraḥ ..
phalamāpnoti manujaḥ kurukṣetrasamudbhavam .. 6 ..
15.23.d:
द्वारकां गंतुकामं यः प्रत्यहं कुरुते नरः ..
फलमाप्नोति मनुजः कुरुक्षेत्रसमुद्भवम् .. 6 ..
15.23.m: The man who daily forms the desire to go to Dvārakā, / that person obtains the fruit that arises from Kurukṣetra.

15.23.s:
somagrahe ca yatproktaṃ yatphalaṃ somanāyake ..
dṛṣṭvā tatphalamāpnoti dvāravatyāṃ janārddanam .. 7 ..
15.23.d:
सोमग्रहे च यत्प्रोक्तं यत्फलं सोमनायके ..
दृष्ट्वा तत्फलमाप्नोति द्वारवत्यां जनार्द्दनम् .. 7 ..
15.23.m: And whatever fruit is declared during an eclipse of the moon at Somanātha, / by seeing Janārdana in Dvāravatī one obtains that same fruit.

15.23.s:
puṣkare kārttikīṃ kṛtvā yatphalaṃ varṣakoṭibhiḥ ..
tatphalaṃ dvārakāvāse dinenaikena jāyate .. 8 ..
15.23.d:
पुष्करे कार्त्तिकीं कृत्वा यत्फलं वर्षकोटिभिः ..
तत्फलं द्वारकावासे दिनेनैकेन जायते .. 8 ..
15.23.m: Whatever fruit is attained in Puṣkara over ten million years by observing the full-moon day of Kārttika, / that fruit is produced in a single day by dwelling in Dvārakā.

15.23.s:
dvārakāyāṃ dinaikena dṛṣṭe devakinaṃdane ..
phalaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ jñeyamatra lakṣaśatodbhavam .. 9 ..
15.23.d:
द्वारकायां दिनैकेन दृष्टे देवकिनंदने ..
फलं कोटिगुणं ज्ञेयमत्र लक्षशतोद्भवम् .. 9 ..
15.23.m: When the son of Devakī is seen in Dvārakā for a single day, / the fruit arising here is to be known as ten million times greater than a hundred thousand [good deeds].

15.23.s:
kalau nivasatāṃ bhūpa dhanyāsteṣāṃ manorathāḥ ..
kṛṣṇasya darśane nityaṃ dvārakāgamane matiḥ .. 7.4.23.10 ..
15.23.d:
कलौ निवसतां भूप धन्यास्तेषां मनोरथाः ..
कृष्णस्य दर्शने नित्यं द्वारकागमने मतिः .. 7.4.23.10 ..
15.23.m: O king, blessed are the wishes of those living in the Kali age / whose minds are always set on the sight of Kṛṣṇa and on going to Dvārakā.

15.23.s:
ekāmapi dvādaśīṃ tu yaḥ karoti nṛpottama ..
kṛṣṇasya sannidhau bhūpa dvārakāyāḥ phalaṃ śṛṇu .. 11 ..
15.23.d:
एकामपि द्वादशीं तु यः करोति नृपोत्तम ..
कृष्णस्य सन्निधौ भूप द्वारकायाः फलं शृणु .. 11 ..
15.23.m: O best of kings, whoever observes even a single Dvādaśī / in the presence of Kṛṣṇa, O king, hear the fruit of Dvārakā:

15.23.s:
dhanyāste kṛtakṛtyāste te janā lokapāvanāḥ ..
dṛṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇamukhaṃ yaistu pāpakoṭyayutāpaham .. 12 ..
15.23.d:
धन्यास्ते कृतकृत्यास्ते ते जना लोकपावनाः ..
दृष्टं कृष्णमुखं यैस्तु पापकोट्ययुतापहम् .. 12 ..
15.23.m: Blessed are they! Successful are they! Those people purify the worlds / by whom Kṛṣṇa's face, which removes tens of millions of sins, has been beheld.

15.23.s:
yatphalaṃ vratasaṃyuktairvāsaraiḥ kṛṣṇasaṃyutaiḥ ..
yajñairdānairbṛhadbhiśca dvārakāyāṃ tathaikayā .. 13 ..
15.23.d:
यत्फलं व्रतसंयुक्तैर्वासरैः कृष्णसंयुतैः ..
यज्ञैर्दानैर्बृहद्भिश्च द्वारकायां तथैकया .. 13 ..
15.23.m: Whatever fruit is obtained by days accompanied by vows and devoted to Kṛṣṇa, / and by grand sacrifices and gifts, [is obtained] in Dvārakā likewise by a single [Dvādaśī].

15.23.s:
kṣīrasnānaṃ prakurvaṃti ye narāḥ kṛṣṇa mūrdhani ..
śatāśvamedhajaṃ puṇyaṃ biṃdunā biṃdunā smṛtam .. 14 ..
15.23.d:
क्षीरस्नानं प्रकुर्वंति ये नराः कृष्ण मूर्धनि ..
शताश्वमेधजं पुण्यं बिंदुना बिंदुना स्मृतम् .. 14 ..
15.23.m: The merit arising from a hundred horse sacrifices is traditionally stated / for each drop [offered] by those men who perform a milk-bath on Kṛṣṇa's head.

15.23.s:
dadhi kṣīrāddaśaguṇaṃ ghṛtaṃ dadhno daśottaram ..
ghṛtāddaśaguṇaṃ kṣaudraṃ kṣaudrāddaśaguṇottaram ... . 15..
15.23.d:
दधि क्षीराद्दशगुणं घृतं दध्नो दशोत्तरम् ..
घृताद्दशगुणं क्षौद्रं क्षौद्राद्दशगुणोत्तरम् ... . 15..
15.23.m: Curd is ten times [more meritorious] than milk; ghee is ten times higher than curd; / honey is ten times greater than ghee; and [water] is ten times higher than honey.

15.23.s:
puṣpodakaṃ ca ratnodaṃ varddhanaṃ ca daśottaram..
maṃtrodakaṃ ca gaṃdhodaṃ tathaiva nṛpasattama.. 16 ..
15.23.d:
पुष्पोदकं च रत्नोदं वर्द्धनं च दशोत्तरम्..
मंत्रोदकं च गंधोदं तथैव नृपसत्तम.. 16 ..
15.23.m: Flower-water and jewel-water increase [the merit] ten times further; / and likewise mantra-water and fragrant water, O best of kings.

15.23.s:
ikṣo rasena snapanaṃ śatavājimakhaiḥ samam..
tathaiva tīrthanīraṃ sa phalaṃ yacchati bhūmipa ..17 ..
15.23.d:
इक्षो रसेन स्नपनं शतवाजिमखैः समम्..
तथैव तीर्थनीरं स फलं यच्छति भूमिप ..17 ..
15.23.m: A ceremonial bath with sugarcane juice is equal to a hundred horse sacrifices; / likewise, water from sacred fords yields that [same] fruit, O protector of the earth.

15.23.s:
kṛṣṇaṃ snānārdragātraṃ ca vastreṇa parimārjati..
tasya lakṣārjitasyāpi bhavetpāpasya mārjanam.. 18 ..
15.23.d:
कृष्णं स्नानार्द्रगात्रं च वस्त्रेण परिमार्जति..
तस्य लक्षार्जितस्यापि भवेत्पापस्य मार्जनम्.. 18 ..
15.23.m: When one wipes Kṛṣṇa, whose limbs are wet from the bath, with a cloth, / there is a wiping away of sin even if accrued through a hundred thousand [lifetimes].

15.23.s:
snāpayitvā jagannāthaṃ puṣpamālāvarohaṇam ..
kurute pratipuṣpaṃ tu svarṇaniṣkāyutaṃ phalam .. 19 ..
15.23.d:
स्नापयित्वा जगन्नाथं पुष्पमालावरोहणम् ..
कुरुते प्रतिपुष्पं तु स्वर्णनिष्कायुतं फलम् .. 19 ..
15.23.m: Having bathed the Lord of the World, one who takes down the garland of flowers / obtains the fruit of ten thousand gold coins for each single flower.

15.23.s:
snānakāle tu devasya śaṃkhādīnāṃ tu vādanam .
kurute brahmaloke tu vasate brahmavāsaram .. 7.4.23.20 ..
15.23.d:
स्नानकाले तु देवस्य शंखादीनां तु वादनम् .
कुरुते ब्रह्मलोके तु वसते ब्रह्मवासरम् .. 7.4.23.20 ..
15.23.m: One who sounds conches and other instruments at the time of the god's bath / dwells in the world of Brahmā for a day of Brahmā.

15.23.s:
snānakāle sa kṛṣṇasya paṭhennāmasahasrakam ..
pratyakṣaraṃ labhetpreṣṭaṃ kapilāgośatodbhavam .. 21 ..
15.23.d:
स्नानकाले स कृष्णस्य पठेन्नामसहस्रकम् ..
प्रत्यक्षरं लभेत्प्रेष्टं कपिलागोशतोद्भवम् .. 21 ..
15.23.m: At the time of Kṛṣṇa's bath, one who recites the Thousand Names / shall obtain at each syllable the dear [fruit] arising from a hundred tawny cows.

15.23.s:
phalametanmahīpāla gītāyāḥ parikīrtitam ..
gajeṃdramokṣaṇenaivaṃ stavarājena kīrttitam .. 22 ..
15.23.d:
फलमेतन्महीपाल गीतायाः परिकीर्तितम् ..
गजेंद्रमोक्षणेनैवं स्तवराजेन कीर्त्तितम् .. 22 ..
15.23.m: This fruit, O ruler of the earth, is proclaimed for the Gītā; / and likewise it is proclaimed for the sovereign hymn of the Liberation of the King of Elephants.

15.23.s:
stavairṛṣikṛtairanyaiḥ paṭhitaiśca narādhipa ..
toṣamāpnoti deveśaḥ sarvānkāmānprayacchati .. 23 ..
15.23.d:
स्तवैरृषिकृतैरन्यैः पठितैश्च नराधिप ..
तोषमाप्नोति देवेशः सर्वान्कामान्प्रयच्छति .. 23 ..
15.23.m: And through other hymns composed by seers being recited, O ruler of men, / the Lord of the Gods attains satisfaction and grants all desires.

15.23.s:
kiṃ punarvedapāṭhaṃ tu snānakāle karoti yaḥ ..
tasya yallabhate puṇyaṃ na jñātaṃ naranāyaka .. 24 ..
15.23.d:
किं पुनर्वेदपाठं तु स्नानकाले करोति यः ..
तस्य यल्लभते पुण्यं न ज्ञातं नरनायक .. 24 ..
15.23.m: How much more so for one who performs the recitation of the Veda at the time of the bath! / What merit such a one attains is not known, O leader of men.

15.23.s:
snāna kāle ca saṃprāpte kṛṣṇasyāgre tu nartanam ..
gītaṃ caiva punastatra stavanaṃ vadanena hi ..25 ..
15.23.d:
स्नान काले च संप्राप्ते कृष्णस्याग्रे तु नर्तनम् ..
गीतं चैव पुनस्तत्र स्तवनं वदनेन हि ..25 ..
15.23.m: And when the time of the bath arrives, dancing before Kṛṣṇa, / singing, and also praising him with one's voice—

15.23.s:
snānakāle tu kṛṣṇasya jayaśabdaṃ karoti yaḥ ..
karatāla samāyuktaṃ gītanṛtyaṃ karoti ca ..26..
15.23.d:
स्नानकाले तु कृष्णस्य जयशब्दं करोति यः ..
करताल समायुक्तं गीतनृत्यं करोति च ..26..
15.23.m: one who utters the shout of victory at the time of Kṛṣṇa's bath / and performs song and dance accompanied by clapping,

15.23.s:
tatra ceṣṭāṃ prakurvāṇo hasate jalpate'pi vā ..
muktaṃ tena paraṃ māturyoniyaṃtrasya nirgamam .. 27 ..
15.23.d:
तत्र चेष्टां प्रकुर्वाणो हसते जल्पतेऽपि वा ..
मुक्तं तेन परं मातुर्योनियंत्रस्य निर्गमम् .. 27 ..
15.23.m: making gestures there, laughing, or conversing, / has escaped the ultimate emergence from the womb-machine of a mother.

15.23.s:
nottānaśāyī bhavati māturaṃke nareśvara ..
guṇānpaṭhati kṛṣṇasya yaḥ kāle snānakarmaṇaḥ .. 28 ..
15.23.d:
नोत्तानशायी भवति मातुरंके नरेश्वर ..
गुणान्पठति कृष्णस्य यः काले स्नानकर्मणः .. 28 ..
15.23.m: He does not lie on his back in a mother's lap, O lord of men, / who recites the virtues of Kṛṣṇa at the time of the rite of bathing.

15.23.s:
caṃdanāgurumiśreṇa kaṃkumena sugaṃdhinā ..
vilepayati yaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ karpūramṛganābhinā ..
kalpaṃ tu bhavane viṣṇorvasate pitṛbhiḥ saha ..29..
15.23.d:
चंदनागुरुमिश्रेण कंकुमेन सुगंधिना ..
विलेपयति यः कृष्णं कर्पूरमृगनाभिना ..
कल्पं तु भवने विष्णोर्वसते पितृभिः सह ..29..
15.23.m: He who anoints Kṛṣṇa with fragrant saffron blended with sandalwood and agallochum, / and with camphor and musk, / dwells with his ancestors in the abode of Viṣṇu for a kalpa.

15.23.s:
pratyekaṃ caṃdanādīnāmiṃdradyumna na cānyathā ..
nānādeśasamudbhūtaiḥ suvastraiśca sukomalaiḥ .. 7.4.23.30 ..
15.23.d:
प्रत्येकं चंदनादीनामिंद्रद्युम्न न चान्यथा ..
नानादेशसमुद्भूतैः सुवस्त्रैश्च सुकोमलैः .. 7.4.23.30 ..
15.23.m: Each one of the sandalwood and other [substances], O Indradyumna, is not otherwise; / and with exceedingly soft, fine garments produced in various lands,

15.23.s:
dhūpayitvā sugaṃdhaiśca yo dhūpayati mānavaḥ ..
manvaṃtarāṇi vasate tatsaṃkhyāni harergṛhe ..31..
15.23.d:
धूपयित्वा सुगंधैश्च यो धूपयति मानवः ..
मन्वंतराणि वसते तत्संख्यानि हरेर्गृहे ..31..
15.23.m: having censed him with sweet scents, the man who censes him [with incense] / dwells in the house of Hari for that number of manvantaras.

15.23.s:
svaśaktyā devadeveśaṃ bhūṣaṇairbhūṣayaṃti ca ..
hemajairatulaiḥ śubhrairmaṇijaiśca suśobhanaiḥ .. 32 ..
15.23.d:
स्वशक्त्या देवदेवेशं भूषणैर्भूषयंति च ..
हेमजैरतुलैः शुभ्रैर्मणिजैश्च सुशोभनैः .. 32 ..
15.23.m: And according to their ability they adorn the God of gods with ornaments / made of gold, peerless and bright, and made of jewels, most splendid.

15.23.s: teṣāṃ phalaṃ mahārāja rudrāśca vāsavādayaḥ .. 33 ..
15.23.d: तेषां फलं महाराज रुद्राश्च वासवादयः .. 33 ..
15.23.m: Their fruit, O great king, the Rudras and the [gods] headed by Indra,

15.23.s:
jānaṃti munayo naiva varjayitvā tu mādhavam ..
ye'rcayaṃti jagannāthaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kalimalāpaham ..
ketakītulasīpatraiḥ puṣpairmālatisaṃbhavaiḥ .. 34 ..
15.23.d:
जानंति मुनयो नैव वर्जयित्वा तु माधवम् ..
येऽर्चयंति जगन्नाथं कृष्णं कलिमलापहम् ..
केतकीतुलसीपत्रैः पुष्पैर्मालतिसंभवैः .. 34 ..
15.23.m: and the sages do not know, leaving aside only Mādhava. / Those who worship the Lord of the World, Kṛṣṇa, who removes the filth of the Kali age, / with ketakī and tulasī leaves, and with flowers born of mālatī,

15.23.s:
taddeśasaṃbhavaiścānyairbhūribhiḥ kusumairnṛpa ..
ekaikaṃ nṛpa śārdūla rājasūyasamaṃ smṛtam .. 35 ..
15.23.d:
तद्देशसंभवैश्चान्यैर्भूरिभिः कुसुमैर्नृप ..
एकैकं नृप शार्दूल राजसूयसमं स्मृतम् .. 35 ..
15.23.m: and with abundant other blossoms grown in that region, O king— / each single one, O tiger among kings, is traditionally considered equal to a Rājasūya.

15.23.s:
ye kurvaṃti narāḥ pūjāṃ svaśaktyā rukmiṇīpateḥ ..
krīḍaṃti viṣṇuloke te manvataraśataṃ narāḥ .. 36 ..
15.23.d:
ये कुर्वंति नराः पूजां स्वशक्त्या रुक्मिणीपतेः ..
क्रीडंति विष्णुलोके ते मन्वतरशतं नराः .. 36 ..
15.23.m: Those men who perform the worship of the lord of Rukmiṇī according to their power, / those men disport themselves in the world of Viṣṇu for a hundred manvantaras.

15.23.s:
yaḥ punastulasīpatraiḥ komalamaṃjarīyutaiḥ ..
pūjayecchraddhayā yastu kṛṣṇaṃ devakinaṃdanam .. 37 ..
15.23.d:
यः पुनस्तुलसीपत्रैः कोमलमंजरीयुतैः ..
पूजयेच्छ्रद्धया यस्तु कृष्णं देवकिनंदनम् .. 37 ..
15.23.m: Moreover, he who should worship Kṛṣṇa, the son of Devakī, with faith, / using tulasī leaves accompanied by tender shoots—

15.23.s:
yā gatiryogayuktānāṃ yā gatiryogaśālinām ..
yā gatirdānaśīlānāṃ yā gatistīrthasevinām .. 38 ..
15.23.d:
या गतिर्योगयुक्तानां या गतिर्योगशालिनाम् ..
या गतिर्दानशीलानां या गतिस्तीर्थसेविनाम् .. 38 ..
15.23.m: the destiny of those united with yoga, the destiny of those possessing yoga, / the destiny of the generous, the destiny of those who resort to sacred fords,

15.23.s:
yā gatirmātṛbhaktānāṃ dvādaśīṃ vedhavarjitām ..
kurvatāṃ jāgaraṃ viṣṇornṛtyatāṃ gāyatāṃ phalam ..39..
15.23.d:
या गतिर्मातृभक्तानां द्वादशीं वेधवर्जिताम् ..
कुर्वतां जागरं विष्णोर्नृत्यतां गायतां फलम् ..39..
15.23.m: the destiny of those devoted to their mothers, and the fruit of those who observe a Dvādaśī free from overlap, / keeping vigil for Viṣṇu, dancing and singing,

15.23.s:
vaiṣṇavānāṃ tu bhaktānāṃ yatphalaṃ vedavādinām ..
paṭhatāṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ śāstraṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ tu yacchatām .. 7.4.23.40 ..
15.23.d:
वैष्णवानां तु भक्तानां यत्फलं वेदवादिनाम् ..
पठतां वैष्णवं शास्त्रं वैष्णवानां तु यच्छताम् .. 7.4.23.40 ..
15.23.m: and whatever fruit belongs to Vaiṣṇava devotees and expounders of the Veda, / to those reciting Vaiṣṇava treatises, and to those giving to Vaiṣṇavas—

15.23.s:
tulasīmālayā kṛṣṇaḥ pūjito rukmiṇī patiḥ ..
phalametanmahīpāla yacchate nātra saśayaḥ .. 41 ..
15.23.d:
तुलसीमालया कृष्णः पूजितो रुक्मिणी पतिः ..
फलमेतन्महीपाल यच्छते नात्र सशयः .. 41 ..
15.23.m: when worshipped with a garland of tulasī, Kṛṣṇa, the lord of Rukmiṇī, / grants this fruit, O protector of the earth; of this there is no doubt.

15.23.s:
yathā lakṣmīḥ priyā viṣṇostulasī ca tato'dhikā ..
dvārakāyāṃ samutpannā viśeṣeṇa phalādhikā .. 42 ..
15.23.d:
यथा लक्ष्मीः प्रिया विष्णोस्तुलसी च ततोऽधिका ..
द्वारकायां समुत्पन्ना विशेषेण फलाधिका .. 42 ..
15.23.m: Just as Lakṣmī is dear to Viṣṇu, even more so is tulasī; / grown in Dvārakā, it bears exceptionally greater fruit.

15.23.s:
yatra tatra sthito viṣṇustulasīdalamālayā ..
pūjito dvārakātulyaṃ puṇyaṃ sa yacchate kalau .. 43 ..
15.23.d:
यत्र तत्र स्थितो विष्णुस्तुलसीदलमालया ..
पूजितो द्वारकातुल्यं पुण्यं स यच्छते कलौ .. 43 ..
15.23.m: Wherever Viṣṇu may reside, when worshipped with a garland of tulasī leaves, / he grants in the Kali age merit equal to Dvārakā.

15.23.s:
yo'rcayetketakīpatraiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ kalimalāpaham ..
patrepatre'śvamedhasyaphalaṃ yacchati bhūbhuja ..44..
15.23.d:
योऽर्चयेत्केतकीपत्रैः कृष्णं कलिमलापहम् ..
पत्रेपत्रेऽश्वमेधस्यफलं यच्छति भूभुज ..44..
15.23.m: Whoever should worship Kṛṣṇa, who removes the filth of the Kali age, with ketakī leaves, / to him he grants the fruit of a horse sacrifice for every leaf, O king.

15.23.s:
yo'rcayenmālatīpuṣpaiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ tribhuvaneśvaram ..
tenāptaṃ nāsti saṃdeho yatphalaṃ durlabhaṃ hareḥ .. 45 ..
15.23.d:
योऽर्चयेन्मालतीपुष्पैः कृष्णं त्रिभुवनेश्वरम् ..
तेनाप्तं नास्ति संदेहो यत्फलं दुर्लभं हरेः .. 45 ..
15.23.m: Whoever should worship Kṛṣṇa, the lord of the three worlds, with mālatī flowers, / by him has been attained, there is no doubt, that fruit of Hari which is difficult to attain.

15.23.s:
ṛtukālodbhavaiḥ puṣpairyo'rcayedrukmiṇīpatim ..
sarvānkāmānavāpnoti durlabhāndevamānuṣaiḥ .. 46 ..
15.23.d:
ऋतुकालोद्भवैः पुष्पैर्योऽर्चयेद्रुक्मिणीपतिम् ..
सर्वान्कामानवाप्नोति दुर्लभान्देवमानुषैः .. 46 ..
15.23.m: He who should worship the lord of Rukmiṇī with flowers born in their proper season / obtains all desires that are hard to attain even for gods and men.

15.23.s:
kṛṣṇenāguruṇā kṛṣṇaṃ dhūpayaṃti kalau yuge ..
sakarpūreṇa rājendra kṛṣṇatulyā bhavaṃti te .. 47 ..
15.23.d:
कृष्णेनागुरुणा कृष्णं धूपयंति कलौ युगे ..
सकर्पूरेण राजेन्द्र कृष्णतुल्या भवंति ते .. 47 ..
15.23.m: In the Kali age, those who incense Kṛṣṇa with black agallochum / together with camphor, O lord of kings, become equal to Kṛṣṇa.

15.23.s:
sājyena guggulenāpi sugaṃdhena janārddanam ..
dhūpayitvā naro yāti padaṃ bhūyaḥ sadā śivam .. 48 ..
15.23.d:
साज्येन गुग्गुलेनापि सुगंधेन जनार्द्दनम् ..
धूपयित्वा नरो याति पदं भूयः सदा शिवम् .. 48 ..
15.23.m: Having censed Janārdana with fragrant bdellium along with clarified butter, / a person goes again to the eternal, auspicious abode.

15.23.s:
yo dadāti mahīpāla kṛṣṇasyāgre tu dīpakam ..
pātakaṃ tu samutsṛjya jyotīrūpaṃ labhetpadam .. 49 ..
15.23.d:
यो ददाति महीपाल कृष्णस्याग्रे तु दीपकम् ..
पातकं तु समुत्सृज्य ज्योतीरूपं लभेत्पदम् .. 49 ..
15.23.m: O protector of the earth, he who offers a lamp before Kṛṣṇa, / casting away all sin, shall attain the state whose nature is light.

15.23.s:
dvāre kṛṣṇasya yo nityaṃ dīpamālāṃ karoti hi ..
saptadvīpavatīrājyaṃ dvīpedvīpe phalaṃ labhet .. 7.4.23.50 ..
15.23.d:
द्वारे कृष्णस्य यो नित्यं दीपमालां करोति हि ..
सप्तद्वीपवतीराज्यं द्वीपेद्वीपे फलं लभेत् .. 7.4.23.50 ..
15.23.m: Whoever constantly arranges a row of lamps at Kṛṣṇa's door, / obtains sovereignty over the seven continents, reaping the fruit on continent after continent.

15.23.s:
naivedyāni manojñāni kṛṣṇāya vinivedayet ..
kalpāṃtaṃ tatpitṝṇāṃ hi tṛptirbhavati śāśvatī .. 51 ..
15.23.d:
नैवेद्यानि मनोज्ञानि कृष्णाय विनिवेदयेत् ..
कल्पांतं तत्पितॄणां हि तृप्तिर्भवति शाश्वती .. 51 ..
15.23.m: One should offer delightful food offerings to Kṛṣṇa; / his ancestors certainly obtain everlasting satisfaction until the end of a kalpa.

15.23.s:
phalāni yacchate yo vai suhṛdyāni nareśvara ..
jāyaṃte tasya kalpāṃtaṃ saphalāstu manorathāḥ .. 52 ..
15.23.d:
फलानि यच्छते यो वै सुहृद्यानि नरेश्वर ..
जायंते तस्य कल्पांतं सफलास्तु मनोरथाः .. 52 ..
15.23.m: O king, whoever gives charming fruits, / his wishes become fruitful until the end of a kalpa.

15.23.s:
tāṃbūlaṃ tu sakarpūraṃ sapūgaṃ naranāyaka ..
kṛṣṇāya yacchate yo vai padaṃ tasyāgnidaivatam .. 53 ..
15.23.d:
तांबूलं तु सकर्पूरं सपूगं नरनायक ..
कृष्णाय यच्छते यो वै पदं तस्याग्निदैवतम् .. 53 ..
15.23.m: O leader of men, whoever offers betel with camphor and areca nut to Kṛṣṇa, / his abode belongs to the deity Agni.

15.23.s:
sanīraṃ karpuropetaṃ kuṃbhaṃ kṛṣṇāgrato nyaset ..
kalpāṃte na jalāpekṣāṃ kurvaṃti ca pitāmahāḥ ..54..
15.23.d:
सनीरं कर्पुरोपेतं कुंभं कृष्णाग्रतो न्यसेत् ..
कल्पांते न जलापेक्षां कुर्वंति च पितामहाः ..54..
15.23.m: One should place a jar filled with water mixed with camphor before Kṛṣṇa; / his ancestors have no longing for water until the end of a kalpa.

15.23.s:
vyajanenātha vastreṇa subhaktyā mātariśvanā ..
devadevasya rājendra kurute dharmavāraṇam..59..
tatkule nāsti pāpiṣṭho na ca loke yamasya ca ..
vāyulokānmahīpāla na punarvidyate gatiḥ..56..
kṛṣṇaveśmani yaḥ kuryyātsadhūpaṃ puṣpamaṃḍapam ..
sapuṣpakavimānaistu krīḍate koṭibhirddivi..57..
calaccāmaravātena kṛṣṇaṃ yastoṣayennaraḥ ..
tasyottamāṃgaṃ deveśaścuṃbate svamukhena hi ..58..
yaḥ kuryātkṛṣṇabhavanaṃ kadalīstaṃbhaśobhitam .. ..
vasatyarkaloke tu yāvadvasati medinī .. 59 ..
15.23.d:
व्यजनेनाथ वस्त्रेण सुभक्त्या मातरिश्वना ..
देवदेवस्य राजेन्द्र कुरुते धर्मवारणम्..59..
तत्कुले नास्ति पापिष्ठो न च लोके यमस्य च ..
वायुलोकान्महीपाल न पुनर्विद्यते गतिः..56..
कृष्णवेश्मनि यः कुर्य्यात्सधूपं पुष्पमंडपम् ..
सपुष्पकविमानैस्तु क्रीडते कोटिभिर्द्दिवि..57..
चलच्चामरवातेन कृष्णं यस्तोषयेन्नरः ..
तस्योत्तमांगं देवेशश्चुंबते स्वमुखेन हि ..58..
यः कुर्यात्कृष्णभवनं कदलीस्तंभशोभितम् .. ..
वसत्यर्कलोके तु यावद्वसति मेदिनी .. 59 ..
15.23.m:
O king of kings, [whoever] wards off the heat for the God of gods / with a fan or a cloth, with great devotion, using wind,
in his lineage there is no sinner, nor [does anyone go] to Yama's world; / O protector of the earth, from the world of Vāyu there is no return.
Whoever sets up a flower pavilion along with incense in Kṛṣṇa's abode, / plays in heaven in tens of millions of aerial chariots decorated with flowers.
The man who pleases Kṛṣṇa with the breeze of waving fly-whisks, / the Lord of gods kisses his head with his own mouth.
Whoever makes Kṛṣṇa's abode adorned with plantain pillars, / dwells in the world of the sun as long as the earth endures.

15.23.s:
dhūpaṃ caṃdanamālāṃ tu kurute kṛṣṇasadmani ..
devakanyāyutairlakṣaiḥ sevyate suranāyakaiḥ .. 7.4.23.60 ..
15.23.d:
धूपं चंदनमालां तु कुरुते कृष्णसद्मनि ..
देवकन्यायुतैर्लक्षैः सेव्यते सुरनायकैः .. 7.4.23.60 ..
15.23.m: Whoever provides incense and a garland of sandalwood in Kṛṣṇa's abode / is served by hundreds of thousands of divine maidens and leaders of the gods.

15.23.s:
dhvajamāropayedyastu prāsādopari bhaktitaḥ ..
tasya brahmapade vāsaḥ krīḍate brahmaṇā saha .. 61 ..
15.23.d:
ध्वजमारोपयेद्यस्तु प्रासादोपरि भक्तितः ..
तस्य ब्रह्मपदे वासः क्रीडते ब्रह्मणा सह .. 61 ..
15.23.m: And whoever raises a banner atop the temple with devotion, / his dwelling is in the abode of Brahmā, and he sports together with Brahmā.

15.23.s:
prāṃgaṇaṃ varṇakopetaṃ svastikaiśca samanvitaiḥ ..
devadevasya kurute krīḍate bhuvanatraye..62..
15.23.d:
प्रांगणं वर्णकोपेतं स्वस्तिकैश्च समन्वितैः ..
देवदेवस्य कुरुते क्रीडते भुवनत्रये..62..
15.23.m: Whoever furnishes the courtyard of the God of gods with colored powders / and with svastika designs, sports in the three worlds.

15.23.s:
yo dadyānmaṇḍape puṣpaprakaraṃ rukmiṇīpateḥ..
devodyāneṣu sarveṣu krīḍate naranāyakaiḥ..63..
15.23.d:
यो दद्यान्मण्डपे पुष्पप्रकरं रुक्मिणीपतेः..
देवोद्यानेषु सर्वेषु क्रीडते नरनायकैः..63..
15.23.m: Whoever offers an abundance of flowers in the pavilion of the husband of Rukmiṇī, / sports in all the divine gardens alongside leaders of men.

15.23.s:
prāsāde devadevasya citrakarma karoti yaḥ..
vasate rudraloke tu yāvattiṣṭhaṃti sāgarāḥ..64..
15.23.d:
प्रासादे देवदेवस्य चित्रकर्म करोति यः..
वसते रुद्रलोके तु यावत्तिष्ठंति सागराः..64..
15.23.m: Whoever executes paintings in the temple of the God of gods, / dwells in Rudra's world as long as the oceans endure.

15.23.s:
dadyāccandramayaṃ yastu kṛṣṇopari nareśvara..
vasate dvārakāṃ yāvatsomaloke sa tiṣṭhati ..65 ..
15.23.d:
दद्याच्चन्द्रमयं यस्तु कृष्णोपरि नरेश्वर..
वसते द्वारकां यावत्सोमलोके स तिष्ठति ..65 ..
15.23.m: O lord of men, whoever offers a silver [canopy] over Kṛṣṇa, / dwells in Dvārakā and remains in the world of the Moon.

15.23.s:
chatraṃ bahuśalākaṃ tu kiṃkiṇīvasraguṇṭhitam ..
divyaratnaiśca saṃyuktaṃ hemadaṇḍasamanvitam .. 66 ..
15.23.d:
छत्रं बहुशलाकं तु किंकिणीवस्रगुण्ठितम् ..
दिव्यरत्नैश्च संयुक्तं हेमदण्डसमन्वितम् .. 66 ..
15.23.m: An umbrella with many ribs, covered in bells and cloth, / adorned with divine gems and furnished with a golden staff—

15.23.s:
samarpayati kṛṣṇāya cchatraṃ lakṣārbudairvṛtam ..
amaraiḥ sahitaḥ sarvaiḥ krīḍate pitṛbhiḥ saha .. 67 ..
15.23.d:
समर्पयति कृष्णाय च्छत्रं लक्षार्बुदैर्वृतम् ..
अमरैः सहितः सर्वैः क्रीडते पितृभिः सह .. 67 ..
15.23.m: [whoever] offers [such] an umbrella to Kṛṣṇa, surrounded by hundreds of thousands and billions [of attendants], / sports together with all the immortals and ancestors.

15.23.s:
dadyānnaravimānaṃ tu kṛṣṇāya naranāyaka ..
satkṛto dhanadenaiva vasate brahmavāsaram .. 68 ..
15.23.d:
दद्यान्नरविमानं तु कृष्णाय नरनायक ..
सत्कृतो धनदेनैव वसते ब्रह्मवासरम् .. 68 ..
15.23.m: O leader of men, if one gives a palanquin to Kṛṣṇa, / honored by Kubera himself, he dwells [there] for a day of Brahmā.

15.23.s:
kṛtā pūjā dikaṃ bhūpa jvalaṃtaṃ kṛṣṇamūrddhani ..
ārārtikaṃ prakurvāṇo modate kṛṣṇasannidhau .. 69 ..
15.23.d:
कृता पूजा दिकं भूप ज्वलंतं कृष्णमूर्द्धनि ..
आरार्तिकं प्रकुर्वाणो मोदते कृष्णसन्निधौ .. 69 ..
15.23.m: O king, having performed worship and other rites, one performing the waving of burning lamps / over Kṛṣṇa's head rejoices in Kṛṣṇa's presence.

15.23.s:
dīptimaṃtaṃ sakarpūraṃ karotyārārtikaṃ nṛpa ..
kṛṣṇasya vasate loke saptakalpāni mānavaḥ .. 7.4.23.70 ..
15.23.d:
दीप्तिमंतं सकर्पूरं करोत्यारार्तिकं नृप ..
कृष्णस्य वसते लोके सप्तकल्पानि मानवः .. 7.4.23.70 ..
15.23.m: O king, the mortal who performs the luminous waving of lamps with camphor, / dwells in the world of Kṛṣṇa for seven kalpas.

15.23.s:
dhṛtvā śaṃkhodakaṃ yastu bhrāmayetkeśavopari ..
saṃnidhau vasate viṣṇoḥ kalpāṃtaṃ kṣīrasāgare .. 71 ..
15.23.d:
धृत्वा शंखोदकं यस्तु भ्रामयेत्केशवोपरि ..
संनिधौ वसते विष्णोः कल्पांतं क्षीरसागरे .. 71 ..
15.23.m: Holding water from a conch, whoever circles it over Keśava, / dwells in the presence of Viṣṇu in the ocean of milk until the end of a kalpa.

15.23.s:
evaṃ kṛtvā tu kṛpṇasya yaḥ karoti pradakṣiṇām ..
paṭhannāmasahasraṃ tu stavamanyaṃ paṭhannṛpa ..
saptadvīpavatīpuṇyaṃ labhate tu padepade .. 72 ..
15.23.d:
