एवं कृत्वा तु कृप्णस्य यः करोति प्रदक्षिणाम् ..
पठन्नामसहस्रं तु स्तवमन्यं पठन्नृप ..
सप्तद्वीपवतीपुण्यं लभते तु पदेपदे .. 72 ..
15.23.m: Having done this, whoever circumambulates Kṛṣṇa / while reciting the Thousand Names or reciting another praise, O king, / obtains at every step the merit of [gifting] the seven-continented earth.

15.23.s:
kuryyāddaṇḍanamaskāramaśvamedhāyutaiḥ samam ..
kṛṣṇaṃ saṃtoṣayedyastu sugītairmadhuraiḥ svaraiḥ ..
sāmavedaphalaṃ tasya jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 73 ..
15.23.d:
कुर्य्याद्दण्डनमस्कारमश्वमेधायुतैः समम् ..
कृष्णं संतोषयेद्यस्तु सुगीतैर्मधुरैः स्वरैः ..
सामवेदफलं तस्य जायते नात्र संशयः .. 73 ..
15.23.m: One should offer prostration like a staff, which equals ten thousand horse sacrifices. / Whoever pleases Kṛṣṇa with sweet, well-sung melodies, / his reward equals that of the Sāmaveda; there is no doubt in this.

15.23.s:
yo nṛtyati prahṛṣṭātmā bhāvairbahu subhaktitaḥ ..
sa nirddahati pāpāni manvaṃtarakṛtānyapi .. 74 ..
15.23.d:
यो नृत्यति प्रहृष्टात्मा भावैर्बहु सुभक्तितः ..
स निर्द्दहति पापानि मन्वंतरकृतान्यपि .. 74 ..
15.23.m: Whoever dances with an exultant heart, displaying many devotional moods with deep devotion, / burns away even sins committed over the course of a manvantara.

15.23.s:
yaḥ kṛṣṇāgre mahābhaktyā kuryyātpustakavācanam ..
pratyakṣaraṃ labhetpuṇyaṃ kapilāśatadānajam .. .75..
15.23.d:
यः कृष्णाग्रे महाभक्त्या कुर्य्यात्पुस्तकवाचनम् ..
प्रत्यक्षरं लभेत्पुण्यं कपिलाशतदानजम् .. .75..
15.23.m: Whoever recites sacred texts with great devotion before Kṛṣṇa / attains at each syllable the merit born of the gift of a hundred kapilā cows.

15.23.s:
ṛgyajuḥsāmabhirvāgbhiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ saṃtoṣayaṃti ye ..
kalpāṃtaṃ brahmaloke tu te vasaṃti dvijottamāḥ .. 76 ..
15.23.d:
ऋग्यजुःसामभिर्वाग्भिः कृष्णं संतोषयंति ये ..
कल्पांतं ब्रह्मलोके तु ते वसंति द्विजोत्तमाः .. 76 ..
15.23.m: Those excellent twice-born who delight Kṛṣṇa with verses from the Ṛg, Yajus, and Sāma, / dwell in the world of Brahmā until the end of a kalpa.

15.23.s:
yogaśāstrāṇi vedāṃtā npurāṇaṃ kṛṣṇasannidhau ..
paṭhaṃti ravibiṃbaṃ te bhittvā yāṃti harerlayam .. 77 ..
15.23.d:
योगशास्त्राणि वेदांता न्पुराणं कृष्णसन्निधौ ..
पठंति रविबिंबं ते भित्त्वा यांति हरेर्लयम् .. 77 ..
15.23.m: Those who recite Yoga treatises, Vedānta texts, and the Purāṇa in the presence of Kṛṣṇa, / pierce the orb of the sun and attain union with Hari.

15.23.s:
gītā nāmasahasraṃ tu stavarājo hyanusmṛtiḥ ..
gajendramokṣaṇaṃ caiva kṛṣṇasyātīva vallabham .. 78 ..
15.23.d:
गीता नामसहस्रं तु स्तवराजो ह्यनुस्मृतिः ..
गजेन्द्रमोक्षणं चैव कृष्णस्यातीव वल्लभम् .. 78 ..
15.23.m: The Bhagavadgītā, the Thousand Names, the Stavarāja, the Anusmṛti, / and the Liberation of Gajendra are exceedingly dear to Kṛṣṇa.

15.23.s:
śrīmadrāgavataṃ yastu paṭhate kṛṣṇasannidhau ..
kulakoṭiśatairyuktaḥ krīḍate yogibhiḥ sadā .. 79 ..
15.23.d:
श्रीमद्रागवतं यस्तु पठते कृष्णसन्निधौ ..
कुलकोटिशतैर्युक्तः क्रीडते योगिभिः सदा .. 79 ..
15.23.m: Whoever recites the Śrīmad Bhāgavata in the presence of Kṛṣṇa, / accompanied by hundreds of millions of his kin, plays forever with the yogis.

15.23.s:
yaḥ paṭhedrāmacaritaṃ bhārataṃ vyāsabhāṣitam ..
purāṇāni mahīpāla prāpto muktiṃ na saṃśayaḥ ..7.4.23.80..
15.23.d:
यः पठेद्रामचरितं भारतं व्यासभाषितम् ..
पुराणानि महीपाल प्राप्तो मुक्तिं न संशयः ..7.4.23.80..
15.23.m: Whoever recites the deeds of Rāma, the Bhārata spoken by Vyāsa, / or the Purāṇas, O king, has attained liberation, there is no doubt.

15.23.s:
dvādaśīvāsare prāpta evaṃ kurvaṃti ye narāḥ ..
gītādyaiḥ śatasāhasraṃ puṇyaṃ yacchati keśavaḥ .. 81..
15.23.d:
द्वादशीवासरे प्राप्त एवं कुर्वंति ये नराः ..
गीताद्यैः शतसाहस्रं पुण्यं यच्छति केशवः .. 81..
15.23.m: Men who do thus when the twelfth lunar day has arrived, / through the Gītā and other texts, Keśava grants them a hundred thousandfold merit.

15.23.s:
jāgare koṭiguṇitaṃ puṇyaṃ bhavati bhūbhipa ..
vasatāṃ dvārakāvāsātpratyahaṃ labhate phalam ..82..
15.23.d:
जागरे कोटिगुणितं पुण्यं भवति भूभिप ..
वसतां द्वारकावासात्प्रत्यहं लभते फलम् ..82..
15.23.m: O king, the merit is multiplied ten-millionfold during a night vigil. / For those who dwell [there], every day reaps the fruit of residence in Dvārakā.

15.23.s:
gomatīnīrapūtānāṃ kṛṣṇavaktrāvaloki nām ..
darśanātpātakaṃ teṣāṃ yāti varṣaśatārjitam ..83..
15.23.d:
गोमतीनीरपूतानां कृष्णवक्त्रावलोकि नाम् ..
दर्शनात्पातकं तेषां याति वर्षशतार्जितम् ..83..
15.23.m: For those purified by the waters of the Gomatī, who gaze upon Kṛṣṇa's face, / the sin accumulated over a hundred years is dispelled merely by sight of them.

15.23.s:
dhanyāste mānuṣe loke gomatyudadhivāriṇā..
tarpayaṃti pitṝndevāngatvā dvāravatīṃ kalau .. ..84..
15.23.d:
धन्यास्ते मानुषे लोके गोमत्युदधिवारिणा..
तर्पयंति पितॄन्देवान्गत्वा द्वारवतीं कलौ .. ..84..
15.23.m: Blessed are those in the world of mortals who, having gone to Dvāravatī in the Kali age, / offer libations to the ancestors and the gods with the waters of the ocean and the Gomatī.

15.23.s:
gaṃgādvāre prayāge ca gaṃgāyāṃ kurujāṃgale ..
prabhāse śuklatīrthe ca śrīsthale puṣkare'pi ca ..85..
15.23.d:
गंगाद्वारे प्रयागे च गंगायां कुरुजांगले ..
प्रभासे शुक्लतीर्थे च श्रीस्थले पुष्करेऽपि च ..85..
15.23.m: At Gaṅgādvāra, Prayāga, along the Gaṅgā, in Kurujāṅgala, / at Prabhāsa, Śuklatīrtha, Śrīsthala, and Puṣkara,

15.23.s:
snānena piṃḍadānena pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇe kṛte ..
tṛptirbhavati bhūpāla tathā gomatidarśanāt ..86..
15.23.d:
स्नानेन पिंडदानेन पितॄणां तर्पणे कृते ..
तृप्तिर्भवति भूपाल तथा गोमतिदर्शनात् ..86..
15.23.m: when satisfaction is offered to the ancestors by ritual ablution, the offering of rice-balls, and libations, / O king, the same satisfaction comes from the darśana of the Gomatī.

15.23.s:
yojanairbahubhistiṣṭhangomatīti ca yo vadet ..
cāṃdrāyaṇasahasrasya phalamāpnoti yatnataḥ .. 87 ..
15.23.d:
योजनैर्बहुभिस्तिष्ठन्गोमतीति च यो वदेत् ..
चांद्रायणसहस्रस्य फलमाप्नोति यत्नतः .. 87 ..
15.23.m: Whoever, standing even many yojanas away, utters 'Gomatī!', / easily obtains the fruit of a thousand cāndrāyaṇa penances.

15.23.s:
dhanyā dvāravatī loke vahate yatra gomatī ..
svayaṃ tu tiṣṭhate yatra nityaṃ rukmiṇivallabhaḥ ..88..
15.23.d:
धन्या द्वारवती लोके वहते यत्र गोमती ..
स्वयं तु तिष्ठते यत्र नित्यं रुक्मिणिवल्लभः ..88..
15.23.m: Blessed is Dvāravatī in the world, where the Gomatī flows, / and where the beloved of Rukmiṇī always dwells in person.

15.23.s:
na snātā gomatītīre kalau pāpena mohitāḥ ..
bhaviṣyati kathaṃ teṣāṃ pāpabaṃdhasya saṃkṣayaḥ .. 89 ..
15.23.d:
न स्नाता गोमतीतीरे कलौ पापेन मोहिताः ..
भविष्यति कथं तेषां पापबंधस्य संक्षयः .. 89 ..
15.23.m: Those deluded by sin in the Kali age who have not bathed on the banks of the Gomatī— / how will the destruction of their bond of sins come about?

15.23.s:
nirmitā svarganiḥśreṇī kalau kṛṣṇena gomatī ..
manasaḥ prītijananī jaṃtūnāṃ narasattama .. 7.4.23.90 ..
15.23.d:
निर्मिता स्वर्गनिःश्रेणी कलौ कृष्णेन गोमती ..
मनसः प्रीतिजननी जंतूनां नरसत्तम .. 7.4.23.90 ..
15.23.m: A ladder to heaven, the Gomatī was fashioned in the Kali age by Kṛṣṇa; / it generates joy in the minds of creatures, O best of men.

15.23.s:
na dṛśyaṃ svargasopānaṃ dṛśyate gomatīsamam..
sukhadaṃ pāpināṃ puṃsāṃ snānamātreṇa mokṣadam .. 91 ..
15.23.d:
न दृश्यं स्वर्गसोपानं दृश्यते गोमतीसमम्..
सुखदं पापिनां पुंसां स्नानमात्रेण मोक्षदम् .. 91 ..
15.23.m: No stairway to heaven is seen that is equal to the Gomatī; / it gives happiness to sinful men, granting liberation through mere ablution.

15.23.s:
gomatīnīrasaṃyukto yatra garjati sāgaraḥ ..
tatra gacchennaravyāghra kṛṣṇastiṣṭhati yatra vai.. 92 ..
15.23.d:
गोमतीनीरसंयुक्तो यत्र गर्जति सागरः ..
तत्र गच्छेन्नरव्याघ्र कृष्णस्तिष्ठति यत्र वै.. 92 ..
15.23.m: Where the ocean roars, joined with the waters of the Gomatī, / there one should go, O tiger among men, where Kṛṣṇa truly resides.

15.23.s:
yatra cakrāṃkitaśilā gomatyudadhiniḥsṛtāḥ ..
yacchaṃti pūjitā mokṣaṃ tāṃ purīṃ ko na sevate .. 93 ..
15.23.d:
यत्र चक्रांकितशिला गोमत्युदधिनिःसृताः ..
यच्छंति पूजिता मोक्षं तां पुरीं को न सेवते .. 93 ..
15.23.m: Where stones marked with discs come forth from the ocean of the Gomatī, / which when worshipped grant liberation—who would not resort to that city?

15.23.s:
yatra cakrāṃkitā mṛtsnā tiṣṭhate nirmalā nṛpa ..
kalau pāpavināśārthaṃ tāṃ purīṃ ko na sevate .. 94 ..
15.23.d:
यत्र चक्रांकिता मृत्स्ना तिष्ठते निर्मला नृप ..
कलौ पापविनाशार्थं तां पुरीं को न सेवते .. 94 ..
15.23.m: Where pure earth marked with disc-shapes is found, O king, / who would not resort to that city to destroy sins in the Kali age?

15.23.s:
apradṛśyā purā loke daityadānavarakṣasām ..
śaraṇyā devatādīnāṃ purīṃ tāṃ ko na sevate .. 95 ..
15.23.d:
अप्रदृश्या पुरा लोके दैत्यदानवरक्षसाम् ..
शरण्या देवतादीनां पुरीं तां को न सेवते .. 95 ..
15.23.m: Formerly invisible in the world to Daityas, Dānavas, and Rākṣasas, / a refuge to the gods and others: who would not resort to that city?

15.23.s:
tyajate yāṃ kalau naiva kṛṣṇo devakinandanaḥ ..
karmaṇā manasā vācā tāṃ purīṃ ko na sevate .. 96 ..
15.23.d:
त्यजते यां कलौ नैव कृष्णो देवकिनन्दनः ..
कर्मणा मनसा वाचा तां पुरीं को न सेवते .. 96 ..
15.23.m: Which Kṛṣṇa, the son of Devakī, never leaves in the Kali age— / who would not resort to that city in action, mind, and speech?

15.23.s:
.. mārkaṃḍeya uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu rājanpravakṣyāmi kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm ..
yāṃ śrutvā mucyate nūnaṃ duḥkhasaṃsāra baṃdhanāt .. 97 ..
15.23.d:
.. मार्कंडेय उवाच .. ..
शृणु राजन्प्रवक्ष्यामि कथां पापप्रणाशिनीम् ..
यां श्रुत्वा मुच्यते नूनं दुःखसंसार बंधनात् .. 97 ..
15.23.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Listen, O king; I shall tell a story that destroys sin, / hearing which one is surely released from the bondage of sorrowful saṃsāra.

15.23.s:
avantīviṣaye pūrvaṃ brāhmaṇo vedapāragaḥ ..
caṃdraśarmeti vikhyātaḥ śivabhaktaḥ sadā nṛpa .. 98 ..
15.23.d:
अवन्तीविषये पूर्वं ब्राह्मणो वेदपारगः ..
चंद्रशर्मेति विख्यातः शिवभक्तः सदा नृप .. 98 ..
15.23.m: Formerly, in the region of Avantī, there was a brahmin who had mastered the Vedas, / famed as Candraśarman, who was always a devotee of Śiva, O king.

15.23.s:
manasā karmaṇā vācā nānyaṃ dhyāti sadāśivāt ..
śaivādvratādvrataṃ nānyatkaroti ca narādhipa .. 99 ..
15.23.d:
मनसा कर्मणा वाचा नान्यं ध्याति सदाशिवात् ..
शैवाद्व्रताद्व्रतं नान्यत्करोति च नराधिप .. 99 ..
15.23.m: In mind, action, and speech, he meditated on none other than Sadāśiva; / nor did he perform any observance other than a Śaiva observance, O ruler of men.

15.23.s:
nopavāsaṃ haridine kurute na vrataṃ hareḥ ..
vinā caturdaśīṃ rājannānyadevasamudbhavam .. 7.4.23.100 ..
15.23.d:
नोपवासं हरिदिने कुरुते न व्रतं हरेः ..
विना चतुर्दशीं राजन्नान्यदेवसमुद्भवम् .. 7.4.23.100 ..
15.23.m: He observed no fast on the day of Hari, nor any observance of Hari; / except for the fourteenth [lunar day], O king, he observed none arising from any other deity.

15.23.s:
yatrayatra śivakṣetraṃ yatra tīrthaṃ tu śāṃkaram ..
tatra gacchati rājendra vaiṣṇavaṃ naiva gacchati .. 101 ..
15.23.d:
यत्रयत्र शिवक्षेत्रं यत्र तीर्थं तु शांकरम् ..
तत्र गच्छति राजेन्द्र वैष्णवं नैव गच्छति .. 101 ..
15.23.m: Wherever there was a kṣetra of Śiva, wherever there was a tīrtha sacred to Śaṅkara, / thither he went, O lord of kings; to a Vaiṣṇava one he would never go.

15.23.s:
prativarṣaṃ tu kurute somanāthasya darśanam ..
na jahāti viśeṣeṇa somaparva nareśvara .. 102 ..
15.23.d:
प्रतिवर्षं तु कुरुते सोमनाथस्य दर्शनम् ..
न जहाति विशेषेण सोमपर्व नरेश्वर .. 102 ..
15.23.m: Year after year he had darśana of Somanātha; / he never missed the lunar conjunction, in particular, O lord of men.

15.23.s:
evaṃ prakurvatastasya varṣāṇi navasaptatiḥ ..
gatāni kila rājendra śivabhaktiṃ prakurvataḥ..103..
15.23.d:
एवं प्रकुर्वतस्तस्य वर्षाणि नवसप्ततिः ..
गतानि किल राजेन्द्र शिवभक्तिं प्रकुर्वतः..103..
15.23.m: As he continued thus, seventy-nine years / passed, O lord of kings, while he practiced devotion to Śiva.

15.23.s:
kadācitsomaparvaṇyāgate somopanāyakam..
nānādeśānmahīpāla hyasaṃkhyātāśca mānavāḥ.. 104..
15.23.d:
कदाचित्सोमपर्वण्यागते सोमोपनायकम्..
नानादेशान्महीपाल ह्यसंख्याताश्च मानवाः.. 104..
15.23.m: Once, when the lunar festival arrived at [the shrine of] Somanātha, / innumerable people from various regions, O ruler of the earth,

15.23.s:
gatāḥ kṛṣṇapurīṃ sarve dṛṣṭvā someśvaraṃ prabhum..
āhūtastaiścaṃdraśarmā na gato dvārakāṃ purīm..105..
15.23.d:
गताः कृष्णपुरीं सर्वे दृष्ट्वा सोमेश्वरं प्रभुम्..
आहूतस्तैश्चंद्रशर्मा न गतो द्वारकां पुरीम्..105..
15.23.m: having seen Lord Someśvara, all went to the city of Kṛṣṇa. / Candraśarman was invited by them, yet he did not go to the city of Dvārakā.

15.23.s:
śivakṣetrātparaṃ tīrthaṃ nāhaṃ manye jaga ttraye ..
nānyadevo mayā jñāta īśvarāddevanāyakāt .. 106 ..
15.23.d:
शिवक्षेत्रात्परं तीर्थं नाहं मन्ये जग त्त्रये ..
नान्यदेवो मया ज्ञात ईश्वराद्देवनायकात् .. 106 ..
15.23.m: [Thinking:] 'I consider no tīrtha in the three worlds higher than a Śaiva kṣetra; / no other deity is known to me than Īśvara, the leader of the gods.'

15.23.s:
vinā'nye caṃdraśarmāṇaṃ gatāste dvārakāṃ purīm ..
anyasmindivase rājangacchataḥ svagṛhaṃ prati ..
cakruste darśanaṃ svapne caṃdraśarmapitāmahāḥ .. 108 ..
15.23.d:
विनाऽन्ये चंद्रशर्माणं गतास्ते द्वारकां पुरीम् ..
अन्यस्मिन्दिवसे राजन्गच्छतः स्वगृहं प्रति ..
चक्रुस्ते दर्शनं स्वप्ने चंद्रशर्मपितामहाः .. 108 ..
15.23.m: Without Candraśarman, the others went to the city of Dvārakā. / On another day, O king, as he was going toward his own home, / Candraśarman’s ancestors appeared to him in a dream.

15.23.s:
pretabhūtā mahākāyāḥ kṣutkṣāmāścaiva bhīṣaṇāḥ ..
dṛṣṭvā svapnaṃ mahā raudraṃ bhīto'sau ca prakaṃpitaḥ .. 109 ..
15.23.d:
प्रेतभूता महाकायाः क्षुत्क्षामाश्चैव भीषणाः ..
दृष्ट्वा स्वप्नं महा रौद्रं भीतोऽसौ च प्रकंपितः .. 109 ..
15.23.m: They had become ghosts, huge-bodied, emaciated with hunger, and terrifying. / Having seen that dreadful dream, he was frightened and trembled violently.

15.23.s:
.. candraśarmovāca .. ..
ke yūyaṃ vikṛtākārā jaṃtūnāṃ ca bhayānakāḥ ..
pṛthvīsamudbhavā jīvā na dṛṣṭā na śrutā mayā .. 7.4.23.110 ..
15.23.d:
.. चन्द्रशर्मोवाच .. ..
के यूयं विकृताकारा जंतूनां च भयानकाः ..
पृथ्वीसमुद्भवा जीवा न दृष्टा न श्रुता मया .. 7.4.23.110 ..
15.23.m: Candraśarman said: / 'Who are you, deformed in shape and frightening to living beings? / Such living beings born of the earth have neither been seen nor heard of by me.'

15.23.s:
.. pretā ūcuḥ .. ..
mā bhayaṃ kuru vipreṃdra tava pūrvapitāmahāḥ ..
āgatāstvatsamīpe tu mahāduḥkhena pīḍitāḥ .. 111 .. ..
15.23.d:
.. प्रेता ऊचुः .. ..
मा भयं कुरु विप्रेंद्र तव पूर्वपितामहाः ..
आगतास्त्वत्समीपे तु महादुःखेन पीडिताः .. 111 .. ..
15.23.m: The ghosts said: / 'Do not fear, O best of brahmins! We are your paternal ancestors; / we have come near you, tormented by great sorrow.'

15.23.s:
.. candraśarmovāca .. ..
iṣṭaṃ dattaṃ tapastaptaṃ bhavadbhirmatpitāmahaiḥ ..
pretatve kāraṇaṃ yatsyādbhavatāṃ vismayo mama ..112..
15.23.d:
.. चन्द्रशर्मोवाच .. ..
इष्टं दत्तं तपस्तप्तं भवद्भिर्मत्पितामहैः ..
प्रेतत्वे कारणं यत्स्याद्भवतां विस्मयो मम ..112..
15.23.m: Candraśarman said: / 'Sacrifices were performed, gifts given, austerities practiced by you, my ancestors! / What could be the cause of your state as ghosts? It is a wonder to me.'

15.23.s:
.. pretā ūcuḥ .. ..
śṛṇu putra pravakṣyāmaḥ pretayonestu kāraṇam ..
vāsaraṃ vāsudevasya sadā viddhaṃ kṛtaṃ purā .. 113 ..
15.23.d:
.. प्रेता ऊचुः .. ..
शृणु पुत्र प्रवक्ष्यामः प्रेतयोनेस्तु कारणम् ..
वासरं वासुदेवस्य सदा विद्धं कृतं पुरा .. 113 ..
15.23.m: The ghosts said: / 'Listen, son, we shall tell the cause of our ghostly state: / in the past, the day of Vāsudeva was always observed by us as overlapped [by another tithi].

15.23.s:
pretatvaṃ tena saṃprāptamasmābhiḥ śṛṇu putraka ..
viśeṣeṇa kṛtaṃ rātrau viddhaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ hareḥ .. 114 ..
15.23.d:
प्रेतत्वं तेन संप्राप्तमस्माभिः शृणु पुत्रक ..
विशेषेण कृतं रात्रौ विद्धं जागरणं हरेः .. 114 ..
15.23.m: Because of that, the state of ghosts was incurred by us—listen, my child! / Especially, at night, the vigil of Hari was kept while overlapped.

15.23.s:
patanaṃ narake ghore bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ..
tvayā saha na saṃdeho yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam .. 115 ..
15.23.d:
पतनं नरके घोरे भविष्यति न संशयः ..
त्वया सह न संदेहो यावदाभूतसंप्लवम् .. 115 ..
15.23.m: There will be a fall into a dreadful hell, of this there is no doubt; / together with you, there is no question, until the dissolution of all beings.'

15.23.s:
candraśarmovāca .. ..
haribhaktivihīnānāṃ dvādaśīvratavarjinām..
nāśaṃ na yāti pretatvaṃ pūjitaiḥ śaṃkarādibhiḥ ..116..
15.23.d:
चन्द्रशर्मोवाच .. ..
हरिभक्तिविहीनानां द्वादशीव्रतवर्जिनाम्..
नाशं न याति प्रेतत्वं पूजितैः शंकरादिभिः ..116..
15.23.m: Candraśarman said: / 'For those devoid of devotion to Hari and avoiding the observance of Dvādaśī, / does the state of ghosts not reach destruction when Śaṃkara and others are worshipped?

15.23.s:
na vā santoṣito devo bhaktyā tripuranāśanaḥ ..
pradāsyati gatiṃ nūnaṃ pretatvaṃ na gamiṣyati .. 117 ..
15.23.d:
न वा सन्तोषितो देवो भक्त्या त्रिपुरनाशनः ..
प्रदास्यति गतिं नूनं प्रेतत्वं न गमिष्यति .. 117 ..
15.23.m: Or will the god who destroyed the three cities, pleased with devotion, / not surely grant the higher path? Will the ghostly state not depart?'

15.23.s:
.. pretā ūcuḥ .. ..
prāyaścittaṃ vinā putra dvādaśīvedhasaṃbhavam ..
āpanna gacchate nūnaṃ pretatvaṃ naiva gacchati .. 118 ..
15.23.d:
.. प्रेता ऊचुः .. ..
प्रायश्चित्तं विना पुत्र द्वादशीवेधसंभवम् ..
आपन्न गच्छते नूनं प्रेतत्वं नैव गच्छति .. 118 ..
15.23.m: The ghosts said: / 'Without expiation, son, for that which arises from the overlap on Dvādaśī, / calamity surely does not depart, nor does the ghostly state ever leave.

15.23.s:
prāyaścittī sadā putra pūjayāno'pi śaṃkaram ..
vinā keśavapūjābhiḥ pāpaṃ bhajati govadham .. 119 ..
15.23.d:
प्रायश्चित्ती सदा पुत्र पूजयानोऽपि शंकरम् ..
विना केशवपूजाभिः पापं भजति गोवधम् .. 119 ..
15.23.m: Even while worshipping Śaṃkara, son, one who needs expiation / incurs the sin of cow-slaughter without the worship of Keśava.

15.23.s:
prathamaṃ keśavaḥ pūjyaḥ paścāddevo maheśvaraḥ ..
pūjanīyāśca bhaktyā vai yāścānyāḥ saṃti devatāḥ .. 7.4.23.120 ..
15.23.d:
प्रथमं केशवः पूज्यः पश्चाद्देवो महेश्वरः ..
पूजनीयाश्च भक्त्या वै याश्चान्याः संति देवताः .. 7.4.23.120 ..
15.23.m: First Keśava should be worshipped, and afterward the god Maheśvara; / and whatever other deities exist are to be worshipped with devotion.

15.23.s:
mūlācchākhāḥ praśākhāśca bhavaṃti bahuśastataḥ ..
vāsudevātsamudbhūtaṃ jagadetaccarācaram.. 121 ..
15.23.d:
मूलाच्छाखाः प्रशाखाश्च भवंति बहुशस्ततः ..
वासुदेवात्समुद्भूतं जगदेतच्चराचरम्.. 121 ..
15.23.m: From the root, branches and twigs arise in abundance; / so this entire world, moving and unmoving, has arisen from Vāsudeva.

15.23.s:
tasmānmūlaṃ parityajya śākhāṃ naivārcayedbudhaḥ ..
viśeṣeṇa jagannāthaṃ trailokyādhipatiṃ harim .. 122..
15.23.d:
तस्मान्मूलं परित्यज्य शाखां नैवार्चयेद्बुधः ..
विशेषेण जगन्नाथं त्रैलोक्याधिपतिं हरिम् .. 122..
15.23.m: Therefore, abandoning the root, a wise man should not worship the branch, / especially Hari, the lord of the universe and ruler of the three worlds.

15.23.s:
taddine ye prakurvaṃti samyagvedhena śobhitam ..
saśalyaṃ tanna saṃdehaḥ pretatvaṃ yāti tena ca .. 123 ..
15.23.d:
तद्दिने ये प्रकुर्वंति सम्यग्वेधेन शोभितम् ..
सशल्यं तन्न संदेहः प्रेतत्वं याति तेन च .. 123 ..
15.23.m: Those who observe that day marred by a flawed overlap, / that [day] is pierced with a defect, there is no doubt; and thereby one incurs the state of a ghost.

15.23.s:
havyaṃ devā na gṛhṇanti kavyaṃ ca pitarastathā ..
pūjāṃ gṛhṇāti no sūryastathā caiva pitāmahāḥ .. 124 ..
15.23.d:
हव्यं देवा न गृह्णन्ति कव्यं च पितरस्तथा ..
पूजां गृह्णाति नो सूर्यस्तथा चैव पितामहाः .. 124 ..
15.23.m: The gods do not accept the oblation, nor do the ancestors accept the funeral offering; / the sun does not accept the worship, and likewise the ancestors do not.

15.23.s:
pretāste ye prakurvaṃti saśalyaṃ vāsaraṃ hareḥ ..
paurṇamāsīdvaye prāpte rākā sāgnivivarjitā .. 125 ..
15.23.d:
प्रेतास्ते ये प्रकुर्वंति सशल्यं वासरं हरेः ..
पौर्णमासीद्वये प्राप्ते राका साग्निविवर्जिता .. 125 ..
15.23.m: They become ghosts who observe the day of Hari pierced by a flaw. / When two full-moon days occur, Rākā is without consecrated fire.

15.23.s:
viśeṣeṇa tu vaiśākhī śrāddhādīnāṃ praśasyate ..
vaiśākhe tu tṛtīyāṃ vai pūrvaviddhāṃ karoti yaḥ .. 126 ..
15.23.d:
विशेषेण तु वैशाखी श्राद्धादीनां प्रशस्यते ..
वैशाखे तु तृतीयां वै पूर्वविद्धां करोति यः .. 126 ..
15.23.m: The full-moon of Vaiśākha, in particular, is commended for ancestral rites and the like. / But he who observes the third [lunar day] of Vaiśākha when overlapped by the preceding day,

15.23.s:
havyaṃ devā na gṛhṇaṃti kavyaṃ caiva pitāmahāḥ..
yatra devā na gṛhṇaṃti kathaṃ tatra pitāmahāḥ ..
tasmātkāryyā tṛtīyā ca pūrvaviddhā budhairnaraiḥ .. 127 ..
15.23.d:
हव्यं देवा न गृह्णंति कव्यं चैव पितामहाः..
यत्र देवा न गृह्णंति कथं तत्र पितामहाः ..
तस्मात्कार्य्या तृतीया च पूर्वविद्धा बुधैर्नरैः .. 127 ..
15.23.m: the gods do not accept the oblation, nor do the ancestors accept the funeral offering. / Where the gods do not accept, how could the ancestors accept there? / Therefore the third [tithi] must [not] be observed as overlapped by the preceding day by wise men.

15.23.s:
kurvate yadi mohādvā pretatvaṃ śāśvataṃ tataḥ ..
nāpayāti kṛtaiḥ puṇyairbahuśastīrthasevanaiḥ .. 128 ..
15.23.d:
कुर्वते यदि मोहाद्वा प्रेतत्वं शाश्वतं ततः ..
नापयाति कृतैः पुण्यैर्बहुशस्तीर्थसेवनैः .. 128 ..
15.23.m: If they observe it through delusion, then perpetual ghostly existence follows; / it does not depart even through merits performed and numerous visits to tīrthas.

15.23.s:
daśamīṃ paurṇamāsīṃ ca pitroḥ sāṃvatsaraṃ dinam ..
pūrvaviddhaṃ prakurvāṇo narakaṃ pratipadyate .. 129..
15.23.d:
दशमीं पौर्णमासीं च पित्रोः सांवत्सरं दिनम् ..
पूर्वविद्धं प्रकुर्वाणो नरकं प्रतिपद्यते .. 129..
15.23.m: One who observes the tenth, the full-moon, or the annual day of one's parents / as overlapped by the preceding [tithi] goes to hell.

15.23.s:
darśaśca paurṇamāsī ca sāgnikaiḥ pūrvasaṃyutā ..
nāgnihīnaistu karttavyā punarāha prajāpatiḥ ..7.4.23.130..
15.23.d:
दर्शश्च पौर्णमासी च साग्निकैः पूर्वसंयुता ..
नाग्निहीनैस्तु कर्त्तव्या पुनराह प्रजापतिः ..7.4.23.130..
15.23.m: The new-moon day and the full-moon day combined with the preceding [tithi] are for those with sacrificial fires; / but Prajāpati stated again that they are not to be observed by those without sacrificial fires.

15.23.s:
kṣayāhe tu punaḥ proktā svakālavyāpinī tithiḥ ..
śrāddhaṃ tatra prakartavyaṃ hrāsavṛddhī na kāraṇam .. 131 ..
15.23.d:
क्षयाहे तु पुनः प्रोक्ता स्वकालव्यापिनी तिथिः ..
श्राद्धं तत्र प्रकर्तव्यं ह्रासवृद्धी न कारणम् .. 131 ..
15.23.m: On the anniversary of death, however, the tithi that covers its own proper time is prescribed; / the ancestral rite should be performed then; decrease or increase [of the tithi] is no concern.

15.23.s:
tatroktaṃ manunā putra vedāṃtairbhāṣyakāribhiḥ ..
tatpramāṇaṃ prakartavyaṃ pretatvaṃ bhavato'nyathā .. .. 132 ..
15.23.d:
तत्रोक्तं मनुना पुत्र वेदांतैर्भाष्यकारिभिः ..
तत्प्रमाणं प्रकर्तव्यं प्रेतत्वं भवतोऽन्यथा .. .. 132 ..
15.23.m: What has been stated there by Manu, son, and by the commentators on the Vedāntas— / that must be taken as authority; otherwise, the ghostly state will be yours.

15.23.s:
etai. prakāraiḥ pretatvaṃ prāṇināṃ jāyate bhuvi ..
nirīkṣya dharmaśāstrāṇi kāryyaṃ vihitamātmanaḥ .. 133 ..
15.23.d:
एतै. प्रकारैः प्रेतत्वं प्राणिनां जायते भुवि ..
निरीक्ष्य धर्मशास्त्राणि कार्य्यं विहितमात्मनः .. 133 ..
15.23.m: In these ways the ghostly state arises for living beings on earth; / having examined the Dharmaśāstras, what is ordained for oneself must be done.

15.23.s:
praṇamya somanāthaṃ tu yātrāṃ kṛtvā na gacchati ..
kṛṣṇasya darśanārthāya tasya kiṃ jāyate phalam .. 134 ..
15.23.d:
प्रणम्य सोमनाथं तु यात्रां कृत्वा न गच्छति ..
कृष्णस्य दर्शनार्थाय तस्य किं जायते फलम् .. 134 ..
15.23.m: Having bowed to Somanātha, if one having made the pilgrimage does not go / to have darśana of Kṛṣṇa, what fruit arises for him?

15.23.s:
kathyate paramā mūrtirharirīśvarasaṃ saṃsthitā..
vibhedo nātra kartavyo yathā śaṃbhustathā hariḥ.. 135..
15.23.d:
कथ्यते परमा मूर्तिर्हरिरीश्वरसं संस्थिता..
विभेदो नात्र कर्तव्यो यथा शंभुस्तथा हरिः.. 135..
15.23.m: It is declared that Hari is the supreme form residing in Īśvara; / no distinction should be made here: as is Śambhu, so is Hari.'

15.23.s:
kṛṣṇasya somanāthasya nāṃtaraṃ dṛśyate kvacit..
yātrā śrīsomanāthasya saṃpūrṇā kṛṣṇadarśanāt.. 136..
15.23.d:
कृष्णस्य सोमनाथस्य नांतरं दृश्यते क्वचित्..
यात्रा श्रीसोमनाथस्य संपूर्णा कृष्णदर्शनात्.. 136..
15.23.m: No difference at all is seen between Kṛṣṇa and Somanātha. / The pilgrimage to the venerable Somanātha is made complete by the darśana of Kṛṣṇa.

15.23.s:
tasmādubhayataḥ putra gantavyaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ..
dṛṣṭvā someśvaraṃ devaṃ gaṃtavyaṃ dvārakāṃ prati.. 137..
15.23.d:
तस्मादुभयतः पुत्र गन्तव्यं नात्र संशयः..
दृष्ट्वा सोमेश्वरं देवं गंतव्यं द्वारकां प्रति.. 137..
15.23.m: Therefore, O son, one must go to both; there is no doubt in this. / Having seen the god Someśvara, one should proceed toward Dvārakā.

15.23.s:
prabhāse somanāthasya liṃgamadhye vyavasthitaḥ ..
svayaṃ tiṣṭhati puṇyātmā bhogaṃ gṛhṇāti keśavaḥ .. 138 ..
15.23.d:
प्रभासे सोमनाथस्य लिंगमध्ये व्यवस्थितः ..
स्वयं तिष्ठति पुण्यात्मा भोगं गृह्णाति केशवः .. 138 ..
15.23.m: Stationed within the liṅga of Somanātha in Prabhāsa, / the meritorious Keśava stands himself and receives enjoyment.

15.23.s:
dṛṣṭvā someśvaraṃ devaṃ dvārakāṃ na naro gataḥ ..
patanaṃ narake ghore pitṝṇāṃ ca bhaviṣyati .. 139 ..
15.23.d:
दृष्ट्वा सोमेश्वरं देवं द्वारकां न नरो गतः ..
पतनं नरके घोरे पितॄणां च भविष्यति .. 139 ..
15.23.m: If a man, having seen the god Someśvara, does not go to Dvārakā, / there will be a fall into a terrible hell, for him and for his ancestors.

15.23.s:
viśeṣeṇa tvayā vatsa na kṛtaṃ dvādaśīvratam ..
vrataṃ kṛtaṃ yadasmābhistatkṛtaṃ vedhasaṃyutam ..
nirgamaṃ yamalokāddhi tadasmākaṃ na dṛśyate .. 7.4.23.140 ..
15.23.d:
विशेषेण त्वया वत्स न कृतं द्वादशीव्रतम् ..
व्रतं कृतं यदस्माभिस्तत्कृतं वेधसंयुतम् ..
निर्गमं यमलोकाद्धि तदस्माकं न दृश्यते .. 7.4.23.140 ..
15.23.m: In particular, O child, you have not observed the dvādaśī vow. / The vow that was performed by us was performed along with an overlap [with another tithi]; / therefore our departure from the world of Yama is not in sight.

15.23.s:
.. candraśarmovāca .. ..
yadi tāta mayā'jñānānna kṛtaṃ dvādaśīvratam ..
kasmātkṛtaṃ saśalyaṃ tu bhavadbhirdvādaśīvratam .. 141 ..
15.23.d:
.. चन्द्रशर्मोवाच .. ..
यदि तात मयाऽज्ञानान्न कृतं द्वादशीव्रतम् ..
कस्मात्कृतं सशल्यं तु भवद्भिर्द्वादशीव्रतम् .. 141 ..
15.23.m: Candraśarman said: / If, father, out of ignorance the dvādaśī vow was not performed by me, / why was the dvādaśī vow performed by you with a flaw?

15.23.s:
.. pretā ūcuḥ .. ..
kuvipraistu kudaivajñaiḥ śukramāyāvimohitaiḥ ..
pāruṣyatāhetukaiśca pretayonimimāṃ gatāḥ .. .. 142 ..
15.23.d:
.. प्रेता ऊचुः .. ..
कुविप्रैस्तु कुदैवज्ञैः शुक्रमायाविमोहितैः ..
पारुष्यताहेतुकैश्च प्रेतयोनिमिमां गताः .. .. 142 ..
15.23.m: The ghosts said: / Through bad brahmins and bad astrologers, deluded by the illusion of Śukra, / and through disputatious arguers, we have entered this state of ghosts.

15.23.s:
dattaṃ taptaṃ hutaṃ japtamasmākaṃ viphalaṃ gatam ..
saṃprāptā pretayonistu saśalyādvādaśīvratāt .. 143 ..
15.23.d:
दत्तं तप्तं हुतं जप्तमस्माकं विफलं गतम् ..
संप्राप्ता प्रेतयोनिस्तु सशल्याद्वादशीव्रतात् .. 143 ..
15.23.m: What was given, mortified, offered in oblation, and muttered by us has gone in vain; / the state of ghosts has been reached on account of the flawed dvādaśī vow.

15.23.s:
saśalyaṃ ye prakurvaṃti vāsaraṃ keśava priyam ..
teṣāṃ pitāmahāḥ svargātpretatvaṃ yāṃti putraka .. 144 ..
15.23.d:
सशल्यं ये प्रकुर्वंति वासरं केशव प्रियम् ..
तेषां पितामहाः स्वर्गात्प्रेतत्वं यांति पुत्रक .. 144 ..
15.23.m: Those who observe the day dear to Keśava with a flaw— / their grandfathers fall from heaven into the state of ghosts, O little son.

15.23.s:
.. candraśarmovāca .. ..
pretatvaṃ nāśamāyāti kathametatpitāmahāḥ ..
karmaṇā kena tatsarvaṃ yaccāhaṃ prakaromi tat .. 145 ..
15.23.d:
.. चन्द्रशर्मोवाच .. ..
प्रेतत्वं नाशमायाति कथमेतत्पितामहाः ..
कर्मणा केन तत्सर्वं यच्चाहं प्रकरोमि तत् .. 145 ..
15.23.m: Candraśarman said: / How does this ghosthood come to an end, O grandfathers? / By what action can all of it [be dispelled], that I might perform it?

15.23.s:
.. pretā ūcuḥ .. ..
mā gayāṃ mā prayāgaṃ ca puṣkare kurujāṃgale ..
ayodhyāyāmavaṃtyāṃ vā madhurāyāṃ na cārbude .. 146 ..
15.23.d:
.. प्रेता ऊचुः .. ..
मा गयां मा प्रयागं च पुष्करे कुरुजांगले ..
अयोध्यायामवंत्यां वा मधुरायां न चार्बुदे .. 146 ..
15.23.m: The ghosts said: / Not at Gayā, not at Prayāga, not at Puṣkara, nor in the Kurujāṅgala; / not in Ayodhyā, nor in Avanti, nor in Mathurā, nor on Mount Arbuda,

15.23.s:
na cānyattīrthalakṣaṃ tu varjayitvā tu gomatīm ..
gaṃgā sarasvatī caiva narmadā naiva puṣkaram .. 147 ..
15.23.d:
न चान्यत्तीर्थलक्षं तु वर्जयित्वा तु गोमतीम् ..
गंगा सरस्वती चैव नर्मदा नैव पुष्करम् .. 147 ..
15.23.m: nor in a hundred thousand other sacred fords, excluding the Gomatī— / not the Gaṅgā, nor the Sarasvatī, nor the Narmadā, nor Puṣkara—

15.23.s:
yādṛśaṃ gomatītīre kalau pretatvanāśanam ..
gomatīnīradānena kṛṣṇavaktravilokanāt .. 148 ..
15.23.d:
यादृशं गोमतीतीरे कलौ प्रेतत्वनाशनम् ..
गोमतीनीरदानेन कृष्णवक्त्रविलोकनात् .. 148 ..
15.23.m: as there is the destruction of ghosthood on the bank of the Gomatī in the Kali age, / through the offering of Gomatī water and through the gazing upon the face of Kṛṣṇa.

15.23.s:
vilayaṃ yāṃti pāpāni janmakoṭikṛtānyapi ..
vṛthā saṃnyāsināṃ puṇyaṃ vṛthā ca vanavāsinām .. 149 ..
15.23.d:
विलयं यांति पापानि जन्मकोटिकृतान्यपि ..
वृथा संन्यासिनां पुण्यं वृथा च वनवासिनाम् .. 149 ..
15.23.m: Sins committed even in ten million lifetimes go to dissolution. / Fruitless is the merit of renouncers, and fruitless that of forest-dwellers,

15.23.s:
saśalyaṃ vāsaraṃ viṣṇoḥ kurvaṃti yadi putraka ..
tasmādgaccha mukhaṃ paśya pūrṇacandrasamaṃ mukham .. 7.4.23.150 ..
15.23.d:
सशल्यं वासरं विष्णोः कुर्वंति यदि पुत्रक ..
तस्माद्गच्छ मुखं पश्य पूर्णचन्द्रसमं मुखम् .. 7.4.23.150 ..
15.23.m: if they observe the day of Viṣṇu with a flaw, O little son. / Therefore go, behold the face that is equal to the full moon!

15.23.s:
kṛṣṇasya dvārakāṃ gatvā yathāsmākaṃ gatirbhavet ..
viphalaṃ tava saṃjātā na kṛtaṃ yadupārjjitam .. 151 ..
15.23.d:
कृष्णस्य द्वारकां गत्वा यथास्माकं गतिर्भवेत् ..
विफलं तव संजाता न कृतं यदुपार्ज्जितम् .. 151 ..
15.23.m: Having gone to Dvārakā, [behold the face] of Kṛṣṇa, so that our good destination may come to pass. / It has become useless for you; what was accumulated was not done [aright].

15.23.s:
tadvyartha sakalaṃ jātaṃ vinā keśava pūjanāt ..
vinā keśavapūjāyāḥ śaṃkaro yastvayārccitaḥ ..
tatpuṇyaṃ viphalaṃ jātaṃ pretayoniṃ gamiṣyasi .. 152 ..
15.23.d:
तद्व्यर्थ सकलं जातं विना केशव पूजनात् ..
विना केशवपूजायाः शंकरो यस्त्वयार्च्चितः ..
तत्पुण्यं विफलं जातं प्रेतयोनिं गमिष्यसि .. 152 ..
15.23.m: All that has become futile without the worship of Keśava. / Because Śaṃkara was worshipped by you without the worship of Keśava, / that merit has become fruitless, and you will enter the state of ghosts.

15.23.s:
saṃpūrṇaṃ tava puṇyaṃ ca dvārakā kṛṣṇadarśanāt ..
bhaviṣyati na sandeho gomatyudadhisannidhau .. 153 ..
15.23.d:
संपूर्णं तव पुण्यं च द्वारका कृष्णदर्शनात् ..
भविष्यति न सन्देहो गोमत्युदधिसन्निधौ .. 153 ..
15.23.m: Your merit will become complete from the darśana of Kṛṣṇa in Dvārakā / near the ocean of the Gomatī; of this there is no doubt.

15.23.s:
dṛṣṭvā someśvaraṃ devaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ yadi na paśyati ..
yātrāphalaṃ na cāpnoti vadatyevaṃ svayaṃ śivaḥ .. 154 ..
15.23.d:
दृष्ट्वा सोमेश्वरं देवं कृष्णं यदि न पश्यति ..
यात्राफलं न चाप्नोति वदत्येवं स्वयं शिवः .. 154 ..
15.23.m: Having seen the god Someśvara, if one does not see Kṛṣṇa, / one does not obtain the fruit of the pilgrimage; so says Śiva himself:

15.23.s:
dṛṣṭo'haṃ tairna sandeho yaiḥ kṛtaṃ kṛṣṇadarśanam ..
ekā mūrtirna sandeho mama kṛṣṇasya nāṃtaram .. 155 ..
15.23.d:
दृष्टोऽहं तैर्न सन्देहो यैः कृतं कृष्णदर्शनम् ..
एका मूर्तिर्न सन्देहो मम कृष्णस्य नांतरम् .. 155 ..
15.23.m: ‘I have been seen by those—there is no doubt—by whom the darśana of Kṛṣṇa has been made; / there is one form, there is no doubt: there is no difference between me and Kṛṣṇa.

15.23.s:
dṛṣṭvā māṃ dvārakāṃ gatvā karttavyaṃ kṛṣṇadarśanam ..
dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ tu māṃ paśyedyāsyatyeva mahāphalam .. 156 ..
15.23.d:
दृष्ट्वा मां द्वारकां गत्वा कर्त्तव्यं कृष्णदर्शनम् ..
दृष्ट्वा कृष्णं तु मां पश्येद्यास्यत्येव महाफलम् .. 156 ..
15.23.m: Having seen me, one should go to Dvārakā and perform the darśana of Kṛṣṇa; / or having seen Kṛṣṇa, one should see me: he shall surely attain great fruit.

15.23.s:
kṛṣṇadarśanapūtātmā yo māṃ paśyati mānavaḥ ..
na tasya punarāvṛttirmama lokācca vaiṣṇavāt .. 157 ..
15.23.d:
कृष्णदर्शनपूतात्मा यो मां पश्यति मानवः ..
न तस्य पुनरावृत्तिर्मम लोकाच्च वैष्णवात् .. 157 ..
15.23.m: The man who, purified in soul by the darśana of Kṛṣṇa, sees me, / for him there is no return from my realm or from the Vaiṣṇava realm.’

15.23.s:
ityāha devadeveśaḥ svayaṃ somapatiḥ purā ..
viprāṇāṃ śrutamasmābhirvadatāṃ puṣkare satām .. 158 ..
15.23.d:
इत्याह देवदेवेशः स्वयं सोमपतिः पुरा ..
विप्राणां श्रुतमस्माभिर्वदतां पुष्करे सताम् .. 158 ..
15.23.m: Thus the lord of the gods of gods, the lord of Soma himself, spoke of old. / It was heard by us from virtuous brahmins speaking at Puṣkara.

15.23.s:
tasmādgaccha prayāṇārtha kuru kṛṣṇasya darśanam ..
anyathā yāsyase yoniṃ paiśācīṃ pāpadāyinīm .. 159 ..
15.23.d:
तस्माद्गच्छ प्रयाणार्थ कुरु कृष्णस्य दर्शनम् ..
अन्यथा यास्यसे योनिं पैशाचीं पापदायिनीम् .. 159 ..
15.23.m: Therefore go, set out on the journey, and perform the darśana of Kṛṣṇa; / otherwise you will enter a demonic womb that brings sin.

15.23.s:
kṛtāparādho'pi yadā kurute kṛṣṇadarśanam ..
mucyate nā'tra saṃdehaḥ pāpājjanmakṛtādapi .. 7.4.23.160 ..
15.23.d:
कृतापराधोऽपि यदा कुरुते कृष्णदर्शनम् ..
मुच्यते नाऽत्र संदेहः पापाज्जन्मकृतादपि .. 7.4.23.160 ..
15.23.m: Even if he has committed an offence, when one performs the darśana of Kṛṣṇa, / he is freed, of this there is no doubt, even from the sin accumulated over a lifetime.

15.23.s:
pūjite devadeveśe kṛṣṇe devakinandane ..
pūjitā devatāḥ sarvā brahmarudrabhagādikāḥ .. 161 ..
15.23.d:
पूजिते देवदेवेशे कृष्णे देवकिनन्दने ..
पूजिता देवताः सर्वा ब्रह्मरुद्रभगादिकाः .. 161 ..
15.23.m: When the lord of the gods of gods, Kṛṣṇa, the son of Devakī, is worshipped, / all deities, headed by Brahmā, Rudra, and Bhaga, are worshipped.

15.23.s:
vinā kṛṣṇasya pūjāṃ ca rudrādyāstridivaukasaḥ ..
pūjitā naiva kurvaṃti tuṣṭiṃ putra pitāmahāḥ .. 162 ..
15.23.d:
विना कृष्णस्य पूजां च रुद्राद्यास्त्रिदिवौकसः ..
पूजिता नैव कुर्वंति तुष्टिं पुत्र पितामहाः .. 162 ..
15.23.m: Without the worship of Kṛṣṇa, the heaven-dwellers headed by Rudra / when worshipped do not grant contentment at all, O son [and] grandfathers.

15.23.s:
tasmāddvāravatīṃ gatvā kṛṣṇasya darśanaṃ kuru ..
pretayonervinirmuktā yāsyāmaḥ paramāṃ gatim .. 163 ..
15.23.d:
तस्माद्द्वारवतीं गत्वा कृष्णस्य दर्शनं कुरु ..
प्रेतयोनेर्विनिर्मुक्ता यास्यामः परमां गतिम् .. 163 ..
15.23.m: Therefore, go to Dvāravatī and perform the darśana of Kṛṣṇa; / freed from the state of ghosts, we shall go to the supreme state.

15.23.s:
gomatīnīradhautāni yasyāṃgāni kalau yuge ..
munibhiryonigamanaṃ tasya dṛṣṭaṃ na putraka .. 164 ..
15.23.d:
गोमतीनीरधौतानि यस्यांगानि कलौ युगे ..
मुनिभिर्योनिगमनं तस्य दृष्टं न पुत्रक .. 164 ..
15.23.m: He whose limbs are washed by the water of the Gomatī in the Kali age, / his entering a womb is not seen by the sages, O little son.

15.23.s:
tāḍitāḥ pādayugmena gomatīnīravīcayaḥ ..
agatīnāṃ prakurvati gatiṃ vai brahmavādinām .. 165 ..
15.23.d:
ताडिताः पादयुग्मेन गोमतीनीरवीचयः ..
अगतीनां प्रकुर्वति गतिं वै ब्रह्मवादिनाम् .. 165 ..
15.23.m: The waves of the water of the Gomatī, struck by a pair of feet, / procure the state of the knowers of Brahman for those who have no refuge.

15.23.s:
yaḥ punaḥ kurute śrāddhaṃ gomatyudadhisaṃgame ..
pitṝṇāṃ jāyate tṛptiryāvadābhūtasaṃplavam .. 166 ..
15.23.d:
यः पुनः कुरुते श्राद्धं गोमत्युदधिसंगमे ..
पितॄणां जायते तृप्तिर्यावदाभूतसंप्लवम् .. 166 ..
15.23.m: Furthermore, whoever performs a śrāddha at the confluence of the Gomatī and the sea, / satisfaction arises for his ancestors until the dissolution of all beings.

15.23.s:
sasāgaradharāyāṃ ca sarvatīrtheṣu yatphalam ..
dinenaikena tatpuṇyaṃ dvārakākṛṣṇasannidhau .. 167 ..
15.23.d:
ससागरधरायां च सर्वतीर्थेषु यत्फलम् ..
दिनेनैकेन तत्पुण्यं द्वारकाकृष्णसन्निधौ .. 167 ..
15.23.m: Whatever fruit there is in all the sacred fords on the earth encircled by the ocean, / that merit is obtained in a single day in the presence of Kṛṣṇa in Dvārakā.

15.23.s:
yatphalaṃ tridaśairdṛṣṭaṃ sarvatīrthasamudbhavam ..
tatphalaṃ labhate sarvaṃ dvārakāyāṃ dinedine .. 168 ..
15.23.d:
यत्फलं त्रिदशैर्दृष्टं सर्वतीर्थसमुद्भवम् ..
तत्फलं लभते सर्वं द्वारकायां दिनेदिने .. 168 ..
15.23.m: Whatever fruit has been seen by the gods arising from all the sacred fords, / all that fruit one obtains day by day in Dvārakā.

15.23.s:
tīrthakoṭisahasraistu kṛtaiḥ śrāddhaiśca yatphalam ..
pitṝṇāṃ tatphalaṃ proktaṃ gomatītilatarpaṇāt .. 169 ..
15.23.d:
तीर्थकोटिसहस्रैस्तु कृतैः श्राद्धैश्च यत्फलम् ..
पितॄणां तत्फलं प्रोक्तं गोमतीतिलतर्पणात् .. 169 ..
15.23.m: Whatever fruit is attained by thousands of ten millions of sacred fords and by performed śrāddhas, / that fruit is declared for the ancestors from a sesame-water libation in the Gomatī.

15.23.s:
yatīnāṃ bhojanaṃ yastu yacchate kṛṣṇamandire ..
sikthesikthe bhavettṛptiḥ pitṝṇāṃ yugasaṃkhyayā .. 7.4.23.170 ..
15.23.d:
यतीनां भोजनं यस्तु यच्छते कृष्णमन्दिरे ..
सिक्थेसिक्थे भवेत्तृप्तिः पितॄणां युगसंख्यया .. 7.4.23.170 ..
15.23.m: Whoever gives food to ascetics in the temple of Kṛṣṇa, / with every single grain of boiled rice there is satisfaction for the ancestors for the number of a yuga.

15.23.s:
kaupīnācchādanaṃ chatraṃ pāduke ca kamaṇḍalum ..
dattvā saṃnyāsināṃ yāti sapta kalpāni tatphalam .. 171 ..
15.23.d:
कौपीनाच्छादनं छत्रं पादुके च कमण्डलुम् ..
दत्त्वा संन्यासिनां याति सप्त कल्पानि तत्फलम् .. 171 ..
15.23.m: Having given a loincloth cover, an umbrella, shoes, and a water-pot / to renouncers, that fruit of his lasts for seven kalpas.

15.23.s:
dhanyāste mānavāḥ putra vasanti śvapacādayaḥ ..
dvārakāyāṃ gatiṃ yāṃti vasatāṃ tatra yoginām .. .. 172 ..
15.23.d:
धन्यास्ते मानवाः पुत्र वसन्ति श्वपचादयः ..
द्वारकायां गतिं यांति वसतां तत्र योगिनाम् .. .. 172 ..
15.23.m: Fortunate are those men, O son—even outcasts and the like—who dwell / in Dvārakā; they attain the state of the yogins who dwell there.

15.23.s:
trikālaṃ ye prapaśyaṃti vadanaṃ pratyahaṃ hareḥ ..
na teṣāṃ punarāvṛttiḥ kalpakoṭiśatairapi .. 173 ..
15.23.d:
त्रिकालं ये प्रपश्यंति वदनं प्रत्यहं हरेः ..
न तेषां पुनरावृत्तिः कल्पकोटिशतैरपि .. 173 ..
15.23.m: Those who behold the face of Hari every day at the three times of the day / have no return even in hundreds of tens of millions of kalpas.

15.23.s:
yā nārī vidhavā bhūtvā kurute dvārakāśrayam ..
kulāyutasahasraṃ tu nayate paramaṃ padam .. 174 ..
15.23.d:
या नारी विधवा भूत्वा कुरुते द्वारकाश्रयम् ..
कुलायुतसहस्रं तु नयते परमं पदम् .. 174 ..
15.23.m: A woman who, having become a widow, takes refuge in Dvārakā, / leads ten million families to the supreme abode.

15.23.s:
putreṇāpīha kiṃ kāryyaṃ na gato dvārakāṃ yadi ..
nārī putraśatācchreṣṭhā gatvā kṛṣṇapurīṃ vaset .. .. 175 ..
15.23.d:
पुत्रेणापीह किं कार्य्यं न गतो द्वारकां यदि ..
नारी पुत्रशताच्छ्रेष्ठा गत्वा कृष्णपुरीं वसेत् .. .. 175 ..
15.23.m: Even by a son, what is to be accomplished here if he has not gone to Dvārakā? / A woman who has gone and dwells in the city of Kṛṣṇa is superior to a hundred sons.

15.23.s:
kṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇapurīṃ gatvā yo'rccayettulasīdalaiḥ ..
prāptaṃ janmaphalaṃ tena tāritāḥ prapitāmahāḥ .. 176 ..
15.23.d:
कृष्णं कृष्णपुरीं गत्वा योऽर्च्चयेत्तुलसीदलैः ..
प्राप्तं जन्मफलं तेन तारिताः प्रपितामहाः .. 176 ..
15.23.m: Whoever, having gone to the city of Kṛṣṇa, worships Kṛṣṇa with tulasī leaves, / the fruit of birth has been attained by him, and his great-grandfathers have been delivered.

15.23.s:
tulasīdalamālāṃ tu kṛṣṇottīrṇāṃ tu yo vahet ..
patrepatre'śvamedhānāṃ daśānāṃ labhate phalam .. 177 ..
15.23.d:
तुलसीदलमालां तु कृष्णोत्तीर्णां तु यो वहेत् ..
पत्रेपत्रेऽश्वमेधानां दशानां लभते फलम् .. 177 ..
15.23.m: And whoever wears a garland of tulasī leaves that has been offered to Kṛṣṇa / obtains the fruit of ten horse sacrifices for every single leaf. // 177

15.23.s:
tulasīkāṣṭhasaṃbhūtāṃ yo mālāṃ vahate naraḥ ..
phalaṃ yacchati daityāriḥ pratyahaṃ dvārakodbhavam .. 178 ..
15.23.d:
तुलसीकाष्ठसंभूतां यो मालां वहते नरः ..
फलं यच्छति दैत्यारिः प्रत्यहं द्वारकोद्भवम् .. 178 ..
15.23.m: The man who wears a garland made of tulasī wood— / the Enemy of the Daityas grants him every day the reward born of Dvārakā. // 178

15.23.s:
nivedya viṣṇave mālāṃ tulasīkāṣṭhasaṃbhavām ..
vahate yo naro bhaktyā tasya naivāsti pātakam ..
sadā prītamanāstasya kṛṣṇo devakinaṃdanaḥ .. 179 ..
15.23.d:
निवेद्य विष्णवे मालां तुलसीकाष्ठसंभवाम् ..
वहते यो नरो भक्त्या तस्य नैवास्ति पातकम् ..
सदा प्रीतमनास्तस्य कृष्णो देवकिनंदनः .. 179 ..
15.23.m: Offering a garland made of tulasī wood to Viṣṇu, / the man who wears it with devotion has no sin at all; / Kṛṣṇa, Devakī's son, is always well-pleased with him. // 179

15.23.s:
tulasīkāṣṭhasaṃbhūtaṃ śirobāhvādibhūṣaṇam ..
jāyate yasya martyasya tasya dehe sadā hariḥ .. 7.4.23.180 ..
15.23.d:
तुलसीकाष्ठसंभूतं शिरोबाह्वादिभूषणम् ..
जायते यस्य मर्त्यस्य तस्य देहे सदा हरिः .. 7.4.23.180 ..
15.23.m: That mortal who has ornaments made of tulasī wood / upon his head, arms, and other limbs—Hari is always in his body. // 180

15.23.s:
tulasīmālayā yastu bhūṣitaḥ karma cā''caret ..
pitṝṇāṃ devatānāṃ ca kṛtaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ kalau ..181..
15.23.d:
तुलसीमालया यस्तु भूषितः कर्म चा'ऽचरेत् ..
पितॄणां देवतानां च कृतं कोटिगुणं कलौ ..181..
15.23.m: And whatever rite one adorned with a garland of tulasī performs / for the ancestors and the deities is multiplied ten million times in the Kali [age]. // 181

15.23.s:
tulasīkāṣṭhamālāṃ tu pretarājasya dūtakāḥ ..
dṛṣṭvā dūreṇa naśyaṃti vātoddhūtā yathā'layaḥ .. 182 ..
15.23.d:
तुलसीकाष्ठमालां तु प्रेतराजस्य दूतकाः ..
दृष्ट्वा दूरेण नश्यंति वातोद्धूता यथाऽलयः .. 182 ..
15.23.m: Upon seeing a garland of tulasī wood, the messengers of the King of the Ghosts / flee far away, like bees driven by the wind. // 182

15.23.s:
jāyate tadgrahe naiva pāpasaṃkramaṇaṃ kutaḥ ..
śrutaṃ purāṇamasmābhiḥ kathitaṃ brahmavādibhiḥ .. 183 ..
15.23.d:
जायते तद्ग्रहे नैव पापसंक्रमणं कुतः ..
श्रुतं पुराणमस्माभिः कथितं ब्रह्मवादिभिः .. 183 ..
15.23.m: How could there be any transmission of sin when one takes it? / This has been heard by us from the Purāṇa as told by knowers of the Veda. // 183

15.23.s:
tasmānmālā tvayā dhāryyā tulasīkāṣṭhasaṃbhavā ..
harate nātra saṃdeha aihikāmuṣmikaṃ tvagham .. 184 ..
15.23.d:
तस्मान्माला त्वया धार्य्या तुलसीकाष्ठसंभवा ..
हरते नात्र संदेह ऐहिकामुष्मिकं त्वघम् .. 184 ..
15.23.m: Therefore, a garland made of tulasī wood must be worn by you; / without doubt, it removes sin pertaining to this world and the next. // 184

15.23.s:
tulasīmālayā yastu bhūṣito bhramate yadi ..
duḥsvapnaṃ durnimittaṃ ca na bhayaṃ śātravaṃ kvacit .. 185 ..
15.23.d:
तुलसीमालया यस्तु भूषितो भ्रमते यदि ..
दुःस्वप्नं दुर्निमित्तं च न भयं शात्रवं क्वचित् .. 185 ..
15.23.m: If one wanders adorned with a garland of tulasī, / there is no bad dream, no ill omen, and never any fear of enemies. // 185

15.23.s:
kṛtvā vai tīrthasaṃnyāsaṃ yatayo vidhavāḥ striyaḥ ..
jīvanmuktāḥ kalau jñeyāḥ kulakoṭisamanvitāḥ .. .. 186 ..
15.23.d:
कृत्वा वै तीर्थसंन्यासं यतयो विधवाः स्त्रियः ..
जीवन्मुक्ताः कलौ ज्ञेयाः कुलकोटिसमन्विताः .. .. 186 ..
15.23.m: Ascetics and widowed women who renounce the world at a sacred ford / are to be known as liberated while living in the Kali [age], together with ten million of their kin. // 186

15.23.s:
dhārayaṃti na ye mālāṃ haitukāḥ pāpamohitāḥ ..
narakānna nivartaṃte dagdhāḥ kopāgninā hareḥ .. 187 ..
15.23.d:
धारयंति न ये मालां हैतुकाः पापमोहिताः ..
नरकान्न निवर्तंते दग्धाः कोपाग्निना हरेः .. 187 ..
15.23.m: Those rationalists deluded by sin who do not wear the garland / do not turn back from hell, burned by the fire of Hari's anger. // 187

15.23.s:
unmīlinī vaṃjulinī trispṛśā pakṣavarddhinī ..
tvayā putra prakarttavyā jayaṃtī vijayā jayā .. 188 ..
15.23.d:
उन्मीलिनी वंजुलिनी त्रिस्पृशा पक्षवर्द्धिनी ..
त्वया पुत्र प्रकर्त्तव्या जयंती विजया जया .. 188 ..
15.23.m: Unmīlinī, Vañjulinī, Trispṛśā, Pakṣavardhinī, / Jayantī, Vijayā, and Jayā must be observed by you, O son. // 188

15.23.s:
pāpaghnī cāṣṭamī proktā kṛṣṇasyātīva vallabhā ..
kṛtā kalau yuge putra dvārakā mokṣadāyinī .. 189 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye dvārakāgamanamāhātmya tulasīdhāraṇamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma trayoviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 23 ..
15.23.d:
पापघ्नी चाष्टमी प्रोक्ता कृष्णस्यातीव वल्लभा ..
कृता कलौ युगे पुत्र द्वारका मोक्षदायिनी .. 189 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे चतुर्थे द्वारकामाहात्म्ये द्वारकागमनमाहात्म्य तुलसीधारणमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम त्रयोविंशतितमोऽध्यायः .. 23 ..
15.23.m:
The eighth day is also proclaimed as sin-destroying and exceedingly dear to Kṛṣṇa; / in the Kali age, O son, Dvārakā has been made the giver of liberation. // 189
Thus ends the twenty-third chapter, entitled 'Description of the Glory of Going to Dvārakā and the Glory of Wearing Tulasī', in the Dvārakāmāhātmya, the fourth [sub-section] of the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, the seventh [book] in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses. // 23

15.24.s:
.. śrīmārkaṃḍeya uvāca .. ..
pitṝṇāṃ pretarūpāṇāṃ kṛtvā vākyaṃ mahīpate ..
caṃdraśarmā dvijaśreṣṭho dvārakāṃ samupāgataḥ .. 1 ..
15.24.d:
.. श्रीमार्कंडेय उवाच .. ..
पितॄणां प्रेतरूपाणां कृत्वा वाक्यं महीपते ..
चंद्रशर्मा द्विजश्रेष्ठो द्वारकां समुपागतः .. 1 ..
15.24.m: Glorious Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Having carried out the instruction of his ancestors who were in the form of ghosts, O king, / Candraśarman, the best of the twice-born, arrived at Dvārakā, // 1

15.24.s:
rukmiṇīsahitaḥ kṛṣṇo yatra tiṣṭhati cānvaham ..
yatra tiṣṭhaṃti tīrthāni tatra yāto dvijottamaḥ .. 2 ..
15.24.d:
रुक्मिणीसहितः कृष्णो यत्र तिष्ठति चान्वहम् ..
यत्र तिष्ठंति तीर्थानि तत्र यातो द्विजोत्तमः .. 2 ..
15.24.m: where Kṛṣṇa dwells constantly together with Rukmiṇī, / and where the sacred fords abide: there the best of the twice-born went. // 2

15.24.s:
yatra tiṣṭhaṃti yajñāśca yatra tiṣṭhaṃti devatāḥ ..
yatra tiṣṭhaṃti ṛṣayo munayo yogavittamāḥ .. 3 ..
15.24.d:
यत्र तिष्ठंति यज्ञाश्च यत्र तिष्ठंति देवताः ..
यत्र तिष्ठंति ऋषयो मुनयो योगवित्तमाः .. 3 ..
15.24.m: Where sacrifices abide, where the deities abide, / and where seers, sages, and the best of knowers of yoga abide; // 3

15.24.s:
yā purī siddhagaṃdharvaiḥ sevyate kiṃnarairnareḥ ..
apsarogaṇayakṣaiśca dvārakā sarvakāmadā .. 4 ..
15.24.d:
या पुरी सिद्धगंधर्वैः सेव्यते किंनरैर्नरेः ..
अप्सरोगणयक्षैश्च द्वारका सर्वकामदा .. 4 ..
15.24.m: the city which is resorted to by siddhas, gandharvas, kinnaras, and men, / and by hosts of apsarases and yakṣas: Dvārakā, the granter of all desires; // 4

15.24.s:
svargārohaṇaniśreṇī vahate yatra gomatī ..
sā purī mokṣadā nṛṇāṃ dṛṣṭā vipravareṇa hi ..5..
15.24.d:
स्वर्गारोहणनिश्रेणी वहते यत्र गोमती ..
सा पुरी मोक्षदा नृणां दृष्टा विप्रवरेण हि ..5..
15.24.m: where the Gomatī flows as a stairway for ascending to heaven— / that city which grants liberation to men was indeed seen by that best of vipras. // 5

15.24.s:
yasyāḥ sīmāṃ praviṣṭasya brahmahatyādipātakam ..
naśyate darśanādeva tāṃ purīṃ ko na sevate .. 6 ..
15.24.d:
यस्याः सीमां प्रविष्टस्य ब्रह्महत्यादिपातकम् ..
नश्यते दर्शनादेव तां पुरीं को न सेवते .. 6 ..
15.24.m: For one who enters its border, the sin of killing a brahmin and other [crimes] / is destroyed merely by the darśana: who would not resort to that city? // 6

15.24.s:
gatvā kṛṣṇapurīṃ dṛṣṭvā gomatīṃ caiva sāgaram ..
manye kṛtārthamātmānaṃ jīvitaṃ yauvanaṃ dhanam .. 7 ..
15.24.d:
गत्वा कृष्णपुरीं दृष्ट्वा गोमतीं चैव सागरम् ..
मन्ये कृतार्थमात्मानं जीवितं यौवनं धनम् .. 7 ..
15.24.m: ‘Having gone to Kṛṣṇa's city and seen the Gomatī and the ocean, / I consider myself to have attained the goal, along with my life, youth, and wealth. // 7

15.24.s:
dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇapurīṃ ramyāṃ kṛṣṇasya mukhapaṃkajam ..
dhanyo'haṃ kṛtyakṛtyohaṃ sabhāgyo'haṃ dharātale .. .. 8 ..
15.24.d:
दृष्ट्वा कृष्णपुरीं रम्यां कृष्णस्य मुखपंकजम् ..
धन्योऽहं कृत्यकृत्योहं सभाग्योऽहं धरातले .. .. 8 ..
15.24.m: Having seen Kṛṣṇa's charming city and Kṛṣṇa's lotus face, / I am blessed, I have accomplished what was to be done, I am fortunate on the face of the earth. // 8

15.24.s:
dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇamukhaṃ ramyaṃ rukmiṇīṃ dvārakāṃ purīm..
tīrthakoṭisahasraistu sevitaiḥ kiṃ prayojanam ..9..
15.24.d:
दृष्ट्वा कृष्णमुखं रम्यं रुक्मिणीं द्वारकां पुरीम्..
तीर्थकोटिसहस्रैस्तु सेवितैः किं प्रयोजनम् ..9..
15.24.m: Having seen Kṛṣṇa's lovely face, Rukmiṇī, and the city of Dvārakā, / what need is there of visiting thousands of tens of millions of sacred fords? // 9

15.24.s:
puṇyairlakṣasahasraistu prāptā dvāravatī śubhā ..
śuklā vaiśākhamāse tu saṃprāptā madhusūdanī .. 7.4.24.10 ..
dvādaśī trispṛśānāma pāpakoṭiśatāpahā ..
dhanyāḥ sarve manuṣyāste vaiśākhe madhusūdanī ..1 1..
15.24.d:
पुण्यैर्लक्षसहस्रैस्तु प्राप्ता द्वारवती शुभा ..
शुक्ला वैशाखमासे तु संप्राप्ता मधुसूदनी .. 7.4.24.10 ..
द्वादशी त्रिस्पृशानाम पापकोटिशतापहा ..
धन्याः सर्वे मनुष्यास्ते वैशाखे मधुसूदनी ..1 1..
15.24.m:
Through hundreds of thousands of merits the auspicious Dvāravatī has been reached, / and in the bright fortnight of the month of Vaiśākha, the [day of] Madhusūdana has arrived: // 10
the dvādaśī named Trispṛśā, which removes hundreds of tens of millions of sins. / Blessed are all those mortals who have attained the [day of] Madhusūdana in Vaiśākha, // 11

15.24.s:
saṃprāptā trispṛśā yaistu budhavāreṇa saṃyutā ..
na yajñaistu na vedaistu na tīrthaiḥ koṭisevitaiḥ ..
prāpyate tatphalaṃ naiva dvārakāyāṃ yathā nṛṇām .. 12 ..
15.24.d:
संप्राप्ता त्रिस्पृशा यैस्तु बुधवारेण संयुता ..
न यज्ञैस्तु न वेदैस्तु न तीर्थैः कोटिसेवितैः ..
प्राप्यते तत्फलं नैव द्वारकायां यथा नृणाम् .. 12 ..
15.24.m: when the Trispṛśā is joined with Wednesday; / not through sacrifices, not through the Vedas, nor through visiting tens of millions of sacred fords / is such a fruit obtained by men as it is in Dvārakā.’ // 12

15.24.s:
evamuktvā dvijaśreṣṭho gomatītīramāśritaḥ ..
upaspṛśya yathānyāyaṃ śāstradṛṣṭena karmaṇā .. 13 ..
15.24.d:
एवमुक्त्वा द्विजश्रेष्ठो गोमतीतीरमाश्रितः ..
उपस्पृश्य यथान्यायं शास्त्रदृष्टेन कर्मणा .. 13 ..
15.24.m: Having spoken thus, the best of the twice-born went to the bank of the Gomatī; / having performed ritual sipping according to rule, in a rite prescribed by scripture, // 13

15.24.s:
kṛtvā snānaṃ yathoktaṃ tu saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ ..
cakratīrthātsamādāya śilāṃścakrāṃkitāñchubhān ..
pūjitāḥ puruṣasūktena yathoktavidhinā nṛpa .. 14 ..
15.24.d:
कृत्वा स्नानं यथोक्तं तु संतर्प्य पितृदेवताः ..
चक्रतीर्थात्समादाय शिलांश्चक्रांकिताञ्छुभान् ..
पूजिताः पुरुषसूक्तेन यथोक्तविधिना नृप .. 14 ..
15.24.m: and having performed the ritual ablution as prescribed and satisfied the ancestors and deities, / he took auspicious stones marked with the discus from Cakratīrtha / and worshipped them according to the Puruṣasūkta with the prescribed rule, O king. // 14

15.24.s:
śivapūjā kṛtā paścātsaṃsmṛtya pitṛbhāṣitam ..
dattvā piṃḍodakaṃ samyakpitṝṇāṃ vidhipūrvakam ..15..
15.24.d:
शिवपूजा कृता पश्चात्संस्मृत्य पितृभाषितम् ..
दत्त्वा पिंडोदकं सम्यक्पितॄणां विधिपूर्वकम् ..15..
15.24.m: Afterwards, remembering what his ancestors had said, he performed the worship of Śiva; / and duly offering the funeral ball and water to the ancestors according to rule, // 15

15.24.s:
vilepanaṃ ca vastrāṇi puṣpāṇi dhūpadīpako ..
naivedyāni manojñāni kaṃdamūlaphalāni ca .. 16 ..
15.24.d:
विलेपनं च वस्त्राणि पुष्पाणि धूपदीपको ..
नैवेद्यानि मनोज्ञानि कंदमूलफलानि च .. 16 ..
15.24.m: [he presented] unguent, garments, flowers, incense, lamp, / delightful food offerings, roots, bulbs, and fruits, // 16

15.24.s:
tāṃbūlaṃ ca sakarpūraṃ kṛtvā nīrājanādikam ..
pradakṣiṇāṃ namaskāraṃ stutipūrvaṃ punaḥpunaḥ .. 17 ..
15.24.d:
तांबूलं च सकर्पूरं कृत्वा नीराजनादिकम् ..
प्रदक्षिणां नमस्कारं स्तुतिपूर्वं पुनःपुनः .. 17 ..
15.24.m: betel with camphor, and performing the waving of lights and other rites, / he made circumambulation and prostration, preceded by praise again and again. // 17

15.24.s:
kṣamāpayitvā deveśaṃ cakre jāgaraṇaṃ tataḥ ..
yāmatraye vyatīte tu caṃdraśarmā hyuvāca ha .. 18 ..
15.24.d:
क्षमापयित्वा देवेशं चक्रे जागरणं ततः ..
यामत्रये व्यतीते तु चंद्रशर्मा ह्युवाच ह .. 18 ..
15.24.m: Having asked forgiveness from the Lord of Gods, he then kept a night vigil; / and when three watches [of the night] had passed, Candraśarman spoke: // 18

15.24.s:
āturasya ca dīnasya śṛṇu kṛṣṇa vaco mama ..
saṃsārabhayasaṃtrastaṃ māṃ tvamuddhara keśava ..19..
15.24.d:
आतुरस्य च दीनस्य शृणु कृष्ण वचो मम ..
संसारभयसंत्रस्तं मां त्वमुद्धर केशव ..19..
15.24.m: ‘Listen, O Kṛṣṇa, to my words, [me who am] afflicted and wretched! / Deliver me, terrified by the fear of saṃsāra, O Keśava! // 19

15.24.s:
tvatpādāṃbuja bhaktānāṃ na duḥkhaṃ pāpināmapi ..
kiṃ punaḥ pāpahīnānāṃ dvādaśīsevināṃ nṛṇām..7.4.24.20..
15.24.d:
त्वत्पादांबुज भक्तानां न दुःखं पापिनामपि ..
किं पुनः पापहीनानां द्वादशीसेविनां नृणाम्..7.4.24.20..
15.24.m: For those devoted to your lotus feet, there is no suffering even if they are sinners; / how much less for sinless men who observe the dvādaśī? // 20

15.24.s:
daśamīvedhajaṃ pāpaṃ kathitaṃ mama pūrvajaiḥ ..
duṣkṛtaṃ nāśamāyātu tvatprasādājjanārddana .. 21 ..
15.24.d:
दशमीवेधजं पापं कथितं मम पूर्वजैः ..
दुष्कृतं नाशमायातु त्वत्प्रसादाज्जनार्द्दन .. 21 ..
15.24.m: The sin arising from contamination by the daśamī was told by my forebears; / may that evil deed go to destruction by your grace, O Janārdana! // 21

15.24.s:
saviddhaṃ tvaddinaṃ kṛṣṇa yatkṛtaṃ jāgaraṃ hare ..
tatpāpaṃ vilayaṃ yātu yathālavaṇamaṃbhasi .. 22 ..
15.24.d:
सविद्धं त्वद्दिनं कृष्ण यत्कृतं जागरं हरे ..
तत्पापं विलयं यातु यथालवणमंभसि .. 22 ..
15.24.m: Whatever vigil was performed on your day contaminated [by daśamī], O Kṛṣṇa, O Hari, / may that sin dissolve like salt in water! // 22

15.24.s:
saviddhaṃ vāsaraṃ yasmā tkṛtaṃ mama pitāmahaiḥ ..
pretatvaṃ tena saṃprāptaṃ mahāduḥkhaprasādhakam .. 23 ..
15.24.d:
सविद्धं वासरं यस्मा त्कृतं मम पितामहैः ..
प्रेतत्वं तेन संप्राप्तं महादुःखप्रसाधकम् .. 23 ..
15.24.m: Because a contaminated day was observed by my grandfathers, / ghosthood, which brings great suffering, was incurred thereby. // 23

15.24.s:
yathā pretatvanirmuktā mama pūrvapitāmahāḥ ..
muktiṃ prayāṃti deveśa tathā kuru jagatpate .. 24 ..
15.24.d:
यथा प्रेतत्वनिर्मुक्ता मम पूर्वपितामहाः ..
मुक्तिं प्रयांति देवेश तथा कुरु जगत्पते .. 24 ..
15.24.m: So act, O Lord of Gods, O Master of the World, that my former grandfathers / may be freed from ghosthood and attain liberation! // 24

15.24.s:
punareva yaduśreṣṭha prasādaṃ kartumarhasi ..
avidyāmohitenāpi na kṛtaṃ tava pūjanam .. 25 ..
15.24.d:
पुनरेव यदुश्रेष्ठ प्रसादं कर्तुमर्हसि ..
अविद्यामोहितेनापि न कृतं तव पूजनम् .. 25 ..
15.24.m: Once more, O best of the Yadus, be pleased to show grace: / though deluded by ignorance, worship of you was not performed [by me]. // 25

15.24.s:
mayā pāpena deveśa śivabhaktiḥ samāśritā ..
tava bhaktiḥ kṛtā naiva na kṛtaṃ tava vāsaram .. 26 ..
15.24.d:
मया पापेन देवेश शिवभक्तिः समाश्रिता ..
तव भक्तिः कृता नैव न कृतं तव वासरम् .. 26 ..
15.24.m: By me, a sinner, O Lord of Gods, devotion to Śiva was resorted to; / devotion to you was not performed, nor was your day [of fasting] observed. // 26

15.24.s:
na dṛṣṭā dvārakā kṛṣṇa na snāto gomatījale ..
na dṛṣṭaṃ pādapadmaṃ ca tvadīyaṃ mokṣadā yakam .. 27 ..
15.24.d:
न दृष्टा द्वारका कृष्ण न स्नातो गोमतीजले ..
न दृष्टं पादपद्मं च त्वदीयं मोक्षदा यकम् .. 27 ..
15.24.m: Dvārakā was not seen, O Kṛṣṇa, nor was a bath taken in the waters of the Gomatī; / nor was your lotus foot seen, which bestows liberation. // 27

15.24.s:
na kṛtā dvārakāyātrā dṛṣṭvā someśvaraṃ prabhum ..
viphalaṃ sukṛtaṃ jātaṃ yanmayā samupārjitam .. 28 ..
15.24.d:
न कृता द्वारकायात्रा दृष्ट्वा सोमेश्वरं प्रभुम् ..
विफलं सुकृतं जातं यन्मया समुपार्जितम् .. 28 ..
15.24.m: I did not undertake the pilgrimage to Dvārakā after beholding Lord Someśvara; / whatever merit was earned by me has become fruitless. / 28

15.24.s:
matpūrvajaistu kathitaṃ sarvameva sureśvara ..
tatpuṇyaṃ mā vṛthā yātu prasādāttava keśava .. 29 ..
15.24.d:
मत्पूर्वजैस्तु कथितं सर्वमेव सुरेश्वर ..
तत्पुण्यं मा वृथा यातु प्रसादात्तव केशव .. 29 ..
15.24.m: Everything has indeed been spoken by my ancestors, O Lord of the gods. / By your grace, O Keśava, may that merit not go in vain. / 29

15.24.s:
dṛṣṭaṃ tu tava vaktraṃ ca durllabhaṃ bhuvanatraye ..
tannāsti devakīputra purāṇeṣu śrutaṃ mayā ..7.4.24.30..
15.24.d:
दृष्टं तु तव वक्त्रं च दुर्ल्लभं भुवनत्रये ..
तन्नास्ति देवकीपुत्र पुराणेषु श्रुतं मया ..7.4.24.30..
15.24.m: Indeed, your face, difficult to behold in the three worlds, has been seen. / That [such a vision could fail to liberate] is not so, O Son of Devakī; thus have I heard in the Purāṇas. / 7.4.24.30

15.24.s:
sāparādhāstu ye kecicchiśupālādayaḥ smṛtāḥ ..
tvatkareṇa hatāḥ kopānmuktiṃ prāptā mahīvarāḥ .. 31 ..
15.24.d:
सापराधास्तु ये केचिच्छिशुपालादयः स्मृताः ..
त्वत्करेण हताः कोपान्मुक्तिं प्राप्ता महीवराः .. 31 ..
15.24.m: Even those great lords of the earth, Śiśupāla and others, who are remembered as wrongdoers, / attained liberation when slain in anger by your hand. / 31

15.24.s:
adyaprabhṛti karttavyaṃ pūjanaṃ pratyahaṃ ca tat..
palārdhenāpi viddhaṃ syādbhoktavyaṃ vāsare tava .. 32 ..
15.24.d:
अद्यप्रभृति कर्त्तव्यं पूजनं प्रत्यहं च तत्..
पलार्धेनापि विद्धं स्याद्भोक्तव्यं वासरे तव .. 32 ..
15.24.m: From this day onward, that worship must be performed every day. / [Even if] it be overlapped by half a pala, one should fast on your day. / 32

15.24.s:
tvatpriyā ca mayā kāryyā dvādaśī vratasaṃyutā ..
bhaktirbhāgavatānāṃ ca kāryyā prāṇairddhanairapi .... 33 ..
15.24.d:
त्वत्प्रिया च मया कार्य्या द्वादशी व्रतसंयुता ..
भक्तिर्भागवतानां च कार्य्या प्राणैर्द्धनैरपि .... 33 ..
15.24.m: And I must observe your beloved Dvādaśī, accompanied by vows; / and devotion to the devotees of the Blessed One must be offered with my very life and wealth. / 33

15.24.s:
nityaṃ nāmasahasraṃ tu paṭhanīyaṃ tava priyam ..
pūjā tu tulasīpatrairmayā kāryā sadaiva hi .. 34 ..
15.24.d:
नित्यं नामसहस्रं तु पठनीयं तव प्रियम् ..
पूजा तु तुलसीपत्रैर्मया कार्या सदैव हि .. 34 ..
15.24.m: Your thousand names, so dear to you, must be recited daily. / And worship must always be performed by me with tulasī leaves. / 34

15.24.s:
tulasīkāṣṭhasaṃbhūtā mālā dhāryyā sadā mayā ..
nṛtyaṃ gītaṃ ca karttavyaṃ saṃprāpte jāgare tava .. 35 ..
15.24.d:
तुलसीकाष्ठसंभूता माला धार्य्या सदा मया ..
नृत्यं गीतं च कर्त्तव्यं संप्राप्ते जागरे तव .. 35 ..
15.24.m: A garland made of tulasī wood must always be worn by me; / and dancing and singing must be performed when your vigil arrives. / 35

15.24.s:
dvārakāyāṃ prakarttavyaṃ pratyahaṃ gamanaṃ mayā ..
tvatkathāśravaṇārthaṃ ca nityaṃ pustakavācanam .. 36 ..
15.24.d:
द्वारकायां प्रकर्त्तव्यं प्रत्यहं गमनं मया ..
त्वत्कथाश्रवणार्थं च नित्यं पुस्तकवाचनम् .. 36 ..
15.24.m: A journey to Dvārakā must be undertaken by me daily; / and recitation of the scripture must take place every day in order to hear your stories. / 36

15.24.s:
nityaṃ pādodakaṃ mūrdhnā mayā dhāryaṃ subhaktitaḥ ..
naivedyabhakṣaṇaṃ caiva kariṣyāmi subhaktitaḥ .. 37 ..
15.24.d:
नित्यं पादोदकं मूर्ध्ना मया धार्यं सुभक्तितः ..
नैवेद्यभक्षणं चैव करिष्यामि सुभक्तितः .. 37 ..
15.24.m: The water of your feet must daily be borne on my head with great devotion, / and I will eat the food offerings with deep devotion. / 37

15.24.s:
nirmālyaṃ śirasā dhāryyaṃ tvadīyaṃ sādaraṃ mayā ..
tava dattvā yadiṣṭaṃ tu bhakṣaṇīyaṃ sadā mayā .. 38 ..
15.24.d:
निर्माल्यं शिरसा धार्य्यं त्वदीयं सादरं मया ..
तव दत्त्वा यदिष्टं तु भक्षणीयं सदा मया .. 38 ..
15.24.m: Your floral remains must be respectfully borne on my head by me. / Having offered to you whatever is cherished, it must always be eaten by me. / 38

15.24.s:
tathā tathā prakarttavyaṃ yena tuṣṭirbhavettava ..
tathyametanmayā kṛṣṇa tavāgre parikīrtitam .. 39 ..
15.24.d:
तथा तथा प्रकर्त्तव्यं येन तुष्टिर्भवेत्तव ..
तथ्यमेतन्मया कृष्ण तवाग्रे परिकीर्तितम् .. 39 ..
15.24.m: Action must be done in every way such that your satisfaction arises. / This truth has been declared by me before you, O Kṛṣṇa. / 39

15.24.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
sādhusādhu mahābhāga candraśarmandvijottama ..
āgamiṣyaṃti malloke tvayā saha pitāmahāḥ .. 7.4.24.40 ..
15.24.d:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
साधुसाधु महाभाग चन्द्रशर्मन्द्विजोत्तम ..
आगमिष्यंति मल्लोके त्वया सह पितामहाः .. 7.4.24.40 ..
15.24.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Well done, well done, O fortunate Chandraśarman, best of brahmins! / Your ancestors shall go to my world along with you. / 7.4.24.40

15.24.s:
paśya pretatvanirmuktā matprasādāddvijottama ..
ākāśe garuḍārūḍhāstava pūrvapitāmahāḥ .. 41 ..
15.24.d:
पश्य प्रेतत्वनिर्मुक्ता मत्प्रसादाद्द्विजोत्तम ..
आकाशे गरुडारूढास्तव पूर्वपितामहाः .. 41 ..
15.24.m: Behold your former ancestors, best of brahmins, freed from the state of ghosts by my grace, / mounted upon Garuḍa in the sky. / 41

15.24.s:
.. pitāmahā ūcuḥ .. ..
tvatprasādādvayaṃ putra muktiṃ prāptā na saṃśayaḥ ..
pretayonervinirmuktāḥ kṛṣṇavaktrāvalokanāt .. 42...
dhanyāste mānuṣe loke putrapautraprapautrakāḥ ..
dṛṣṭvā śrīsomanāthaṃ tu kṛṣṇaṃ paśyaṃti dvārakām .. 43 ..
15.24.d:
.. पितामहा ऊचुः .. ..
त्वत्प्रसादाद्वयं पुत्र मुक्तिं प्राप्ता न संशयः ..
प्रेतयोनेर्विनिर्मुक्ताः कृष्णवक्त्रावलोकनात् .. 42...
धन्यास्ते मानुषे लोके पुत्रपौत्रप्रपौत्रकाः ..
दृष्ट्वा श्रीसोमनाथं तु कृष्णं पश्यंति द्वारकाम् .. 43 ..
15.24.m: The ancestors said: / By your grace, O son, we have attained liberation, without a doubt, / freed from the womb of ghosts through the beholding of Kṛṣṇa's face. / 42 / / Blessed are those sons, grandsons, and great-grandsons in the world of mortals / who, having seen venerable Somanātha, behold Kṛṣṇa and Dvārakā. / 43

15.24.s:
dhanyā ca vidhavā nārī kṛṣṇayātrāṃ karoti yā ..
uddhariṣyati loke'sminkulānāṃ nirayācchatam .. 44 ...
15.24.d:
धन्या च विधवा नारी कृष्णयात्रां करोति या ..
उद्धरिष्यति लोकेऽस्मिन्कुलानां निरयाच्छतम् .. 44 ...
15.24.m: Blessed too is the widowed woman who undertakes the pilgrimage to Kṛṣṇa; / she will deliver a hundred lineages from hell in this world. / 44

15.24.s:
śvapaco'pi karotyevaṃ yātrāṃ ca hariśāṃkarīm..
sa yāti paramāṃ muktiṃ pitṛbhiḥ parivāritaḥ .. 45 ..
15.24.d:
श्वपचोऽपि करोत्येवं यात्रां च हरिशांकरीम्..
स याति परमां मुक्तिं पितृभिः परिवारितः .. 45 ..
15.24.m: Even an outcaste who thus undertakes the pilgrimage to Hari and Śaṃkara / goes to supreme liberation, surrounded by his ancestors. / 45

15.24.s:
yaḥ punastīrthasaṃnyāsaṃ kṛtvā tiṣṭhati tatra vai ..
viṣṇulokānnivṛttirna kalpakoṭiśatairapi ..46..
15.24.d:
यः पुनस्तीर्थसंन्यासं कृत्वा तिष्ठति तत्र वै ..
विष्णुलोकान्निवृत्तिर्न कल्पकोटिशतैरपि ..46..
15.24.m: Moreover, he who, having renounced the world at that sacred ford, remains there, / does not return from the world of Viṣṇu even after hundreds of crores of kalpas. / 46

15.24.s:
vaṃcitāste na sandeho dṛṣṭvā someśvaraṃ prabhum ..
dṛṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇamukhaṃ naiva na snātā gomatījale .. 47 ..
15.24.d:
वंचितास्ते न सन्देहो दृष्ट्वा सोमेश्वरं प्रभुम् ..
दृष्टं कृष्णमुखं नैव न स्नाता गोमतीजले .. 47 ..
15.24.m: They are deceived, no doubt, who having seen Lord Someśvara, / have not beheld the face of Kṛṣṇa nor bathed in the waters of the Gomatī. / 47

15.24.s:
kiṃ jalairbahubhiḥ puṇyaistīrthakoṭisamudbhavaiḥ ..
dṛṣṭvā someśvaraṃ yastu dvārakāṃ naiva gacchati ..
dhikkurvaṃti ca taṃ pāpaṃ pitaro divi saṃsthitāḥ .. 48 ..
15.24.d:
किं जलैर्बहुभिः पुण्यैस्तीर्थकोटिसमुद्भवैः ..
दृष्ट्वा सोमेश्वरं यस्तु द्वारकां नैव गच्छति ..
धिक्कुर्वंति च तं पापं पितरो दिवि संस्थिताः .. 48 ..
15.24.m: What is the use of abundant meritorious waters arising from crores of sacred fords? / If one who has seen Someśvara does not go to Dvārakā, / the ancestors dwelling in heaven curse that sinner. / 48

15.24.s:
dṛṣṭvā someśvaraṃ devaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā punaḥ śivam..
sauparṇe kathitaṃ puṇyaṃ yātrāśatasamudbhavam .. 49 ..
15.24.d:
दृष्ट्वा सोमेश्वरं देवं कृष्णं दृष्ट्वा पुनः शिवम्..
सौपर्णे कथितं पुण्यं यात्राशतसमुद्भवम् .. 49 ..
15.24.m: Having seen the god Someśvara, and having seen Kṛṣṇa, and then Śiva again, / the merit arising from a hundred pilgrimages has been declared in the Sauparṇa Purāṇa. / 49

15.24.s:
dṛṣṭvā someśvaraṃ devaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ naiva prapaśyati ..
mohādvyarthagataṃ tasya sarvaṃ saṃsārakarma vai .. 7.4.24.50 ..
15.24.d:
दृष्ट्वा सोमेश्वरं देवं कृष्णं नैव प्रपश्यति ..
मोहाद्व्यर्थगतं तस्य सर्वं संसारकर्म वै .. 7.4.24.50 ..
15.24.m: He who, having seen the god Someśvara, does not behold Kṛṣṇa, / all his worldly activity has gone in vain through delusion. / 7.4.24.50

15.24.s:
āgatya yaḥ prabhāse ca kṛṣṇaṃ paśyati vai naraḥ ..
prabhāsāyutasaṃkhyaṃ tu phalamāpnoti yatnataḥ .. 51 ..
15.24.d:
आगत्य यः प्रभासे च कृष्णं पश्यति वै नरः ..
प्रभासायुतसंख्यं तु फलमाप्नोति यत्नतः .. 51 ..
15.24.m: The man who, having arrived at Prabhāsa, beholds Kṛṣṇa, / diligently attains the fruit equal to ten thousand visits to Prabhāsa. / 51

15.24.s:
yasmātsarvāṇi tīrthāni sarve devāstathā makhāḥ ..
dvārakāyāṃ samāyāṃti trikālaṃ kṛṣṇasaṃnidhau .. 52 ..
15.24.d:
यस्मात्सर्वाणि तीर्थानि सर्वे देवास्तथा मखाः ..
द्वारकायां समायांति त्रिकालं कृष्णसंनिधौ .. 52 ..
15.24.m: Because all sacred fords, all gods, and likewise all sacrifices / arrive at Dvārakā at the three junctures of the day, into the presence of Kṛṣṇa. / 52

15.24.s:
tīrthairnānāvidhaiḥ putra tatsthānaiḥ kiṃ prayojanam ..
phalaṃ samastatīrthānāṃ dṛṣṭvā dvāravatīṃ labhet .. 53 ..
15.24.d:
तीर्थैर्नानाविधैः पुत्र तत्स्थानैः किं प्रयोजनम् ..
फलं समस्ततीर्थानां दृष्ट्वा द्वारवतीं लभेत् .. 53 ..
15.24.m: What is the need, O son, for various sacred fords and their sites? / By beholding Dvāravatī, one attains the fruit of all sacred fords. / 53

15.24.s:
hate kaṃse jarāsandhe narake ca nipātite ..
uttārite bhuvo bhāre kṛṣṇo devakinaṃdanaḥ ..
cakre dvāravatīṃ ramyāṃ sannidhau sāgarasya ca .. 54 ..
15.24.d:
हते कंसे जरासन्धे नरके च निपातिते ..
उत्तारिते भुवो भारे कृष्णो देवकिनंदनः ..
चक्रे द्वारवतीं रम्यां सन्निधौ सागरस्य च .. 54 ..
15.24.m: When Kaṃsa and Jarāsandha were slain, and Naraka was cast down, / and the burden of the earth was lifted, Kṛṣṇa, the son of Devakī, / built delightful Dvāravatī near the ocean. / 54

15.24.s: sthitaḥ prītamanāḥ kṛṣṇo lapsyate kāminīsukham .. 55 ..
15.24.d: स्थितः प्रीतमनाः कृष्णो लप्स्यते कामिनीसुखम् .. 55 ..
15.24.m: Dwelling there with a delighted mind, Kṛṣṇa obtains the pleasure of lovely women. / 55

15.24.s:
brahmāgnivāyusūryāśca vāsavādyā divaukasaḥ ..
marttyā viprāśca rājānaḥ pātālātpannageśvarāḥ .. 56 ..
15.24.d:
ब्रह्माग्निवायुसूर्याश्च वासवाद्या दिवौकसः ..
मर्त्त्या विप्राश्च राजानः पातालात्पन्नगेश्वराः .. 56 ..
15.24.m: Brahmā, Agni, Vāyu, Sūrya, and the gods headed by Indra, / mortals, brahmins, kings, and the lords of serpents from Pātāla, / 56

15.24.s:
nadyo nadāśca śailāśca vanānyupavanāni ca ..
puragrāmā hyaraṇyāni sāgarāśca sarāṃsi ca .. 57 ..
15.24.d:
नद्यो नदाश्च शैलाश्च वनान्युपवनानि च ..
पुरग्रामा ह्यरण्यानि सागराश्च सरांसि च .. 57 ..
15.24.m: rivers and streams, mountains, forests and groves, / cities, villages, wildernesses, oceans, and lakes, / 57

15.24.s:
yakṣāścāsuragaṃdharvāḥ siddhā vidyādharāstathā ..
rambhādyapsarasaścaiva prahlādādyā diteḥ sutāḥ ..
rakṣā vibhīṣaṇādyāśca dhanado rakṣa nāyakaḥ .. 58 ..
15.24.d:
यक्षाश्चासुरगंधर्वाः सिद्धा विद्याधरास्तथा ..
रम्भाद्यप्सरसश्चैव प्रह्लादाद्या दितेः सुताः ..
रक्षा विभीषणाद्याश्च धनदो रक्ष नायकः .. 58 ..
15.24.m: yakṣas, asuras, gandharvas, siddhas, and likewise vidyādharas, / Rambhā and other apsarases, Prahlāda and other sons of Diti, / rākṣasas headed by Vibhīṣaṇa, and Kubera, the lord of rākṣasas, / 58

15.24.s:
ṛṣayo munayaḥ siddhāḥ sanakādyāśca yoginaḥ ..
grahā ṛkṣāṇi yogāśca dhruvaḥ paramavaiṣṇavaḥ .. 59 ..
15.24.d:
ऋषयो मुनयः सिद्धाः सनकाद्याश्च योगिनः ..
ग्रहा ऋक्षाणि योगाश्च ध्रुवः परमवैष्णवः .. 59 ..
15.24.m: seers, sages, siddhas, and yogins headed by Sanaka, / the planets, lunar mansions, astrological yogas, and Dhruva, the supreme Vaiṣṇava, / 59

15.24.s:
yatkiṃcittriṣu lokeṣu tiṣṭhate sthāṇujaṃgamam ..
śrīkṛṣṇasannidhau nityaṃ pratyahaṃ tiṣṭhate sadā .. 7.4.24.60 ..
15.24.d:
यत्किंचित्त्रिषु लोकेषु तिष्ठते स्थाणुजंगमम् ..
श्रीकृष्णसन्निधौ नित्यं प्रत्यहं तिष्ठते सदा .. 7.4.24.60 ..
15.24.m: whatever exists in the three worlds, stationary or moving, / always abides daily in the presence of Śrī Kṛṣṇa. / 7.4.24.60

15.24.s:
na tyajaṃti purīṃ puṇyāṃ dvārakāṃ kṛṣṇasevitām ..
sā tvayā sevitā putra sāṃprataṃ kṛṣṇadarśanāt ..
piśācayoninirmuktā yāsyāmaḥ paramāṃ gatim .. 61 ..
15.24.d:
न त्यजंति पुरीं पुण्यां द्वारकां कृष्णसेविताम् ..
सा त्वया सेविता पुत्र सांप्रतं कृष्णदर्शनात् ..
पिशाचयोनिनिर्मुक्ता यास्यामः परमां गतिम् .. 61 ..
15.24.m: They do not leave the sacred city of Dvārakā, served by Kṛṣṇa. / That [city] has been served by you, O son, and now from beholding Kṛṣṇa, / freed from the ghost-state, we shall go to the supreme state. / 61

15.24.s:
dvādaśīvedhajaṃpāpaṃ dvārakāyāḥ prabhāvataḥ ..
naṣṭaṃ putra na sandehaḥ saṃprāptāḥ paramaṃ padam .. 62 ..
15.24.d:
द्वादशीवेधजंपापं द्वारकायाः प्रभावतः ..
नष्टं पुत्र न सन्देहः संप्राप्ताः परमं पदम् .. 62 ..
15.24.m: Through the power of Dvārakā, the sin born of the overlapping of Dvādaśī / is destroyed, O son; without a doubt, we have attained the supreme abode. / 62

15.24.s:
dvādaśīvedhasambhūtaṃ yattvayā pāpamarjitam ..
kṛṣṇasya darśanātkṣīṇaṃ na jahyaṃ dvādaśīvratam .. 63 ..
15.24.d:
द्वादशीवेधसम्भूतं यत्त्वया पापमर्जितम् ..
कृष्णस्य दर्शनात्क्षीणं न जह्यं द्वादशीव्रतम् .. 63 ..
15.24.m: Whatever sin was accumulated by you, born from the overlapping of Dvādaśī, / has been destroyed through the darśana of Kṛṣṇa. Do not abandon the vow of Dvādaśī. / 63

15.24.s:
rakṣaṇīyaṃ prayatnena vedho daśamisambhavaḥ ..
no cetputra na saṃdehaḥ pretayonimavāpsyasi .. 64 ..
15.24.d:
रक्षणीयं प्रयत्नेन वेधो दशमिसम्भवः ..
नो चेत्पुत्र न संदेहः प्रेतयोनिमवाप्स्यसि .. 64 ..
15.24.m: The overlapping arising from the tenth tithi must be avoided with great effort; / otherwise, O son, you will doubtlessly obtain the womb of ghosts. / 64

15.24.s:
trailokya saṃbhavaṃ pāpaṃ teṣāṃ bhavati bhūtale..
saśalyaṃ ye prakurvaṃti vāsaraṃ kṛṣṇasaṃjñakam..65..
15.24.d:
त्रैलोक्य संभवं पापं तेषां भवति भूतले..
सशल्यं ये प्रकुर्वंति वासरं कृष्णसंज्ञकम्..65..
15.24.m: The sin that arises in all the three worlds falls upon those on earth / who observe the day designated for Kṛṣṇa with an astrological defect. / 65

15.24.s:
prāyaścittaṃ na tasyāsti saśalyaṃ vāsaraṃ hareḥ ..
ye kurvaṃti na te yāṃti manvataraśatairdivam .. 66 ..
15.24.d:
प्रायश्चित्तं न तस्यास्ति सशल्यं वासरं हरेः ..
ये कुर्वंति न ते यांति मन्वतरशतैर्दिवम् .. 66 ..
15.24.m: There is no expiation for him; those who observe the day of Hari / with an astrological defect do not reach heaven even in hundreds of manvantaras. / 66

15.24.s:
pretatvaṃ duḥsahaṃ putra duḥsahā yamayātanā ..
tasmātputra na karttavyaṃ saśalyaṃ dvādaśīvratam .. 67 ..
15.24.d:
प्रेतत्वं दुःसहं पुत्र दुःसहा यमयातना ..
तस्मात्पुत्र न कर्त्तव्यं सशल्यं द्वादशीव्रतम् .. 67 ..
15.24.m: The state of a ghost is intolerable, O son, and intolerable is the torment of Yama; / therefore, O son, the vow of Dvādaśī must not be performed with an astrological defect. / 67

15.24.s:
kārayaṃti hi ye tvajñāḥ kūṭayuktāśca hetukāḥ ..
pretayoniṃ prayāsyaṃti pitṛbhiḥ saha sarvataḥ .. 68 ..
15.24.d:
कारयंति हि ये त्वज्ञाः कूटयुक्ताश्च हेतुकाः ..
प्रेतयोनिं प्रयास्यंति पितृभिः सह सर्वतः .. 68 ..
15.24.m: For those ignorant, deceitful sophists who cause it to be observed [thus] / will entirely enter the womb of ghosts along with their ancestors. / 68

15.24.s:
dvādaśī daśamīviddhā saṃtānapravināśinī ..
dhvaṃsinī pūrvapuṇyānāṃ kṛṣṇabhaktivināśinī ..69..
15.24.d:
द्वादशी दशमीविद्धा संतानप्रविनाशिनी ..
ध्वंसिनी पूर्वपुण्यानां कृष्णभक्तिविनाशिनी ..69..
15.24.m: A dvādaśī overlapping with a daśamī destroys one's offspring; / it destroys previous merits and ruins devotion to Kṛṣṇa. // 69

15.24.s:
svasti te'stu gamiṣyāmaḥ prasādādrukmiṇīpateḥ ..
prāptaṃ viṣṇupadaṃ putra apunarbhavasaṃjñakam ..7.4.24.70.. ..
15.24.d:
स्वस्ति तेऽस्तु गमिष्यामः प्रसादाद्रुक्मिणीपतेः ..
प्राप्तं विष्णुपदं पुत्र अपुनर्भवसंज्ञकम् ..7.4.24.70.. ..
15.24.m: May you be blessed! We shall depart, by the grace of the lord of Rukmiṇī. / Viṣṇu’s realm, called non-return, has been attained, O son!” // 70

15.24.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
caṃdraśarmanprasanno'haṃ tava bhaktyā dvijottama ..
śaivabhāvaprapanno'pi yastvaṃ jāto'si vaiṣṇavaḥ .. 71 ..
15.24.d:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
चंद्रशर्मन्प्रसन्नोऽहं तव भक्त्या द्विजोत्तम ..
शैवभावप्रपन्नोऽपि यस्त्वं जातोऽसि वैष्णवः .. 71 ..
15.24.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / “O Candraśarman, best of brahmins, I am pleased with your devotion! / Though adhering to the Śaiva path, you have become a Vaiṣṇava. // 71

15.24.s:
navasaptativarṣāṇi na kṛtaṃ vāsare mama ..
saṃpūrṇaṃ matprasādena tava jātaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ..72..
15.24.d:
नवसप्ततिवर्षाणि न कृतं वासरे मम ..
संपूर्णं मत्प्रसादेन तव जातं न संशयः ..72..
15.24.m: For seventy-nine years you did not observe [the fast] on my day; / by my grace, it has now been fully completed for you—there is no doubt. // 72

15.24.s:
ekenaivopavāsena trispṛśāsaṃbhavena hi ..
dvārakāyāḥ prasādena maddṛṣṭyālokanena hi .. 73 ..
15.24.d:
एकेनैवोपवासेन त्रिस्पृशासंभवेन हि ..
द्वारकायाः प्रसादेन मद्दृष्ट्यालोकनेन हि .. 73 ..
15.24.m: By just a single fast arising on a trispṛśā day, / by the grace of Dvārakā, and by beholding my form, // 73

15.24.s:
avidyāmohitenaiva śivabhaktyā mamārcanam ..
na kṛtaṃ matprasādena kṛtaṃ caiva bhaviṣyati .. 74 ..
15.24.d:
अविद्यामोहितेनैव शिवभक्त्या ममार्चनम् ..
न कृतं मत्प्रसादेन कृतं चैव भविष्यति .. 74 ..
15.24.m: since, deluded by ignorance through Śiva-devotion, my worship / was not performed, it shall indeed be deemed performed by my grace. // 74

15.24.s:
vaiśākhe yairahaṃ dṛṣṭo dvārakāyāṃ dvijottama ..
trispṛśāvāsare caiva vaṃjulīvāsare tathā .. 75 ..
15.24.d:
वैशाखे यैरहं दृष्टो द्वारकायां द्विजोत्तम ..
त्रिस्पृशावासरे चैव वंजुलीवासरे तथा .. 75 ..
15.24.m: Those by whom I am seen in Dvārakā in the month of Vaiśākha, O best of brahmins, / on a trispṛśā day, and likewise on a vañjulī day, // 75

15.24.s:
unmīlinīdine prāpte prāpte vā pakṣavarddhinī ..
naiteṣāṃ cāparādho'sti yadyapi brahmaghātakāḥ .. 76 ..
15.24.d:
उन्मीलिनीदिने प्राप्ते प्राप्ते वा पक्षवर्द्धिनी ..
नैतेषां चापराधोऽस्ति यद्यपि ब्रह्मघातकाः .. 76 ..
15.24.m: or when an unmīlinī day has arrived, or a pakṣavardhinī day, / no sin attaches to them, even if they are slayers of brahmins. // 76

15.24.s:
janmaprabhṛti puṇyasya prakṛtasyāpi bhūsura ..
matpurīdarśanenāpi phalabhāgī bhavennaraḥ .. 77 ..
15.24.d:
जन्मप्रभृति पुण्यस्य प्रकृतस्यापि भूसुर ..
मत्पुरीदर्शनेनापि फलभागी भवेन्नरः .. 77 ..
15.24.m: From the very time of one’s birth, O brahmin, even of standard merit, / a person becomes a sharer in the fruit merely by the darśana of my city. // 77

15.24.s:
dṛṣṭvā samastatīrthāni prabhāsādīni bhūtale ..
matpurīdarśanenaiva pṛṣṭvā'pīha bhavetphalam .. 78 ..
15.24.d:
दृष्ट्वा समस्ततीर्थानि प्रभासादीनि भूतले ..
मत्पुरीदर्शनेनैव पृष्ट्वाऽपीह भवेत्फलम् .. 78 ..
15.24.m: Having visited all the sacred fords on earth, such as Prabhāsa, / the same fruit is obtained here merely by the darśana of my city, or even by inquiring about it. // 78

15.24.s:
māhātmyaṃ dvārakāyāstu maddine yatra tatra vā ..
paṭhenmama purīṃ puṇyāṃ labhate matprasādataḥ .. 79 ..
15.24.d:
माहात्म्यं द्वारकायास्तु मद्दिने यत्र तत्र वा ..
पठेन्मम पुरीं पुण्यां लभते मत्प्रसादतः .. 79 ..
15.24.m: Whoever recites the māhātmya of Dvārakā on my day, wherever it may be, / attains my sacred city through my grace. // 79

15.24.s:
matpurīṃ vasatāṃ puṇyaṃ trikālaṃ mama darśanāt ..
tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti yastvidaṃ paṭhate kalau .. 7.4.24.80 ..
15.24.d:
मत्पुरीं वसतां पुण्यं त्रिकालं मम दर्शनात् ..
तत्फलं समवाप्नोति यस्त्विदं पठते कलौ .. 7.4.24.80 ..
15.24.m: The merit of those dwelling in my city from beholding me at the three junctures of the day— / he who recites this in the Kali age attains that very fruit. // 80

15.24.s:
kalau kāśī ca mathurā hyavaṃtī ca dvijottama ..
ayodhyā ca tathā māyā kāṃcī caiva ca matpurī .. 81 ..
15.24.d:
कलौ काशी च मथुरा ह्यवंती च द्विजोत्तम ..
अयोध्या च तथा माया कांची चैव च मत्पुरी .. 81 ..
15.24.m: In the Kali age, Kāśī, Mathurā, and Avantī, O best of brahmins, / Ayodhyā, and likewise Māyā, Kāñcī, and my own city; // 81

15.24.s:
śāligrāmabhavaṃ caiva badarī ca tathottamā ..
kurukṣetraṃ bhṛgukṣetraṃ puṣkaraṃ śubhasaṃjñakam ..82..
15.24.d:
शालिग्रामभवं चैव बदरी च तथोत्तमा ..
कुरुक्षेत्रं भृगुक्षेत्रं पुष्करं शुभसंज्ञकम् ..82..
15.24.m: the place where Śāligrāma is found, and excellent Badarī; / Kurukṣetra, Bhṛgukṣetra, and the auspicious Puṣkara; // 82

15.24.s:
prayāgaṃ ca prabhāsaṃ ca kṣetraṃ vai hāṭakeśvaram ..
gaṃgādvāraṃ śaukaraṃ ca gaṃgāsāgarasaṃgamam .. 83 ..
15.24.d:
प्रयागं च प्रभासं च क्षेत्रं वै हाटकेश्वरम् ..
गंगाद्वारं शौकरं च गंगासागरसंगमम् .. 83 ..
15.24.m: Prayāga, Prabhāsa, and the sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara; / Gaṅgādvāra, Śaukara, and the confluence of the Gaṅgā and the ocean; // 83

15.24.s:
naimiṣaṃ daṇḍakāraṇyaṃ tathā vṛndāvanaṃ dvija ..
saiṃdhavaṃ cārbudākhyaṃ ca sarvāṇyāyatanāni ca .. 84 ..
15.24.d:
नैमिषं दण्डकारण्यं तथा वृन्दावनं द्विज ..
सैंधवं चार्बुदाख्यं च सर्वाण्यायतनानि च .. 84 ..
15.24.m: Naimiṣa, the Daṇḍaka forest, and likewise Vṛndāvana, O brahmin; / Saiṃdhava, Arbuda, and all shrines; // 84

15.24.s:
vanāni māgadhādīni puṣkarāṇi dvijottama ..
śailarājādayaḥ śailā himādripramukhā hi ye .. 85 ..
15.24.d:
वनानि मागधादीनि पुष्कराणि द्विजोत्तम ..
शैलराजादयः शैला हिमाद्रिप्रमुखा हि ये .. 85 ..
15.24.m: the forests beginning with Māgadha, the lotus lakes, O best of brahmins; / mountains such as the king of mountains, headed by the Himālaya; // 85

15.24.s:
gaṃgādayaśca sarito bhūtale saṃti yāni vai ..
tīrthāni triṣu kāleṣu samāni dvārakāpuraḥ .. 86 ..
15.24.d:
गंगादयश्च सरितो भूतले संति यानि वै ..
तीर्थानि त्रिषु कालेषु समानि द्वारकापुरः .. 86 ..
15.24.m: rivers such as the Gaṅgā—whatever sacred fords there are on earth / are, at all three times, equal before Dvārakā. // 86

15.24.s:
kalinā kalitaṃ sarvaṃ varjayitvā tu matpurīm ..
vipra varṣaśate prāpte matpuryāṃ mama darśane .. 87 ..
15.24.d:
कलिना कलितं सर्वं वर्जयित्वा तु मत्पुरीम् ..
विप्र वर्षशते प्राप्ते मत्पुर्यां मम दर्शने .. 87 ..
15.24.m: Everything has been seized by the Kali age, except my city. / O brahmin, when a hundred years have elapsed, upon the darśana of me in my city, // 87

15.24.s:
tava mṛtyurmahīdeva matprasādādbhaviṣyati ..
trispṛśāvāsare prāpte vaiśākhe śuklapakṣataḥ .. 88 ..
15.24.d:
तव मृत्युर्महीदेव मत्प्रसादाद्भविष्यति ..
त्रिस्पृशावासरे प्राप्ते वैशाखे शुक्लपक्षतः .. 88 ..
15.24.m: your death shall take place by my grace, O earthly deity, / when a trispṛśā day arrives in the bright fortnight of Vaiśākha, // 88

15.24.s:
saṃgame budhavārasya divā bhūmau mamāgrataḥ ..
daśamaṃ dvāramāsādya tava prāṇasya nirgamam ..
bhaviṣyati na saṃdeho matprasādena bhūsura .. 89 ..
15.24.d:
संगमे बुधवारस्य दिवा भूमौ ममाग्रतः ..
दशमं द्वारमासाद्य तव प्राणस्य निर्गमम् ..
भविष्यति न संदेहो मत्प्रसादेन भूसुर .. 89 ..
15.24.m: on the conjunction of a Wednesday, by day, on the ground before me. / Reaching the tenth door, the departure of your life-breath / shall occur—there is no doubt—by my grace, O brahmin. // 89

15.24.s:
svasthānaṃ gaccha vipreṃdra sarvānkāmānavāpsyasi ..
madbhaktānāṃ yugāṃte'pi vināśo nopapadyate .. 7.4.24.90 ..
15.24.d:
स्वस्थानं गच्छ विप्रेंद्र सर्वान्कामानवाप्स्यसि ..
मद्भक्तानां युगांतेऽपि विनाशो नोपपद्यते .. 7.4.24.90 ..
15.24.m: Go to your own abode, O chief of brahmins; you shall attain all desires. / Even at the end of an era, destruction does not befall my devotees. // 90

15.24.s:
madbhaktiṃ vahatāṃ puṃsāmiha loke pare'pi vā ..
nāśubhaṃ vidyate kiṃcitkulakoṭiṃ nayeddivam .. 91 ..
15.24.d:
मद्भक्तिं वहतां पुंसामिह लोके परेऽपि वा ..
नाशुभं विद्यते किंचित्कुलकोटिं नयेद्दिवम् .. 91 ..
15.24.m: For men who bear devotion to me, in this world or in the next, / no misfortune exists; such a one leads ten million kinsmen to heaven.” // 91

15.24.s:
.. mārkaṇḍeya uvāca .. ..
tato varṣaśate prāpte gatvā dvāravatīṃ purīm ..
prāṇānkṛṣṇopadeśena tyaktvā mokṣaṃ jagāma ha .. 92..
15.24.d:
.. मार्कण्डेय उवाच .. ..
ततो वर्षशते प्राप्ते गत्वा द्वारवतीं पुरीम् ..
प्राणान्कृष्णोपदेशेन त्यक्त्वा मोक्षं जगाम ह .. 92..
15.24.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then, when a hundred years had elapsed, he went to the city of Dvāravatī / and, having given up his life-breaths according to Kṛṣṇa’s instruction, he attained liberation. // 92

15.24.s:
indradyumna tadākhyātaṃ māhātmyaṃ dvārakābhavam ..
punarev pravakṣyāmi yatte manasi varttate .. 93 ..
15.24.d:
इन्द्रद्युम्न तदाख्यातं माहात्म्यं द्वारकाभवम् ..
पुनरेव् प्रवक्ष्यामि यत्ते मनसि वर्त्तते .. 93 ..
15.24.m: O Indradyumna, thus has been declared the māhātmya belonging to Dvārakā. / I shall tell you once more whatever is in your mind. // 93

15.24.s:
śṛṇvatāṃ paṭhatāṃ caiva māhā tmyaṃ dvārakābhavam ..
sarvaṃ phalamavāpnoti kṛṣṇena kathitaṃ ca yat .. 94 ..
15.24.d:
शृण्वतां पठतां चैव माहा त्म्यं द्वारकाभवम् ..
सर्वं फलमवाप्नोति कृष्णेन कथितं च यत् .. 94 ..
15.24.m: For those who hear and recite the māhātmya belonging to Dvārakā, / they attain all the fruit that was spoken by Kṛṣṇa. // 94

15.24.s:
vistārayaṃti loke'smim̐llikhitaṃ yasya veśmani ..
pratyakṣaṃ dvārakāpuṇyaṃ prāpyate kṛṣṇasaṃbhavam .. 95..
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakākhaṇḍe candraśarmopākhyāne candraśarmaṇo dvārakāgamanapūrvaka kṛṣṇadattavaragrahaṇādi dvārakānagarīśraiṣṭhyamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma caturviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 24 ..
15.24.d:
विस्तारयंति लोकेऽस्मिम्̐ल्लिखितं यस्य वेश्मनि ..
प्रत्यक्षं द्वारकापुण्यं प्राप्यते कृष्णसंभवम् .. 95..
इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे चतुर्थे द्वारकाखण्डे चन्द्रशर्मोपाख्याने चन्द्रशर्मणो द्वारकागमनपूर्वक कृष्णदत्तवरग्रहणादि द्वारकानगरीश्रैष्ठ्यमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम चतुर्विंशतितमोऽध्यायः .. 24 ..
15.24.m:
Those who propagate it in this world, or in whose house it is written down, / tangibly obtain the merit of Dvārakā born of Kṛṣṇa. // 95
Thus ends the twenty-fourth chapter, entitled “Description of the Pre-eminence and Māhātmya of the City of Dvārakā, Preceded by Candraśarman’s Arrival at Dvārakā and Receiving a Boon from Kṛṣṇa,” in the Episode of Candraśarman in the Dvārakākhaṇḍa, the fourth [sub-division] of the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, the seventh [part] in the venerable Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses. // 24
